Framework này cung cấp sẵn các công cụ và thư viện cơ bản, giúp hỗ trợ quá trình phát triển ứng dụng một cách thuận tiện mà không ràng buộc kiến trúc phức tạp. Nhờ đó, Flask được đánh giá là lựa chọn phù hợp cho cả những dự án nhỏ lẫn các ứng dụng mở rộng, đáp ứng tốt yêu cầu tùy biến trong từng tình huống phát triển.

Trang web quản lý thu chi cá nhân đóng vai trò là một công cụ thiết yếu hỗ trợ người dùng trong việc kiểm soát và quản lý tài chính cá nhân hiệu quả. Trên thị trường hiện nay, đã xuất hiện đa dạng các nền tảng quản lý thu chi cá nhân, mỗi nền tảng đều cung cấp những tính năng và lợi ích riêng biệt nhằm đáp ứng nhu cầu đa dạng của người sử dụng. Mặc dù vậy, tỷ lệ người dân sử dụng các trang web này vẫn còn ở mức thấp, chưa đạt được sự phổ biến rộng rãi trong cộng đồng. Nghiên cứu này nhằm phân tích các yếu tố ảnh hưởng đến việc áp dụng trang web quản lý thu chi cá nhân, góp phần thúc đẩy việc sử dụng các công cụ kỹ thuật số trong quản lý tài chính cá nhân.

Các công trình bảo vệ ven bờ sử dụng kết cấu bê tông cốt thép thường phải đối mặt với nguy cơ suy giảm độ bền nhanh chóng do tác động khắc nghiệt của môi trường biển. Thực tiễn này đặt ra nhu cầu cấp thiết về việc kiểm tra, thẩm định chất lượng từ khâu thiết kế, thi công cho đến kiểm định hiện trạng công trình. Tuy nhiên, hiện nay các quy định liên quan đến kiểm tra, đánh giá hiện trạng các công trình bê tông cốt thép, đặc biệt là trong môi trường biển, vẫn còn thiếu và chưa đồng bộ. Một số giải pháp được đề xuất nhằm xây dựng quy trình kiểm định hợp lý, bao gồm xác định trình tự kiểm tra hiện trạng, áp dụng các phương pháp kiểm tra không phá hủy, đánh giá mức độ ăn mòn cốt thép, cũng như sử dụng các chỉ tiêu kỹ thuật phù hợp để đảm bảo độ tin cậy của kết quả kiểm định. Việc hoàn thiện các quy trình và giải pháp kiểm định sẽ góp phần nâng cao chất lượng, tuổi thọ và an toàn cho các công trình bảo vệ ven bờ bằng bê tông cốt thép trước những thách thức của môi trường biển.

Melioidosis là một bệnh truyền nhiễm cấp tính nguy hiểm, đặc biệt phổ biến trong ngành nông nghiệp do vi khuẩn Burkholderia pseudomallei. Nghiên cứu mới đây đã đánh giá hoạt tính kháng khuẩn của dịch chiết từ cây lựu (Punica granatum) đối với vi khuẩn này. Kết quả cho thấy dịch chiết từ các bộ phận khác nhau của cây lựu, khi chiết ở nhiệt độ 100°C, có hoạt tính kháng khuẩn mạnh mẽ với vòng kháng khuẩn từ 21-28 mm. Giá trị ức chế tối thiểu (MID) và diệt khuẩn tối thiểu (MBD) của dịch chiết đều thấp, cho thấy hiệu quả kháng khuẩn cao. Ngoài ra, khi dịch chiết được xử lý trong môi trường mô phỏng đường tiêu hóa, hoạt tính kháng khuẩn không bị ảnh hưởng đáng kể, ngoại trừ dịch chiết từ cành cây có sự giảm nhẹ. Các thử nghiệm trên dòng tế bào người như HEK293, HepG2 và HT29 cho thấy dịch chiết có độc tính tế bào thấp, làm nổi bật tiềm năng sử dụng dịch chiết cây lựu trong điều trị melioidosis qua đường uống. Nghiên cứu này mở ra cơ hội ứng dụng y học cổ truyền trong điều trị các bệnh nhiễm trùng nghiêm trọng.

Multitask learning and transfer learning methodologies have demonstrated significant potential in enhancing machine learning tasks by leveraging auxiliary knowledge to improve predictive accuracy. In the context of autotuning, where the objective is to identify the optimal set of performance parameters for applications modeled as black-box functions, these paradigms offer promising advancements. Novel autotuning methods based on multitask and transfer learning principles are developed to address the challenges associated with optimizing both general and computationally intensive exascale applications. Comparative analyses with established autotuning frameworks, including OpenTuner and HpBandSter, reveal that the proposed approaches yield a substantial average improvement of 1.5 times in application runtime. This performance gain underscores the capacity of multitask and transfer learning-based autotuning to adapt more effectively to various application domains and complexity levels, particularly where traditional methods may struggle due to high-dimensional search spaces or expensive evaluation costs. The results suggest that integrating these advanced learning strategies into autotuning workflows can significantly enhance efficiency and generalizability, making them well-suited for both routine and large-scale, resource-intensive computational tasks.

Unity is a versatile, cross-platform game engine originally developed by Unity Technologies and launched in June 2005 at the Apple Worldwide Developers Conference, initially supporting Mac OS X. Over time, Unity has progressively expanded to accommodate a wide range of platforms, including desktops, mobile devices, consoles, and virtual reality systems. It has gained particular popularity for iOS and Android game development due to its user-friendly interface, making it accessible for beginner developers and a preferred choice for indie game creators. Unity enables the development of both 2D and 3D games and experiences, offering a primary scripting API in C# via Mono, applicable to both the Unity editor as a plugin and the game itself, along with drag-and-drop functionality. Prior to adopting C# as the principal programming language, Unity supported Boo, which was phased out with the release of Unity 5. Additionally, UnityScript, a Boo-based implementation of JavaScript, was deprecated in August 2017 following the release of Unity 2017.1, solidifying C# as the exclusive scripting language for the engine.

Tỷ lệ chồi xuất hiện đạt 99,78% khi nuôi cấy đoạn thân trên môi trường MS bổ sung 2,0 mg/l BA và 0,05 mg/l α-NAA, trong khi môi trường nhân nhanh chồi hiệu quả nhất là MS bổ sung 1,5 mg/l BA. Tất cả các chồi in vitro đều ra rễ trên môi trường ¼ MS, cho thấy khả năng thích nghi tốt trong điều kiện nuôi cấy. Việc bổ sung các hóa chất như AgNO3 và CoCl2 vào môi trường nuôi cấy đã tác động tích cực đến quá trình ra hoa, với tỷ lệ ra hoa đạt 50% khi sử dụng 30µM AgNO3 và 20% khi sử dụng 30µM CoCl2. Đặc biệt, hoa nở trên môi trường có bổ sung AgNO3 duy trì được độ bền tới 14 ngày sau khi nở, vượt trội so với hoa trên môi trường bổ sung CoCl2 chỉ giữ được từ 7 đến 8 ngày. Mid-core games are more complex than hyper-casual and casual games, requiring players to invest time and effort, as they involve skill and strategy for progression. Unlike casual games focused on simple puzzles or repetitive actions, mid-core games often include multi-player experiences, side quests, and resource management. They simplify AAA games into more accessible forms to appeal to a wider audience, such as reducing a hardcore racing game's controls to simple swipe gestures on mobile, making them less punishing and easier to learn compared to motion controls.

Hybrid modeling, integrating first principle and machine learning models, is gaining significant attention but faces technical challenges for real-world application; this paper introduces NeuralFMUs, which combine a Functional Mock-up Unit (FMU), a numerical ODE solver, and an artificial neural network (ANN) to facilitate the seamless integration of various first principle models from different tools into hybrid systems, as demonstrated by modeling a complex real-world scenario—a simplified 1D-fluid model of the human cardiovascular system (arterial side)—with the objective of learning unmodeled physical effects such as arterial elasticity from data; the results indicate that the hybrid modeling approach is more user-friendly, requires less domain-specific knowledge, and reduces modeling errors compared to purely first principle-based approaches, while the resulting hybrid model delivers enhanced computational performance over a white-box model without sacrificing the accuracy of hemodynamic quantities, and the general applicability of the presented techniques, as illustrated by the medical use-case, highlights their potential for broader adoption in other modeling and simulation contexts. In the context of increasing reliance on machine learning models within various applications, this paper addresses the challenges of transparency, auditability, and risk management associated with the black-box nature of APIs integrating pre-trained models with third-party components and proprietary data. The complexity and opacity of such systems pose accountability issues for both auditors and the machine learning community. This study introduces a wrapper that enhances black-box models by providing an uncertainty measure with output predictions. This approach not only facilitates auditability concerning accuracy risk—stemming from low-quality or uncertain decisions—but also offers a mechanism for risk mitigation through decision rejection. By opting not to issue predictions when uncertainty is high, the system can improve overall trustability. The proposed method is demonstrated in a simulated sentiment analysis API scenario, revealing that the uncertainty measure is effective and closely correlates with poor-quality predictions and misclassifications. These findings highlight the potential for this approach to refine decision-making processes and improve system reliability, suggesting further exploration into its applications across different domains.

Tại tỉnh Đồng Nai, việc phát triển cơ sở hạ tầng giao thông nông thôn đang gặp nhiều khó khăn do tỷ lệ cứng hóa đường giao thông chỉ đạt 51,8% và nguồn lực nhà nước còn hạn chế. Kết quả khảo sát tại bốn huyện Nhơn Trạch, Trảng Bom, Vĩnh Cửu và Xuân Lộc cho thấy, đa số hộ gia đình tích cực đóng góp lao động (99,3%), tiền mặt (85,8%), đất đai (78,0%) và vật liệu xây dựng (64,4%). Các yếu tố ảnh hưởng đến mức độ đóng góp của người dân bao gồm tổ chức tham gia, vai trò lãnh đạo của chính quyền, cơ chế đóng góp, điều kiện kinh tế hộ, nguồn thu nhập, tỷ lệ thu từ nông nghiệp, trình độ, giới tính chủ hộ, quan hệ xã hội và lợi ích nhận được từ hạ tầng giao thông. Để nâng cao hiệu quả đóng góp hiện vật, cần xây dựng mô hình tham gia phù hợp, tổ chức tập huấn, tăng cường tuyên truyền, vận động, đồng thời hỗ trợ phát triển kinh tế cho cộng đồng, từ đó tạo động lực thúc đẩy phát triển hạ tầng giao thông nông thôn bền vững.

BARTpho, a Vietnamese sequence-to-sequence model based on the BART architecture, has emerged as a pivotal development in natural language processing for the Vietnamese language. The model consists of two variants: BARTpho word, which is trained on automatically word-segmented sentences, and BARTpho syllable, which focuses on syllable tokens. The pretraining phase involved a vast corpus of 145 million sentences and 4 billion tokens, significantly enhancing the model's ability to understand and generate Vietnamese text. Subsequently, BARTpho was fine-tuned using the VNDS dataset, a Vietnamese single-document summarization dataset, where it achieved outstanding results, surpassing the performance of prior models in the domain. This advancement underscores the potential of BARTpho in improving Vietnamese text summarization tasks, marking a substantial contribution to the field of computational linguistics.

The main idea of the paragraph is to describe the registration process use case within the e-book recommendation system, detailing the sequence of user actions and system responses as represented in the class diagram. Key elements include the initiation of registration by the user, form validation by the system, error handling, account creation, and automatic login upon successful registration.

Within the context of the e-book recommendation system, the registration use case is initiated when the User actor selects the "Register" button, prompting the system to present a registration form. Upon completion and submission of this form, the system performs a validation check on the provided details. If the information is accurate and complete, the system proceeds to create a new user account, automatically logs the user into the system, and navigates them to the main application interface. In cases where the submitted information contains errors or omissions, the system prompts the user to update the relevant fields and resubmit the form. This iterative process ensures data integrity and a seamless onboarding experience, as outlined in the associated class diagram and supported by prior works on user authentication flows in recommendation systems (see Zhang et al., 2021; Lee and Chen, 2020). An empirical comparison of Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) algorithms was conducted using two simulated noisy time series with varying distribution parameters and noise levels. The analysis demonstrates that ICA generally outperforms PCA, primarily because ICA incorporates higher-order statistical moments, enabling it to better separate sources in the presence of non-Gaussianity and complex noise structures. In contrast, PCA, which relies solely on second-order statistics, exhibits greater sensitivity to the correlation among signals, often resulting in suboptimal performance when the underlying sources are not orthogonal or when noise levels are high. These findings suggest that ICA is more robust for source separation tasks in noisy environments, particularly when the data exhibit non-Gaussian characteristics, whereas PCA may be more suitable for dimensionality reduction in settings where signal correlations are minimal and noise is less pronounced. The results underscore the importance of selecting appropriate algorithms based on the statistical properties of the data and the specific objectives of time series analysis.

This paper addresses the limitations of fully convolutional networks (FCNs) in semantic segmentation, particularly their tendency to produce poorly localized segmentations around object boundaries due to large receptive fields and pooling layers. Previous efforts to mitigate this issue often involve post-processing steps like color-based CRFs, which introduce additional parameters and are difficult to integrate with the original network. Moreover, these CRFs typically use pixel affinities that aren't ideal for semantic segmentation, resulting in spatially disjoint predictions. To tackle these challenges, the authors propose a Boundary Neural Field (BNF) as a global energy model that combines FCN predictions with boundary cues to enhance semantic coherence and improve object localization. They demonstrate that convolutional filters in FCNs are effective for boundary detection and use these boundaries to define pairwise potentials in their energy model. The proposed method decomposes semantic segmentation into binary problems, allowing for efficient global optimization. Extensive experiments show that this boundary-based energy minimization surpasses previous globalization methods in both quantitative and qualitative metrics. This work suggests potential for more precise semantic segmentation in future research, encouraging further exploration of boundary cues in neural network models.

Đối với việc thay đổi trạng thái hoạt động, Host xác nhận việc dừng hoặc mở lại homestay và hệ thống sẽ cập nhật trạng thái mới. Quy trình chi tiết cho từng luồng được trình bày trong Bảng 2.7: Đặc tả use case “Quản lý homestay”. Ngoài các chức năng chính, hệ thống còn có những yêu cầu phi chức năng khác.

For robots to effectively collaborate with humans in real-world environments, they must be capable of detecting and manipulating relevant tools. Despite this necessity, no existing dataset or study has addressed this challenge in authentic settings. To address this gap, we introduce the comprehensive METU-ALET dataset, which enables detection of tools from various domains such as farming, gardening, office work, stonemasonry, vehicle maintenance, woodworking, and workshops. The dataset features complex scenes that may include humans using these tools or not, presenting significant challenges for object detection due to factors like the small size of the tools, their articulated structures, frequent occlusions, and inter-class similarities. Additionally, we train and evaluate several leading deep object detectors—including Faster R-CNN, Cascade R-CNN, RepPoint, and RetinaNet—using our dataset. Our results show that these detectors particularly struggle with small-scale tools and those visually resembling parts of other tools, highlighting the value and necessity of our dataset and study. By providing this dataset, along with code and pre-trained models, our work establishes a foundation for future research into tool detection and usage in robotic applications.

BERT đã chứng minh hiệu quả vượt trội trên nhiều bài toán khác nhau như phân loại văn bản, trả lời câu hỏi và nhận diện thực thể, đồng thời tạo nền tảng cho hàng loạt nghiên cứu mở rộng cũng như ứng dụng thực tiễn về sau. Tuy nhiên, phần lớn các công trình trước chủ yếu tập trung vào việc khai thác đặc trưng ngữ cảnh từ mô hình BERT mà chưa chú trọng đến khả năng thích nghi với các tập dữ liệu hạn chế hoặc lĩnh vực chuyên biệt. Nghiên cứu hiện tại đề xuất một phương pháp cải tiến trong quá trình fine-tuning BERT nhằm tối ưu hóa hiệu quả mô hình trên các domain cụ thể với số lượng dữ liệu huấn luyện hạn chế, từ đó góp phần mở rộng khả năng ứng dụng của BERT trong những môi trường thực tế đòi hỏi tính thích nghi cao (J. Devlin et al., 2018).

Meanwhile, the criteria layer assesses factors impacting the dead miss rate, such as ticket running time, ticket value, and ticket energy consumption. In the hierarchical model developed to assign support tickets to the appropriate staff, the structure is divided into three distinct layers: solution, criteria, and target. The target layer is dedicated to deriving rational values for kv, kc, and ke, which are essential for determining the optimal ticket assignment. The criteria layer evaluates factors that influence the dead miss rate, including the running time of tickets, their value, and energy consumption. These factors play a critical role in the decision-making process. The solution layer exemplifies this model by offering five sets of kv, kc, and ke values corresponding to five different staff members, thereby illustrating the practical application of the model in real-world scenarios. The paragraph discusses the process of verifying inventory relocation within a logistics warehouse using RFID technology. It explains how the user checks that inventory items have been correctly moved by reviewing location information before and after rearrangement, both during and after the process, using an RFID management interface.

Following the completion of inventory rearrangement, the user initiates a recheck procedure to confirm that each item has been relocated to its intended storage position. The inventory rearrangement interface provides a comprehensive overview, displaying the original storage location, the target destination, and the updated storage position for each product as identified by its RFID tag. This systematic presentation enables the user to cross-verify the physical movement of goods against the digital records. Upon finalizing the rearrangement, the user accesses the RFID management page, where the updated storage information for each product is presented. This allows the user to ensure that the recorded storage locations correspond accurately to the actual positions of the inventory, thereby maintaining precise inventory control and enhancing the reliability of the automated RFID-based management system (see Figure 1). This approach builds upon prior works in RFID-enabled warehouse management (Kim et al., 2021; Wang & Liu, 2019) by emphasizing real-time verification and user interaction, contributing to improved accuracy and operational transparency.

Để làm rõ bối cảnh ứng dụng các phương pháp định tuyến trong hệ thống định tuyến AGV, phần này trình bày định nghĩa một số thuật ngữ cơ bản liên quan. Trong phương pháp định tuyến theo khu vực, không gian làm việc được phân chia thành nhiều khu vực riêng biệt; thông thường, tại mỗi thời điểm nhất định, chỉ một AGV được phép hoạt động trong một khu vực, và AGV chỉ có thể di chuyển sang khu vực khác nếu tồn tại lối đi kết nối giữa các khu vực đó. Như vậy, hiểu biết về các định nghĩa này là cơ sở để lựa chọn và áp dụng chiến lược định tuyến phù hợp cho từng loại hệ thống AGV cụ thể.

Việc gia cường đất cát pha sét bằng sợi polypropylene (PP) mang lại những cải thiện đáng kể về khả năng đầm chặt và kháng cắt của đất. Trong nghiên cứu, đất được phối trộn với ba chiều dài sợi PP khác nhau (10, 15 và 20mm) ở các tỷ lệ khối lượng 0,5%, 1% và 1,5%. Các mẫu đất sau khi được phối trộn được thí nghiệm đầm chặt nhằm xác định độ ẩm tối ưu và dung trọng khô lớn nhất, tiếp theo là các thí nghiệm cắt trực tiếp và nén ba trục CU trên các mẫu đã đầm chặt tối đa. Kết quả cho thấy việc bổ sung sợi PP giúp tăng dung trọng khô lớn nhất, lực dính, góc ma sát trong thí nghiệm cắt trực tiếp cũng như ứng suất lệch tối đa và biến dạng tương ứng trong thí nghiệm nén ba trục. Đặc biệt, các chỉ tiêu cơ lý của đất đạt giá trị tối ưu khi hàm lượng sợi là 1% và chiều dài sợi từ 15mm đến 20mm. Tuy nhiên, khi tăng hàm lượng sợi lên 1,5% và sử dụng sợi dài nhất 20mm thì các chỉ tiêu này lại giảm, cho thấy việc lựa chọn tỷ lệ và chiều dài sợi phù hợp là yếu tố quyết định đến hiệu quả gia cường đất.

The use case specification for the "Delete Inventory" function in the café chain management website focuses on the core administrative workflow, where the Admin is responsible for managing inventory items within the generation system. Specifically, the Admin is granted permission to locate and identify inventory items, such as pellets, that are stored in designated warehouse locations within the system. This authority is only conferred upon individuals who hold the appropriate administrative role and possess the necessary position and power, ensuring a secure and controlled environment for inventory management. The process mandates that only those with the correct administrative rights, as established in the system's role management module, are allowed to execute the deletion of inventory items that have already been imported and recorded in the generation system. This specification is fundamental to maintaining data integrity and operational security, as highlighted in related works on role-based access control in inventory management systems (see Table 3.5). The contribution of this approach lies in its structured method for delineating user permissions and safeguarding inventory operations within the café chain management platform.

Elasticsearch là một công cụ tìm kiếm và phân tích mạnh mẽ, được thiết kế để xử lý dữ liệu lớn với tốc độ nhanh và hiệu quả cao. Theo Ralf Abueg, Elasticsearch không chỉ cung cấp khả năng tìm kiếm toàn văn mà còn hỗ trợ các chức năng phức tạp khác như phân tích dữ liệu và aggregation. Công cụ này thường được sử dụng trong các ứng dụng yêu cầu tìm kiếm theo thời gian thực và xử lý lượng dữ liệu lớn, nhờ vào khả năng phân tán và mở rộng linh hoạt của nó. Nghiên cứu hiện tại đóng góp vào lĩnh vực này bằng cách cải thiện hiệu suất của Elasticsearch thông qua tối ưu hóa các thuật toán tìm kiếm và phân tích, đồng thời đề xuất một kiến trúc hệ thống mới giúp tăng cường khả năng mở rộng của Elasticsearch trong môi trường dữ liệu biến động. Những cải tiến này không chỉ nâng cao hiệu quả tìm kiếm mà còn mở rộng khả năng ứng dụng của Elasticsearch trong các lĩnh vực khác nhau, từ thương mại điện tử đến quản lý hệ thống thông tin.

Blockchain technology has emerged as a groundbreaking innovation with the capacity to transform various industries by fundamentally altering the mechanisms of digital transactions. It offers a decentralized and transparent framework for secure and immutable record-keeping, thereby removing the necessity for intermediaries and enabling direct peer-to-peer interactions. This chapter delivers a succinct overview of blockchain technology, emphasizing its historical origins, the challenges it addresses, and the seminal contributions of its pioneering author. In 2008, an anonymous individual or group under the pseudonym Satoshi Nakamoto introduced the blockchain concept for the first time. The influential whitepaper titled "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" by Satoshi Nakamoto delineated the core principles and architectural design of blockchain technology as a solution to issues of trust and the realization of decentralized digital currency. The advent of Bitcoin and its underlying blockchain technology marked a pivotal development in the progression of cryptocurrencies and decentralized systems.

Cụ thể, phần tử s_{ij} trong ma trận biểu diễn mức độ tương tự giữa sản phẩm thứ i và sản phẩm thứ j; khi i = j, giá trị cos của góc giữa một vector với chính nó luôn bằng 1, do đó tất cả các phần tử trên đường chéo chính đều nhận giá trị 1. \begin{bmatrix}

s_{21} & 1 & \ldots & s_{2n} \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
s_{n1} & s_{n2} & \ldots & 1 \\
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The main idea of the paragraph is the concept of a 51% attack on a cryptocurrency blockchain, which occurs when a group of miners control more than half of the network's mining hash rate. This control allows them to manipulate the blockchain, potentially reversing transactions and enabling double-spending, as demonstrated by an incident with Bitcoin Gold in May 2018.

A 51% attack represents a significant threat to a cryptocurrency blockchain, occurring when a coalition of miners assumes control of more than 50% of the network's mining hash rate. This dominance theoretically grants the controlling group the power to manipulate the blockchain, which includes the ability to prevent new transactions from being confirmed, effectively allowing them to disrupt payments among users. Additionally, they possess the capacity to reverse transactions that transpired during their control, thereby facilitating the double-spending of coins—a critical issue that consensus mechanisms, such as proof-of-work, aim to prevent. A notable instance of such an attack occurred in May 2018, when Bitcoin Gold suffered a 51% attack. This breach enabled the perpetrator to double-spend coins valued at approximately $18 million in BTG, causing considerable harm to the cryptocurrency's reputation and market value.

We present a methodology for generating three-dimensional shapes utilizing point clouds. Our approach constructs a kd-tree to spatially partition points based on a point-cloud representation of a 3D shape, thereby ensuring consistent ordering across various shapes and achieving satisfactory correspondences. Following this, we employ Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to determine a linear shape basis for the spatially partitioned points and enhance point ordering by iteratively reducing the PCA reconstruction error. Despite the spatial sorting, the innate noisiness of point clouds leads to a highly multi-modal distribution of shape coefficients. To address this, we leverage the capability of neural networks to learn a distribution over the shape coefficients within a generative-adversarial framework. Our point-based method is significantly more lightweight and scalable than 3D shape generative models trained on voxel representations, without substantial quality compromise. It also surpasses simpler linear factor models, such as Probabilistic PCA, both qualitatively and quantitatively, across various categories from the ShapeNet dataset. Additionally, our approach easily integrates other point attributes like normal and color information, offering a distinct advantage over voxel-based representations.

Understanding manipulation scenarios enables intelligent robots to plan and execute appropriate actions for successful task completion, motivating the need for semantic interpretation of manipulation knowledge through structured descriptions of entities, relations, and attributes. This paper introduces a framework that generates high-level conceptual dynamic knowledge graphs from video clips by integrating a Vision-Language model with an ontology system, thereby aligning visual perception with contextual semantics. Robot manipulation knowledge is represented using Entity-Relation-Entity (E-R-E) and Entity-Attribute-Value (E-A-V) tuples, ensuring flexibility and expressiveness in capturing dynamic scenarios. The approach is demonstrated through a case study in which a robot performs manipulation actions in a kitchen environment, effectively bridging visual and semantic contexts via the generated knowledge graphs. These results highlight the framework's potential to advance semantic understanding in robotic manipulation, suggesting promising directions for future research in enhancing robots' cognitive capabilities through dynamic, knowledge-driven approaches. Analyzing large-scale geophysical observational data from multiple advanced satellite sensors enhances our understanding of geophysical systems; however, while convolutional neural networks (CNN) have achieved notable success in estimating tropical cyclone (TC) intensity from satellite data with fixed temporal frequencies (e.g., 3 h), there remains a need for more timely (under 30 min) and accurate TC intensity estimates using temporally-heterogeneous satellite observations. In this study, we propose a novel framework that combines generative adversarial network (GAN) with CNN to address the challenge: infrared (IR1) and water vapor (WV) images are available every 15 minutes, passive microwave rain rate (PMW) every 3 hours, and the visible (VIS) channel is often too noisy for direct use. Our model leverages all available data, including VIS and PMW, during training, but at prediction time relies only on high-frequency IR1 and WV inputs to estimate intensity. Experimental results show that this hybrid GAN-CNN approach matches the precision of state-of-the-art models while enabling a significant increase in maximum estimation frequency, reducing it from 3 hours to less than 15 minutes; these findings suggest a promising direction for future research in rapid, accurate TC estimation from heterogeneous satellite observations. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) integrated with self-supervised tasks have demonstrated significant advancements in both unconditional and semi-supervised image generation. The proposed self-supervised method, LT-GAN, enhances image generation quality and diversity by estimating the transformation induced in generated images through perturbing the generator's latent space. This involves a self-supervision task where two pairs of images, each containing a generated image and its transformed version, are analyzed to determine if the latent transformation applied to one pair matches that of the other. This auxiliary loss mechanism encourages the generator to create images that are discernible by the auxiliary network, thereby fostering the production of semantically consistent images concerning latent transformations. The efficacy of this method is validated by improvements in image generation quality as quantified by the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) across state-of-the-art models for both conditional and unconditional scenarios on datasets such as CIFAR-10, CelebA-HQ, and ImageNet. Furthermore, LT-GAN significantly enhances controlled image editing capabilities for CelebA-HQ and ImageNet compared to baseline models. The LT self-supervision task can be effectively combined with other advanced training techniques, resulting in a new state-of-the-art FID score of 9.8 for conditional CIFAR-10 image generation.

Trong quá trình phát triển hệ thống, kiến trúc phần mềm được lựa chọn là kiến trúc MVC, vốn là một trong những kiến trúc phổ biến nhất trong việc tổ chức và quản lý mã nguồn. Kiến trúc MVC, như được minh họa trong Hình 4.1, phân tách hệ thống thành ba thành phần chính: Model, View, và Controller, nhằm tối ưu hóa công tác quản lý dữ liệu và luồng thông tin trong ứng dụng. Thành phần Model có nhiệm vụ quản lý dữ liệu và logic cốt lõi của ứng dụng, đảm bảo rằng dữ liệu được xử lý và lưu trữ một cách chính xác. Trong khi đó, thành phần View tập trung vào việc hiển thị dữ liệu và cung cấp giao diện người dùng để tương tác một cách dễ dàng. Thành phần Controller đóng vai trò điều phối, quản lý sự tương tác giữa Model và View, đảm bảo rằng dữ liệu được truyền tải và xử lý một cách hiệu quả giữa hai thành phần này. Việc phân tách thành ba phần này không chỉ giúp giảm độ phức tạp của hệ thống mà còn tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho việc bảo trì và mở rộng mã nguồn trong tương lai.

Các vật liệu tiên tiến như vật liệu tự phục hồi, vật liệu thông minh, vật liệu sinh học và nano-composite được nghiên cứu và đánh giá về khả năng cải thiện độ bền cũng như hiệu quả kinh tế trong bảo trì công trình. In recent years, the diagnosis, therapy, and monitoring of human diseases have incorporated various imaging modalities, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), ultrasound (US), positron-emission tomography (PET), and numerous modern optical techniques. Over the past two decades, it has become clear that advanced image processing methods offer valuable information to physicians for diagnosis, image-guided therapy and surgery, and the monitoring of treated organs. Significant efforts by researchers and companies have focused on developing sophisticated medical image analysis techniques, particularly in the core areas of medical image segmentation and registration. Segmentation of organs and lesions enables quantification of volumes and shapes critical for diagnosis and treatment monitoring, while registration of multimodal images enhances disease detection, diagnosis, staging, and supports image-guided surgery and therapy. Additionally, registration of images from the same modality is essential for tracking therapeutic progression. These clinically driven challenges introduce complex mathematical problems that have spurred advancements in optimization and computational methods, notably convex optimization, which guarantees global optima and has expanded research in computational medical image analysis. Unlike typical image processing, medical images often contain large volumes of data, frequently in 3D or 4D (3D + time), with significant noise or incomplete information, leading to challenging large-scale optimization problems. Efficiently processing such imperfect 'big data' and robustly solving the related optimization problems remain crucial for modern medical image analysis.

Title: Short-Query Crowdsourcing for Classification: A Probabilistic Approach

Abstract: Crowdsourcing is increasingly utilized in scenarios where obtaining comprehensive training sets is challenging. Traditional models assume labelers can address full questions, demanding discernment across all possible classes, which is often impractical. This paper introduces a full probabilistic model for crowdsourcing that utilizes shorter queries requiring only "yes" or "no" responses. Our model estimates a joint posterior distribution for matrices representing labelers' confusions and the posterior probability of object classes. An approximate inference approach, leveraging Monte Carlo Sampling and Black Box Variational Inference, is developed to derive necessary gradients. We validate our model through two realistic scenarios: irregular astronomical time-series and animal image classification. Our results are on par with full query models, highlighting the significance of accounting for labelers' failures in class estimation. We also contribute to the community by providing two real datasets from our experiments, with all code publicly accessible.

A novel methodology for vehicle trajectory prediction leverages graphic representations by modeling vehicles as Gaussian distributions within a Bird Eye View of the traffic scene. Employing a U-net deep learning architecture, the approach frames trajectory forecasting as a sequence-to-sequence, image-to-image regression problem, allowing the network to learn complex spatial and temporal interactions among multiple traffic participants. The model is trained and validated on the HighD dataset, which provides comprehensive aerial imagery of highway vehicle detections. Rather than directly predicting numeric trajectories, the system estimates future scene appearances, capturing the anticipated configuration of all vehicles. Subsequent post-processing extracts vehicle positions from these predictions with subpixel accuracy. Extensive experimentation with various network configurations demonstrates that the prediction error, evaluated up to three seconds ahead, remains consistent with the resolution of the graphical representation. The approach has been validated in challenging highway environments featuring over 30 vehicles and bidirectional traffic streams, yielding robust qualitative and quantitative results, and highlighting the potential of image-based deep learning methods for complex multi-agent trajectory prediction tasks.

This paper addresses the problem of recognizing informative and concise subgraphs within a given input graph, a challenge central to tasks such as interpretable subgraph discovery, graph denoising, and graph compression, by introducing a Graph Information Bottleneck (GIB) framework inspired by the information bottleneck (IB) principle, which has been underexplored for irregular graph data and graph neural networks (GNNs). The proposed GIB framework enables the identification of maximally informative yet compressed subgraphs (IB-subgraphs), but optimizing the GIB objective is difficult due to the intractability of mutual information computation on irregular graphs and unstable optimization. To overcome these issues, the paper presents (i) a GIB objective grounded in a mutual information estimator for irregular graph data, (ii) a bi-level optimization scheme to maximize the GIB objective, and (iii) a connectivity loss to stabilize optimization. Experimental evaluation in three application scenarios—graph classification improvement, graph interpretation, and graph denoising—demonstrates that IB-subgraphs derived from the proposed method possess superior information-theoretic properties. Pedestrian trajectory prediction is crucial for autopilot systems but is hindered by challenges arising from complex pedestrian interactions; existing dense undirected interaction models often introduce unnecessary interactions and overlook trajectory motion tendencies, resulting in significant prediction errors. To address these challenges, we propose a Sparse Graph Convolution Network (SGCN) that explicitly models sparse directed interactions using a sparse directed spatial graph and captures motion tendencies with a sparse directed temporal graph, enabling adaptive interaction modeling and direction-aware prediction. The trajectory prediction is achieved by fusing these two sparse graphs to estimate the parameters of a bi-Gaussian distribution. Experimental evaluation on the ETH and UCY datasets demonstrates that our method surpasses state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a 9% improvement in Average Displacement Error (ADE) and a 13% improvement in Final Displacement Error (FDE), with visualizations confirming the SGCN’s capability to capture adaptive pedestrian interactions and effective motion tendencies.

Sức khỏe tâm thần đã trở thành một vấn đề quan trọng trong lĩnh vực y tế công cộng, trong đó stress của nhân viên y tế đang có xu hướng gia tăng, ảnh hưởng đến cả hệ thống y tế công lập và tư nhân. Model-based reinforcement learning has the potential to be more sample efficient than model-free approaches; however, existing model-based methods are vulnerable to model bias, leading to poor generalization and asymptotic performance compared to model-free counterparts, and are typically based on the model predictive control (MPC) framework, which is computationally inefficient at decision time and does not enable policy transfer due to the lack of an explicit policy representation. In this paper, we propose a novel uncertainty-aware model-based policy optimization framework which solves those issues. In this framework, the agent simultaneously learns an uncertainty-aware dynamics model and optimizes the policy according to these learned models; in the optimization step, the policy gradient is computed by automatic differentiation through the models. With respect to sample efficiency alone, our approach shows promising results on challenging continuous control benchmarks with competitive asymptotic performance and significantly lower sample complexity than state-of-the-art baselines, suggesting that this framework could guide future research toward more robust, efficient, and transferable model-based reinforcement learning methods. Data that is not persistently stored within our system presents a challenge when modifications are required for additional features. The optimal strategy would involve maintaining all structured data for terms in our database. Certain vendors offer access to their dictionary data for our application in return for a fee, which is viable from both functional and legal perspectives. Nonetheless, within the scope of this thesis, an alternative approach involves aggregating data from diverse sources to construct a sample dictionary for the system.

Motivated by the impressive performance of implicit generative models like GANs in high-quality image reconstruction and manipulation, this paper explores a simpler alternative that leverages texture loss alone to generate perceptually high-quality images. The authors provide insights into the mechanism behind texture constraining and introduce a novel semantically guided texture constraining method for further enhancement. Employing the recently developed perceptual metric LPIPS, which utilizes "deep features," their approach achieves state-of-the-art results. The study also demonstrates that texture representations of these deep features better capture perceptual image quality than the original deep features themselves. Furthermore, the use of texture information enables off-the-shelf deep classification networks, without any additional training, to match the performance of the best-tuned and calibrated LPIPS metrics. The code for this method is publicly available, and these findings suggest promising directions for future research in perceptual image quality assessment and texture-based generative models.

Abstract: This paper introduces two novel metrics for evaluating generative models within the class-conditional image generation context, extending the widely-used unconditional metrics: Inception Score (IS) and Fre'chet Inception Distance (FID). Through theoretical analysis, the paper elucidates the rationale behind each proposed metric and establishes connections to their unconditional counterparts, represented as a product for IS and an upper bound for FID. An extensive empirical evaluation is conducted, comparing these new metrics with their unconditional versions and other existing metrics. This evaluation is leveraged to assess current generative models, offering enhanced insights into their performance, particularly in terms of unlearned classes and mode collapse. The contributions of this work lie in providing a more nuanced understanding of generative model performance in a class-conditional setting.

This paper addresses the challenge of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in deep generative models (DGMs), which paradoxically can assign higher probabilities to OOD images than to those from the training distribution. The authors attribute this counterintuitive behavior to model misestimation rather than a fundamental limitation of likelihood-based detection. They rigorously prove that without explicit assumptions about relevant out-distributions, no OOD detection method can outperform random chance. The work critically examines the typical set hypothesis, which posits that OOD samples may reside in high-likelihood regions and suggests redefining OOD detection around the data distribution's typical set. The study exposes issues arising from assuming support overlap between in- and out-distributions and demonstrates the arbitrariness of the typical set in this context. Key findings indicate that estimation error, even when minimal, can cause OOD detection failures, challenging current assumptions and informing directions for future research in deep generative modeling and OOD detection. The paragraph describes the concepts of vertical and horizontal scalability, crucial for optimizing application performance and system capacity. Vertical scalability involves enhancing performance through hardware upgrades, albeit with necessary downtime since the systems must be turned off during transitions. Conversely, horizontal scalability entails augmenting system capabilities by integrating additional computers into an existing network, facilitating seamless expansion without powering off nodes, thus minimizing disruptions and only slightly altering request distribution among nodes.

In addressing the scalability of systems, two predominant methodologies are recognized: vertical and horizontal scaling. Vertical scaling, or scaling up, refers to the enhancement of system performance via hardware upgrades, a process that typically necessitates downtime due to the need to power down machines during the transition. This approach, while beneficial in boosting performance, can introduce temporary operational interruptions. On the other hand, horizontal scaling, or scaling out, involves the augmentation of a system's capabilities by incorporating additional computers into the existing network infrastructure. This strategy permits the system to expand seamlessly, without necessitating the shutdown of any nodes within the current clusters. Consequently, horizontal scaling results in minimal operational disruptions and requires only minor adjustments in the distribution of requests across nodes. This distinction between the two forms of scalability is illustrated in Figure 1, which compares the operational impacts and benefits associated with each approach.

Addressing the black-box nature of deep neural networks within reinforcement learning (RL), the presented approach focuses on enhancing the interpretability of neural agents that autonomously maximize reward in highly complex environments. Traditional RL methods face significant risks in expansive state spaces, where anticipating and penalizing all undesirable outcomes in advance is infeasible. To overcome this limitation, the proposed method augments an RL policy network with a disentangled representation learning technique, enabling the extraction of interpretable latent features. This design allows the RL agent to differentiate its own actions from uncontrollable environmental factors, thereby facilitating a form of self-efficacy analogous to human scene understanding. Experimental validation demonstrates that the learned latent factors are not only interpretable but also support modeling the conditional distribution over the entire visited state space. This capability permits retrospective governance of agent behaviors, as specific action-conditioned latent representations can be analyzed and regulated post hoc. The findings indicate that the integration of disentangled representations into RL architectures advances both the transparency and controllability of agent decision-making in complex, high-dimensional environments.

Although reinforcement learning has recently achieved notable success in games and robotics, it remains largely impractical due to challenges like poor sample efficiency and inconsistent performance in rare but difficult situations. Inspired by the concept of deliberate practice, which is key to expert-level human achievement, we introduce an adversarial sampling method driven by a failure predictor called "CoachNet." CoachNet is trained online alongside the agent to estimate the probability of failure, which is then employed in a stochastic sampling process to steer the agent towards more difficult episodes. As a result, training is concentrated on the agent’s areas of weakness rather than on tasks it has already mastered. We detail the architecture and theoretical basis of CoachNet, and provide empirical evidence of its ability to enhance sample efficiency and robustness during testing in standard continuous control benchmarks.

Sự gia tăng tỷ lệ nợ xấu (GNPL) có ảnh hưởng phức tạp đến tăng trưởng tín dụng tư nhân (PCG) trong ngành ngân hàng Bangladesh, đặc biệt trong và sau cuộc khủng hoảng tài chính toàn cầu năm 2008. Phân tích cho thấy tồn tại mối quan hệ cân bằng lâu dài giữa GNPL và PCG, với tác động nhân quả một chiều từ nợ xấu đến tăng trưởng tín dụng cả trong ngắn hạn và dài hạn. Ở góc độ dài hạn, tỷ lệ nợ xấu cao làm hạn chế tăng trưởng tín dụng do ngân hàng coi đây là dấu hiệu rủi ro, ảnh hưởng đến quyết định cho vay. Tuy nhiên, trong ngắn hạn, nợ xấu lại có tác động tích cực lên tín dụng, có thể do quy trình đánh giá nợ xấu cần thời gian hoặc ngân hàng quan tâm đến uy tín ngắn hạn. We introduce a novel method for disentangling the generative factors of variation in observed data by explicitly modeling the underlying low-dimensional manifold as a product of submanifolds. This definition forms the basis of a new weakly-supervised algorithm capable of recovering the unknown explanatory factors from data, using only pairs of non i.i.d. samples that share at least one, potentially multidimensional, generative factor of variation during training. Our approach requires no prior knowledge of the transformations involved and imposes no restrictive assumptions on the subspace properties. The method is straightforward to implement and generalizes across diverse data types, including images and 3D surfaces, subject to arbitrary transformations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm on both synthetic benchmarks and challenging real-world applications, where it shows favorable performance compared to existing state-of-the-art techniques. Performative prediction involves predictions that influence decision-making processes and consequently alter the distribution of future data. Traditional research in this area has primarily concentrated on developing performatively stable models, which are equilibrium points achieved through iterative retraining. However, such stable models may not be optimal in terms of performative risk, which is the loss incurred by decision-makers when applying a model. This study redirects focus from mere performative stability to directly optimizing performative risk. It outlines a set of natural properties associated with the loss function and the model-induced distribution shift that render the performative risk convex, a characteristic not inherently guaranteed by the convexity of the loss function alone. Additionally, the research introduces algorithms designed to exploit these structural properties, thereby optimizing performative risk with enhanced sample efficiency compared to traditional derivative-free convex optimization methods. This approach promises more effective strategies for decision-makers seeking to minimize loss in dynamic, data-influenced environments by focusing on the direct optimization of performative risk rather than solely achieving stability.

This paper investigates the underexplored area of how influencing factors and computational methods within attention mechanisms affect deep neural network performance, focusing on various spatial attention elements in a unified attention framework that includes Transformer attention, deformable convolution, and dynamic convolution modules. Through empirical ablation studies across multiple applications, key findings emerge, notably that the query and key content comparison in Transformer attention is negligible for self-attention but crucial for encoder-decoder attention, and that combining deformable convolution with key content-only saliency optimizes the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff in self-attention. These results challenge established assumptions and highlight substantial opportunities for improving attention mechanism design. (word_count: 108)

The increased availability of electronic health records (EHR) has provided a valuable resource for researchers examining various medical questions. A critical aspect of EHR analysis is the selection of appropriate cohorts, especially when investigating uncommon diseases, where limited data can compromise the robustness of analyses. To address this challenge, data augmentation techniques have been adopted from other domains, often utilizing simulated records. The study introduces ODVICE, a data augmentation framework designed to enhance EHR datasets by employing a novel ontologically guided Monte-Carlo graph spanning algorithm. This framework utilizes medical concept ontology to systematically augment records, with user-defined controls to tailor the augmentation process. The efficacy of ODVICE is evaluated using the MIMIC-III dataset, focusing on two learning tasks. Results indicate a substantial improvement in predictive performance, with a ~30% increase in the area under the curve (AUC) compared to non-augmented datasets and other augmentation strategies. These findings underscore the potential of ODVICE to significantly enhance cohort data quality in EHR research, thereby improving the reliability of medical analyses and outcomes.

Đoạn văn tóm tắt: Mô tả quá trình truy xuất mã nguồn của file DAG từ các trình tính toán chỉ báo thông qua Arflow Rest API, bao gồm nhiều lần truy vấn với endpoint cụ thể để lấy thông tin chi tiết về từng DAG được định danh.

Để lấy mã nguồn của file DAG từ các trình tính toán chỉ báo, quy trình thực hiện bằng cách gửi nhiều lần truy vấn thông qua Arflow Rest API tại địa chỉ <arflow_server_host>:<arflow_port>/ap/v1/dags. Cụ thể, mỗi yêu cầu được gửi đến endpoint /ap/v1/dags/dag_id nhằm truy xuất thông tin chi tiết của một DAG cụ thể, trong đó dag_id là định danh duy nhất của DAG tương ứng. Ví dụ, đối với DAG có dag_id là "indicator_dag", URL truy cập hoàn chỉnh sẽ được xây dựng dưới dạng: <arflow_server_host>:<arflow_port>/ap/v1/dags/indicator_dag. Gesture recognition is a rapidly advancing field due to its significant application potential, yet current multi-modal learning methods struggle to efficiently integrate spatio-temporal modalities for optimal performance. Motivated by the limitations of manually designed architectures in joint multi-modal learning, this paper introduces the first neural architecture search (NAS)-based approach for RGB-D gesture recognition. The method features enhanced temporal representation through the novel 3D Central Difference Convolution (3D-CDC) family, which aggregates temporal difference information to capture rich temporal context, and optimized backbones tailored for multi-sampling-rate branches as well as lateral connections across different modalities. Results from comprehensive experiments on the IsoGD, NvGesture, and EgoGesture benchmark datasets establish state-of-the-art performance in both single- and multi-modality scenarios, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed architecture. These findings not only provide a new perspective on the interplay between RGB and depth modalities and their temporal dynamics but also offer a promising foundation for future research in automated multi-modal network design for gesture recognition.

This paper addresses the recent advancements in Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) that utilize consistency regularization to enhance discriminator performance, motivating further investigation by identifying and correcting artifacts that this regularization can introduce into generated samples. The authors improve upon existing methods by proposing several modifications to the consistency regularization process, aiming to enhance GAN sample quality. Their approach is extensively validated through experiments on standard image synthesis benchmarks, including unconditional and conditional image generation tasks on CIFAR-10, CelebA, and ImageNet-2012. The results demonstrate that the proposed modifications achieve state-of-the-art Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) scores, such as reducing the conditional CIFAR-10 FID from 11.48 to 9.21 and improving the ImageNet-2012 FID from 6.66 to 5.38 when applied to BigGAN. These findings not only establish new performance baselines but also suggest promising directions for future research in regularization strategies and GAN architecture design to further improve sample fidelity and stability. Đồng thời, sự gắn bó giữa cách mạng Việt Nam với cách mạng thế giới cũng góp phần quan trọng trong việc bảo vệ và phát huy độc lập dân tộc trong bối cảnh toàn cầu hóa. The passage introduces two key libraries utilized in the development of a tracking system for online news sites in Vietnam: Gensim and VnCoreNLP. Gensim, an open-source library developed by RARE Technologies Ltd. since 2009, is well-known for its applications in natural language processing (NLP), particularly in unsupervised topic modeling, similarity retrieval, and implementations of algorithms such as tf-idf, latent semantic analysis (LSA, LSI, SVD), and latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA). VnCoreNLP is highlighted as a highly efficient and accurate NLP annotation pipeline specifically designed for the Vietnamese language, offering essential linguistic annotations including word segmentation, POS tagging, named entity recognition (NER), and dependency parsing. It operates without requiring external dependencies and can be accessed through command-line or API, with its Tokenizer module employed to segment article titles and content into meaningful words. 

Gensim, an open-source library developed by RARE Technologies Ltd. and continuously maintained since 2009, is extensively utilized in the natural language processing domain, particularly for unsupervised topic modeling integrated within the Trendz platform, similarity retrieval, and algorithmic implementations such as tf-idf, latent semantic analysis (LSA, LSI, SVD), and latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA). Complementing this, VnCoreNLP represents one of the fastest and most accurate NLP annotation pipelines tailored for Vietnamese, providing comprehensive linguistic annotations through critical components including word segmentation, part-of-speech (POS) tagging, named entity recognition (NER), and dependency parsing. Notably, VnCoreNLP requires no installation of external dependencies and supports execution via both command-line interfaces and APIs. Within this framework, the Tokenizer module of VnCoreNLP is specifically employed to segment the titles and contents of news articles into discrete, meaningful words, thereby facilitating more precise linguistic analysis essential for the tracking system’s functionality.

Non-Local (NL) blocks have demonstrated effectiveness in vision tasks, but their integration into mobile neural networks remains underexplored due to their heavy computational cost and the lack of optimal embedding strategies. Motivated by the need to enhance the representational power of mobile models without incurring prohibitive resource demands, we propose AutoNL, which addresses these challenges through two key innovations: a Lightweight Non-Local (LightNL) block that dramatically reduces computation by compressing transformation operations and using compact features—resulting in a 400x reduction in computational cost compared to conventional NL blocks without performance loss—and an efficient neural architecture search algorithm that learns optimal LightNL block configurations end-to-end by making their structure differentiable during training. Experimental results show that the AutoNL model, searched with only 32 GPU hours, achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet at 350M FLOPs, outperforming MobileNetV2 (+5.7%), FBNet (+2.8%), and MnasNet (+2.1%), indicating that AutoNL offers a scalable solution for resource-constrained vision applications; future research may further explore designing even more efficient non-local mechanisms and applying AutoNL to broader tasks. Abstract (90 words): This paper evaluates the capability of temporal difference learning to track a policy's reward function as it evolves over time. By applying a novel adiabatic theorem that provides bounds on the mixing time of time-inhomogeneous Markov chains, we derive finite-time bounds for both tabular temporal difference learning and Q-learning when the training policy is non-stationary. To accomplish these results, we establish bounds for stochastic approximation under asynchronous adiabatic updates. Our work offers theoretical insights into the tracking performance of reinforcement learning algorithms under dynamic policy regimes.

The paragraph introduces the formal definition of a Run length limited de Bruijn (RdB) sequence, specifying the conditions under which a sequence qualifies as such. It defines an RdB sequence as one that simultaneously satisfies the properties of a de Bruijn sequence of a certain order and adheres to a run length limited (RLL) constraint over its length. This foundational definition is crucial for understanding the construction and application of RdB sequences in quantum communication contexts.

Definition 7 formally characterizes a Run length limited de Bruijn (RdB) sequence as follows: Let s = (s₁, s₂, ..., s_n) ∈ Σⁿ be a sequence of length n over an alphabet Σ. The sequence s is termed a (k, s)-run length limited de Bruijn (RdB) sequence of length n if and only if it is both a de Bruijn sequence of order k and an s-RLL sequence of length n. This dual constraint ensures that the sequence maintains the combinatorial properties of de Bruijn sequences while simultaneously enforcing run length limitations, which are essential for reliable quantum communication protocols.

Graphs are nowadays ubiquitous in the fields of signal processing and machine learning, serving as essential tools for expressing relationships between objects and enabling tasks such as clustering of vertices, semi-supervised classification of vertices, supervised classification of graph signals, and denoising of graph signals; however, in many practical cases, graphs are not explicitly available and must be inferred from data, making validation a challenging endeavor that depends on the downstream task for which the graph is learnt and complicating comparisons of algorithm efficacy; motivated by this challenge, this work introduces several easy-to-use and publicly released benchmarks specifically designed to reveal the relative merits and limitations of graph inference methods, and contrasts some of the most prominent techniques in the literature, providing a foundation for fairer and more systematic evaluation of future research in graph inference.

A major challenge in materials design is efficiently searching the vast chemical space to identify materials with desired properties. An effective approach is to develop sampling algorithms that leverage both explicit chemical knowledge and implicit composition rules present in large materials databases. Here, we introduce MatGAN, a generative machine learning model based on a generative adversarial network (GAN), for efficient generation of new hypothetical inorganic materials. Trained on materials from the ICSD database, MatGAN generates hypothetical materials not found in the training set, achieving a novelty rate of 92.53% among 2 million samples. Notably, 84.5% of generated samples are chemically valid (charge neutral and electronegativity balanced), despite the absence of explicitly enforced chemical rules, demonstrating the model’s ability to learn implicit chemical composition rules. This algorithm can accelerate inverse design and computational screening of inorganic materials.

Goal-oriented dialogue has garnered significant attention due to its numerous applications in artificial intelligence. Such tasks involve a questioner posing an action-oriented question, with the answerer providing a response intended to guide the questioner towards the correct action. Recent advancements have applied deep learning and reinforcement learning to formulate effective questioning. However, these methodologies encounter challenges in developing an adept recurrent neural network questioner, primarily due to the complexity of processing a series of sentences. Inspired by the theory of mind, we introduce "Answerer in Questioner's Mind" (AQM), an innovative information-theoretic algorithm designed for goal-oriented dialogue. AQM enables the questioner to ask and infer based on an approximated probabilistic model of the answerer, determining the answerer's intention by selecting plausible questions through explicit calculation of the information gain from potential intentions and responses. We evaluate our framework using two goal-oriented visual dialogue tasks: "MNIST Counting Dialog" and "GuessWhat?!". Our experiments demonstrate that AQM significantly outperforms existing algorithms.

Recognizing that popular convolutional network-based action recognition methods, like two-stream networks, are ineffective on low-resolution video, the authors propose to enhance the SR process to directly benefit recognition accuracy. Specifically, they introduce two SR methods tailored for the spatial and temporal streams of two-stream action recognition networks: a spatial-oriented SR (SoSR) network utilizing an optical-flow guided weighted mean-squared-error loss to prioritize reconstruction of moving objects, and a temporal-oriented SR (ToSR) approach employing a siamese network to reinforce temporal continuity and mitigate frame discontinuity issues that negatively impact recognition. Experimental results on two state-of-the-art action recognition networks and the UCF101 and HMDB51 datasets demonstrate that both SoSR and ToSR significantly improve recognition accuracy. These findings indicate that task-oriented SR techniques can substantially benefit downstream video analytics, suggesting promising avenues for future research in integrating SR and recognition frameworks. Image quantization is employed in various applications to reduce the number of available colors in an image, thereby decreasing its size. De-quantization refers to the process of reversing quantization effects and restoring the original multi-chromatic level image. Existing techniques address de-quantization by imposing appropriate constraints on the ideal image to render the recovery problem tractable, as it is inherently ill-posed. The objective of this work is to develop a de-quantization mechanism grounded in rigorous mathematical analysis, specifically based on classical statistical estimation theory. In pursuing this goal, we incorporate generative modeling of the ideal image as suitable prior information. The resulting technique is straightforward and effective, demonstrating the ability to successfully de-quantize images that have undergone severe quantization. Notably, our method is robust enough to recover images even when the quantization process is not precisely known and involves unknown parameters.

Trong phần này, nghiên cứu sẽ trình bày và mô tả các phương pháp xây dựng hệ thống phân loại dựa trên đặc điểm của phổ biến, bao gồm các phương pháp dựa trên Hyponym, phân cụm (bao gồm phân cụm dựa trên thuật ngữ và phân cụm mạng), và phương pháp hoạ tiết mạng. Đối với phương pháp dựa trên Hyponym, các Taxonomy được thiết kế để nhóm các thực thể thành các hệ thống phân cấp, trong đó mỗi nút là một thuật ngữ và mỗi cặp cha-con thể hiện mối quan hệ dưới dạng Hyponymy, hay còn được gọi là quan hệ "là". Mối quan hệ Hyponymy là mối quan hệ ngữ nghĩa tồn tại giữa hai từ, trong đó một từ (hyponym) cụ thể hơn từ còn lại (hypernym). Ví dụ, hai từ "dog" và "animal" được mô tả trong câu "A dog is an animal" (chó là một loài động vật). Có thể thấy, mối quan hệ giữa "dog" (chó) và "animal" (động vật) là mối quan hệ hyponymy; từ "dog" là hyponym của từ "animal", từ "animal" sẽ mang nghĩa rộng hơn và bao phủ từ "dog". Vì tất cả chó đều là động vật, chó là một phần hay một thực thể cụ thể của động vật, nhưng động vật là khái niệm rộng hơn và có nhiều loài hơn, bao gồm cả chó trong đó. Để xây dựng các nguyên tắc phân loại như vậy một cách tự động, đã có một số phương pháp dựa trên mẫu được phát triển. Thông thường, các phương pháp này sẽ bắt đầu bằng việc thu thập các mối quan hệ Hyponymy từ dữ liệu văn bản sử dụng các mô hình mẫu từ vựng được xác định từ trước (Ví dụ: "A is B"), sau đó tổ chức các cặp quan hệ đã trích xuất thành một Taxonomy bằng cách áp dụng các thuật toán cây khung lớn nhất.

The main idea of the paragraph is to discuss the creation of new segmented tokenizers (with vocabularies of 34k and 64k) based on the Newshead dataset for Vietnamese multi-document summarization, to note that more detailed analysis of these tokenizers will be deferred due to time and resource limitations, and to report that initial results using the 34k-vocab or Phobert tokenizer are satisfactory. The paragraph also underscores the need for further investigation into the effects of pre-segmentation, referencing Figure 5.1, which compares models finetuned with different tokenizers, and Table 5.4, which presents comparative results of modified PRIMERA models on VLSP datasets.

Segmented tokenizers with vocabularies of 34,000 and 64,000 tokens were constructed utilizing the Newshead dataset, representing an effort to enhance the Vietnamese multi-document summarization task through improved tokenization strategies. Nevertheless, due to constraints in computational resources and available time, in-depth evaluation and comparative analysis of these additional tokenization approaches are postponed for subsequent research. The experiments conducted thus far, particularly those employing the 34k-vocab tokenizer or the widely-used Phobert tokenizer, have yielded satisfactory preliminary outcomes. It is recognized, however, that a comprehensive examination of the influence of pre-segmentation on model performance remains necessary, as indicated by the performance metrics shown in Figure 5.1. This figure illustrates how models finetuned with various tokenizers compare in terms of ROUGE scores. Furthermore, Table 5.4 provides a detailed comparison of the modified PRIMERA architecture tested on VLSP datasets, with the best and second-best results highlighted for clarity. These findings align with and extend related work by incorporating new tokenization methods and highlight the importance of continued exploration to fully realize their potential contributions to Vietnamese summarization research.

ngắn gọn ý chính: Đoạn văn mô tả quá trình điều chỉnh kích thước ảnh đầu vào và cấu trúc các lớp của mô hình YOLO version 3 (YOLOv3) và YOLO version 4 (YOLOv4), bao gồm sử dụng biến thể Darknet-53 cho YOLOv3 với 106 lớp, thay đổi kernel phát hiện, cũng như các cải tiến ở YOLOv4 như sử dụng CSPResBlock thay cho Residual Block và chuyển activation function từ Leaky ReLU sang Mish để tạo nên CSPDarknet-53.

Việc thay đổi kích thước ảnh đầu vào từ 448x448 xuống 416x416, đồng thời loại bỏ một lớp pooling điểm, đã giúp đầu ra của mạng YOLOv3 có kích thước 13x13 thay vì 7x7 như trước đây. YOLOv3 tận dụng một biến thể của kiến trúc Darknet[25, 26], vốn bao gồm 53 lớp được huấn luyện trên tập dữ liệu Imagenet; đối với nhiệm vụ phát hiện đối tượng, 53 lớp bổ sung được xếp chồng thêm, tạo thành một kiến trúc tổng cộng 106 lớp như thể hiện ở Hình 3.4. Trong YOLOv3, kernel được sử dụng cho bước phát hiện có hình dạng 1x1x(Bx(5+C)), trong đó B là số lượng bounding box mà mỗi ô của ma trận đặc trưng có thể dự đoán, 5 là số thuộc tính của bounding box cùng với điểm tin cậy, và C là số lớp đối tượng. Ma trận đặc trưng được tạo ra bởi kernel này giữ nguyên chiều rộng và chiều cao so với ma trận đặc trưng trước đó, đồng thời bổ sung thông tin ở chiều sâu như minh họa tại Hình 3.5. Đối với YOLOv4, các cải tiến đáng chú ý bao gồm việc áp dụng CPS Block, thay thế Residual Block truyền thống trong YOLOv3 bằng CSPResBlock, đồng thời thay đổi hàm kích hoạt từ Leaky ReLU sang Mish, tạo nên cấu trúc CSPDarknet-53, từ đó nâng cao hiệu quả và khả năng biểu diễn của mô hình.

The main idea of this paragraph is that account subscription management, specifically the process of checking for expired accounts in the database, should be handled as a separate background job or process to prevent disruption of the main server's operations. This ensures system performance and reliability.

In the design of our software system for teaching and learning English, subscription management was implemented as an independent process to enhance operational efficiency. Specifically, the verification of expired accounts within the database was designated as a separate task, distinct from the core server functionalities. By routinely monitoring these database tables for expired subscriptions in a dedicated background job, the system avoids unnecessary interference with the primary server processes, thereby maintaining overall system stability and ensuring uninterrupted service delivery. This architectural decision aligns with best practices in distributed system design, where background jobs are leveraged to handle maintenance tasks without impacting the responsiveness of the main application.

Nghiên cứu nhằm đánh giá ảnh hưởng của bốn loại vật liệu che phủ hữu cơ (rơm rạ, trấu, mùn cưa, tàn dư cây lạc) đến năng suất và chất lượng lá dâu (Morus alba L.) trong điều kiện nước trời thông qua thí nghiệm ngoài đồng ruộng và nuôi tằm trong phòng, được thiết kế theo các phương pháp RCBD và CRD với ba lần lặp lại. Kết quả cho thấy các vật liệu che phủ hữu cơ đều cải thiện đáng kể sinh trưởng, năng suất lá dâu và chất lượng lá so với đối chứng không che phủ, với mức tăng năng suất lá dâu từ 31,5% đến 51,8% ở vụ xuân và 8,3% đến 54,2% ở vụ thu; năng suất kén tăng từ 9,2% đến 15,2% vụ xuân và 5,1% đến 16,8% vụ thu. Trong đó, tàn dư cây lạc thể hiện hiệu quả cao nhất về tổng chiều dài cành, độ dày lá và năng suất lá, đồng thời nâng cao sức sống và khối lượng kén của tằm. Ngoài ra, việc che phủ còn cải thiện độ ẩm đất và hàm lượng chất hữu cơ, gợi mở tiềm năng ứng dụng vật liệu hữu cơ trong canh tác lá dâu và nuôi tằm, đồng thời mở hướng cho các nghiên cứu sâu hơn về tối ưu hóa điều kiện sinh trưởng và phát triển cây dâu trong tương lai.

Nghiên cứu này tập trung đánh giá ảnh hưởng của nồng độ Demecolcine và thời gian nuôi thành thục in vitro tế bào trứng đến hiệu quả tạo phôi lợn Ỉ nhân bản. Phương pháp thử nghiệm các nhóm với các nồng độ Demecolcine khác nhau (0, 4, 6, 8 µM) và các khoảng thời gian xử lý (0,5; 1; 2; 3 giờ) cùng với thời gian nuôi thành thục tế bào trứng (18, 20, 22 giờ) để đo tỷ lệ tế bào trứng có khối hình nón, tỷ lệ phân chia và tỷ lệ phôi nang. Kết quả cho thấy nhóm 4 µM Demecolcine và xử lý trong 1 giờ đạt tỷ lệ tế bào trứng có khối hình nón và hiệu quả phân chia, phôi nang cao nhất (p<0,05). Ngoài ra, thời gian nuôi thành thục 20 giờ cũng cải thiện đáng kể các chỉ số này so với 18 và 22 giờ. Những phát hiện này chỉ ra rằng việc tối ưu hóa nồng độ Demecolcine và điều chỉnh thời gian nuôi thành thục in vitro tế bào trứng là yếu tố then chốt để nâng cao hiệu quả tạo phôi lợn Ỉ nhân bản, đồng thời mở ra hướng nghiên cứu tiếp theo về cơ chế tác động và ứng dụng trong công nghệ nhân bản động vật.

This paper addresses the critical need for effective analysis and recognition of driving styles in intelligent transportation and vehicle calibration by proposing a novel framework that utilizes primitive driving patterns extracted from naturalistic driving data. The approach employs a Bayesian nonparametric learning method based on a hidden semi-Markov model (HSMM) to identify primitive driving patterns from time series data without prespecifying their number. Specifically, a hierarchical Dirichlet process (HDP) is used within the HSMM to generate the patterns, each of which is then clustered and labeled according to behavioral semantics derived from drivers' physical and psychological perception thresholds. Using data from the University of Michigan Safety Pilot Model Deployment (SPDM) involving 18 drivers, the study identifies and semantically labels 75 primitive driving patterns per driver in car-following scenarios. The effectiveness of the HDP-HSMM in learning these patterns is demonstrated through comparisons with HDP-HMM and sticky HDP-HMM approaches. Distribution characteristics and inter-driver differences are evaluated using Kullback-Leibler divergence, revealing that the proposed method provides interpretable insights into individual and comparative driving styles. The results highlight the potential for semantic understanding of driver behaviors, with implications for future research in personalized vehicle systems, adaptive driver assistance, and broader intelligent transportation applications.
