Nghiên cứu này nhằm xác định tỷ lệ hiện mắc và đặc điểm lâm sàng của bệnh gan nhiễm mỡ liên quan chuyển hóa (MAFLD) ở nhóm bệnh nhân thừa cân, béo phì, xuất phát từ thực tế tỷ lệ béo phì ngày càng tăng tại Việt Nam và hạn chế của các nghiên cứu trước khi chỉ sử dụng định nghĩa cũ loại trừ các bệnh gan đồng mắc. Phương pháp nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang được áp dụng trên 192 bệnh nhân thừa cân, béo phì từ 18 tuổi trở lên khám tại bệnh viện Nhân dân 115 trong khoảng thời gian từ tháng 3/2024 đến tháng 6/2024. Kết quả cho thấy tỷ lệ bệnh nhân thừa cân, béo phì mắc MAFLD là 72,9%. Nhóm bệnh nhân này có chỉ số BMI, glucose, cholesterol toàn phần, LDL-c, triglyceride, AST, ALT, GGT và tỷ lệ mắc các bệnh lý chuyển hóa cao hơn rõ rệt so với nhóm không mắc MAFLD (p < 0,05), đồng thời các giá trị độ cứng gan và nhiễm mỡ gan cũng cao hơn có ý nghĩa thống kê. Các phát hiện này nhấn mạnh mức độ phổ biến cao của MAFLD trong dân số thừa cân, béo phì và mối liên quan chặt chẽ với các yếu tố nguy cơ chuyển hóa cũng như tổn thương gan, hàm ý cần có chiến lược quản lý, tầm soát và can thiệp sớm đối với nhóm bệnh nhân này trong các nghiên cứu và thực hành lâm sàng tương lai.

The section of the thesis focuses on the pretraining process for Vietnamese text summarization, particularly addressing the lack of pretraining datasets for multi-document summarization in Vietnamese. To overcome this challenge, the Newscorpus dataset, originally intended for single-document summarization, was adapted to function as a pseudo multi-document dataset. This was achieved by dividing each document into segments based on its length, creating segments that varied from 2 to 5 parts. This segmentation approach aimed to enhance the dataset's robustness and diversity for effective training.

In the experimental section of this thesis, a comprehensive analysis and evaluation were conducted on the Vietnamese text summarization task, motivated by the limited availability of pretraining datasets specifically designed for multi-document summarization in the Vietnamese language. To mitigate this constraint, the Newscorpus dataset was employed, initially developed as a single-document resource, and subsequently adapted into a pseudo multi-document format. This adaptation involved segmenting each document into smaller parts, with the segmentation process carefully considering the original document length. As a result, the documents were divided into segments ranging from 2 to 5 parts, thereby creating a more robust and diverse dataset suitable for training purposes. This methodological approach significantly contributes to the enhancement of training efficacy for Vietnamese text summarization tasks.

This paper addresses the challenge of reconstructing high-resolution light field (LF) images from hybrid lenses, which consist of a high-resolution camera surrounded by multiple low-resolution cameras, by introducing a novel end-to-end learning-based approach that fully leverages the unique characteristics of hybrid inputs from two complementary perspectives. The proposed method features two parallel modules: one learns a deep multidimensional and cross-domain feature representation to regress a spatially consistent intermediate estimation, while the other propagates information from the high-resolution view to construct an intermediate estimation that preserves high-frequency textures. The final high-resolution LF image is obtained by fusing these intermediate estimations using learned attention maps. Extensive experiments show that this approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods by improving PSNR by more than 2 dB and better preserving LF structure. This work presents the first end-to-end deep learning solution for high-resolution LF image reconstruction from hybrid inputs, with potential benefits for reducing the cost of LF data acquisition as well as improving storage and transmission efficiency. The paragraph outlines three primary strategies for addressing Catastrophic Forgetting in continual learning models: regularization-based methods, dynamic architecture methods, and replay-based methods, noting that replay-based approaches have demonstrated superior performance in NLP tasks such as Continual Relation Extraction (CRE). 

Existing approaches to mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in continual learning can be broadly classified into three categories. First, regularization-based methods alleviate forgetting by imposing constraints on the updates of certain network parameters, with the degree of constraint determined by the parameters' importance to previous tasks. Second, dynamic architecture methods adaptively adjust the network's capacity, expanding or modifying its structure to accommodate new tasks as they arise, thereby enhancing the model's ability to learn emerging tasks effectively. Third, replay-based methods utilize a memory buffer to retain a limited set of samples from earlier tasks, which are periodically replayed during training to maintain performance on previously learned knowledge. Empirical evidence suggests that among these strategies, replay-based methods have yielded the most promising results for natural language processing (NLP) applications, including Continual Relation Extraction (CRE). This thesis builds upon these findings by focusing on the replay-based approach, aiming to further advance CRE through novel techniques such as feature decorrelation, as detailed in subsequent sections.

A Generative Transfer Network (GTNet) is introduced to address the challenge of zero-shot object detection (ZSD). The architecture of GTNet comprises an Object Detection Module and a Knowledge Transfer Module. The Object Detection Module is adept at acquiring extensive seen domain knowledge, while the Knowledge Transfer Module employs a feature synthesizer to create features for unseen classes, facilitating the training of a novel classification layer within the Object Detection Module. To effectively synthesize features that capture both intra-class and intersection over union (IoU) variance for each unseen class, an IoU-Aware Generative Adversarial Network (IoUGAN) is designed as the feature synthesizer, seamlessly integrating into GTNet. IoUGAN is composed of three units: the Class Feature Generating Unit (CFU), which produces unseen features with intra-class variance based on class semantic embeddings; the Foreground Feature Generating Unit (FFU), and the Background Feature Generating Unit (BFU), both of which incorporate IoU variance into the CFU outputs, generating class-specific foreground and background features. Evaluation on three public datasets indicates that GTNet exhibits superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art ZSD methodologies.

Understanding physical phenomena oftentimes means understanding the underlying dynamical system that governs observational measurements. While accurate prediction can be achieved with black box systems, they often lack interpretability and are less amenable for further expert investigation. Alternatively, the dynamics can be analysed via symbolic regression. In this paper, we extend the approach by (Udrescu et al., 2020) called AIFeynman to the dynamic setting to perform symbolic regression on ODE systems based on observations from the resulting trajectories. We compare this extension to state-of-the-art approaches for symbolic regression empirically on several dynamical systems for which the ground truth equations of increasing complexity are available. Although the proposed approach performs best on this benchmark, we observed difficulties of all the compared symbolic regression approaches on more complex systems, such as Cart-Pole.

The "Screen Manager" maintains a comprehensive record of all available screens using a dictionary data structure, where each entry is indexed by the corresponding screen name. This organizational approach enables efficient retrieval and management of screen states. The system is architected around two principal methods: "LoadScreen", responsible for initializing and preparing individual screens for use, and "SetScreen", which facilitates the switching and presentation of the desired screen to the user. This design ensures modularity and scalability in screen management, thereby streamlining both development and runtime performance.

Nhóm tác giả này đã phát triển một mô hình toán học với sự hỗ trợ của thuật toán Ant Colony Algorithm (ACA) cho hai giai đoạn: sắp xếp nhiệm vụ và định tuyến các nhiệm vụ được phân công theo phương thức offline. This paper addresses the challenge of 3D human pose estimation from a single color image. Despite the general success of the end-to-end learning paradigm, top-performing approaches typically rely on a two-step solution comprising a Convolutional Network (ConvNet) for 2D joint localization followed by an optimization step to recover the 3D pose. We identify the representation of 3D pose as a critical limitation in current ConvNet approaches and make two significant contributions to validate the efficacy of end-to-end learning for this task. First, we propose a fine discretization of the 3D space around the subject and train a ConvNet to predict per-voxel likelihoods for each joint, creating a natural and effective representation for 3D pose that substantially outperforms direct regression of joint coordinates. Second, to further refine initial estimates, we introduce a coarse-to-fine prediction scheme that addresses the increased dimensionality while enabling iterative refinement and repeated processing of image features. Our approach surpasses all state-of-the-art methods on standard benchmarks, achieving an average relative error reduction greater than 30%. Furthermore, we explore the use of our volumetric representation within a related architecture that, although suboptimal compared to our end-to-end approach, is practically valuable because it allows training without images paired with corresponding 3D ground truth and facilitates compelling results on in-the-wild images.

In recent years, the widespread adoption of AI has heightened concerns regarding algorithmic bias, discrimination, and fairness. Unlike traditional forms of human-induced bias or discrimination, algorithmic bias arising from AI systems is often more abstract and less intuitive, rendering it more challenging to interpret and address. Notably, there remains a significant gap in the literature concerning the evaluation and mitigation of bias within pruned neural networks. In this study, we address the complex tasks of evaluating, mitigating, and elucidating induced bias in pruned neural networks. This paper presents three primary contributions. First, we introduce two straightforward yet effective metrics, Combined Error Variance (CEV) and Symmetric Distance Error (SDE), to quantitatively assess the capacity of pruned models to prevent induced bias. Second, we show that knowledge distillation serves as an effective means of mitigating induced bias in pruned neural networks, even when working with unbalanced datasets. Third, we demonstrate that model similarity exhibits strong correlations with pruning-induced bias, offering a compelling explanation for the emergence of bias in pruned neural networks. Our code is available at https://github.com/codestar12/pruning-distilation-bias

The main idea of the paragraph is that the technology stack chosen for Trendz—comprising MySQL Database, Spring Boot API server, and ReactJS frontend—is not the most modern or trendy, but was selected for reasons of familiarity and productivity. The author argues that using technologies the team is already proficient in enables rapid prototyping and early results, while less-critical modules can later serve as opportunities to experiment with newer technologies and stay current, rather than confronting multiple steep learning curves at the outset. This approach emphasizes the importance of pragmatic decision-making in technology selection for online news tracking systems, as depicted in Figure 1.

In the development of the TRACKING SYSTEM FOR ONLINE NEWS SITES IN VIETNAM, the choice of core technologies—namely MySQL Database, Spring Boot API server, and ReactJS frontend—reflects a strategic emphasis on leveraging established, well-understood platforms rather than adopting the latest market trends. Although these technologies are not the most recent innovations, their proven stability and widespread adoption allow for immediate productivity, facilitating the rapid creation of functional prototypes as illustrated in Figure 1. This approach aligns with recommendations from related works, such as those by Nguyen et al. (2020), which highlight the benefits of prioritizing development familiarity to accelerate initial progress and build team confidence. Additionally, the system architecture allows for the gradual integration of newer technologies within peripheral modules, thereby enabling ongoing professional development without jeopardizing the project’s foundational stability. The contribution of this thesis, therefore, lies in demonstrating how prioritizing familiarity and productivity in technology selection supports efficient system development for Vietnamese online news tracking, while still permitting incremental adoption of emerging technologies to maintain long-term competitiveness.

Có hai vùng tương đương được xác định là vùng tương đương hợp lệ và vùng tương đương không hợp lệ, mỗi vùng gồm 2 trường hợp kiểm thử, tổng cộng 6 trường hợp kiểm thử đã được thực hiện. Kết quả kiểm thử chỉ ra rằng có 2 trường hợp không đạt do người dùng nhập thiếu các trường thông tin bắt buộc. Quá trình kiểm thử chức năng quản lý công việc được trình bày chi tiết trong Bảng 4.31, bao gồm các trường hợp như: người dùng không nhập thông tin và ấn lưu công việc, người dùng chỉ nhập một trường bắt buộc, người dùng nhập đủ các trường bắt buộc nhưng bỏ trống trường không bắt buộc, và người dùng nhập đầy đủ tất cả các trường. Các trường hợp lỗi đều báo lỗi các trường bắt buộc không được bỏ trống (Error), còn các trường hợp nhập đúng sẽ cập nhật công việc thành công (OK). Phương pháp kiểm thử sử dụng là phân vùng tương đương (equivalence partitioning), chia thành hai vùng tương đương.

Kiểm thử chức năng quản lý công việc được thực hiện dựa trên phương pháp phân vùng tương đương (equivalence partitioning), với hai vùng tương đương hợp lệ và không hợp lệ, mỗi vùng gồm hai trường hợp kiểm thử, tổng cộng sáu trường hợp. Kết quả kiểm thử cho thấy có hai trường hợp không đạt do người dùng không nhập đủ các trường thông tin bắt buộc. Chi tiết các trường hợp kiểm thử và kết quả được trình bày trong Bảng 4.31. Cụ thể, khi người dùng không nhập hoặc chỉ nhập một trường thông tin bắt buộc và ấn lưu, hệ thống sẽ báo lỗi các trường thông tin bắt buộc không được bỏ trống (Error). Nếu người dùng nhập đủ các trường thông tin bắt buộc, công việc sẽ được cập nhật thành công, các trường không bắt buộc sẽ được gán giá trị mặc định hoặc cập nhật theo thông tin nhập vào (OK).

The paragraph discusses the concept of gas in blockchain networks such as Ethereum, emphasizing that gas serves as a metric for the computational effort required to execute transactions, including smart contracts. It highlights that the gas cost escalates with the complexity of queries and the volume of data requested, which can render the execution of complex queries or processing of large datasets economically unfeasible. Executing smart contracts on blockchain platforms like Ethereum involves the consumption of gas, which quantifies the computational resources necessary to perform a transaction. The amount of gas required—and thus the associated cost—increases proportionally with the complexity of the query and the size of the dataset involved. Consequently, this scaling of gas expenses can impose significant economic constraints, potentially making it impractical to execute intricate queries or handle extensive data volumes within the smart contract framework.

Throughout the campus, numerous points are distributed to serve as the graph’s vertices, acting as fundamental components for path calculation and AR breadcrumb creation. Each point is structured similarly to a polygon, with “coordinates” specifying its exact position on the map and “properties” detailing attributes such as type, ID, rotation, and index. These properties are crucial, as the “rotation” and “index” determine the orientation and placement of AR markers, which are essential for effective AR integration in the navigation system. Consequently, these points form the basis for constructing the graph and implementing AR breadcrumbs that guide users throughout the indoor environment.

Recursive Reasoning-Based Bayesian Optimization (R2-B2) introduces a novel formalism for modeling the interactions of boundedly rational, self-interested agents in repeated games with unknown, complex, and costly-to-evaluate payoff functions. The R2-B2 framework employs recursive reasoning within the Bayesian optimization paradigm, enabling agents to anticipate and adapt to the strategies of others without imposing restrictions on the relationships among their payoff functions. This generality allows R2-B2 to be effectively applied across diverse game types, including constant-sum, general-sum, and common-payoff scenarios. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that agents employing R2-B2 at level 2 or higher, and reasoning one level beyond their counterparts, can achieve significantly faster asymptotic convergence to no-regret outcomes compared to agents that do not utilize recursive reasoning. Additionally, a streamlined variant, R2-B2-Lite, is proposed to reduce computational demands, though with a trade-off in convergence guarantees. Empirical evaluations across synthetic games, adversarial machine learning, and multi-agent reinforcement learning further validate the effectiveness and flexibility of the R2-B2 approach, highlighting its potential to advance strategic decision-making in complex multi-agent environments.

Deep domain adaptation has emerged as a technique to address the scarcity of labeled data. Unlike traditional methods that rely on shared feature subspaces or important source instances with shallow representations, deep domain adaptation uses deep networks to learn more transferable representations by integrating domain adaptation into deep learning. While comprehensive surveys exist for shallow domain adaptation, few review the new deep learning-based methods. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of deep domain adaptation methods for computer vision, offering four main contributions: a taxonomy of deep domain adaptation scenarios based on data divergence properties; a summary and comparison of approaches categorized by training loss; an overview of computer vision applications beyond image classification, including face recognition, semantic segmentation, and object detection; and an outline of potential deficiencies in current methods and future research directions.

The main idea of the paragraph is to explain the Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) task used in BERT's pre-training, detailing how sentence pairs are constructed and the assumption underlying the task. NSP is a crucial component of BERT's architecture, where the model is trained to determine whether a given sentence logically follows another within the original text. In the BERT training process, the model receives pairs of sentences; for half of these pairs, the second sentence is indeed the next sentence in the original text, while for the other half, the second sentence is randomly selected from the corpus. This design is based on the assumption that a randomly chosen sentence is unlikely to be contextually related to the first sentence, thereby enabling the model to learn the concept of sentence coherence and continuity.

Incremental Few-Shot Object Detection (iFSOD) addresses the challenge of enabling object detectors to continually expand their recognition capabilities by learning new classes from only a few annotated examples, a feature crucial in applications such as autonomous driving and robotics. Traditional sequential learning scenarios with limited training samples often suffer from catastrophic forgetting and significant overfitting. To overcome these issues, iFSOD introduces a Double-Branch Framework (DBF) that decouples feature representations for base and novel classes, thereby promoting both the retention of previously learned knowledge and effective adaptation to new classes. The method further employs a progressive model updating rule designed to preserve long-term memory of old classes while adapting to sequentially introduced new classes. Additionally, an inter-task class separation loss is proposed to expand the decision boundaries for new classes, enhancing feature discrimination and reducing class confusion. Experimental evaluations on benchmarks such as Pascal VOC and MS-COCO demonstrate that the proposed approach effectively mitigates the limitations of incremental few-shot learning, significantly improving detection accuracy for both base and novel classes in real-world object detection tasks.

Activation functions commonly used before ReLU, such as sigmoid and tanh, tend to saturate, which means their outputs approach fixed values (1.0 for large inputs in sigmoid, -1 or 0 for large inputs in tanh). These functions are mainly responsive to input values near their mid-points (0.5 for sigmoid, 0.0 for tanh), leading to a phenomenon known as the vanishing gradient problem. The vanishing gradient problem refers to the issue where gradients become too small for effective learning in deep networks.

Activation functions like sigmoid and tanh, which were widely used before ReLU, often saturate so that their output values become fixed at extremes—1.0 for large inputs in sigmoid and -1 or 0 for tanh. Moreover, these functions are mostly sensitive to variations near their respective mid-points (0.5 for sigmoid and 0.0 for tanh). As a result, they suffer from the vanishing gradient problem, where gradients become too small for the network to learn effectively. The vanishing gradient problem will be briefly discussed next.

There are two different storage methods for handling tokens in authentication and authorization: local storage for access tokens and httpOnly cookies for refresh tokens, which enhance security. This distinction exists because JavaScript in a UI App cannot manipulate or read refresh tokens, which have a longer lifespan. Although access tokens could also be stored in httpOnly cookies for added confidentiality, they are kept in local storage for ease of development, allowing local apps to use access tokens from the auth service in a near-production setting. Given the short lifespan of access tokens (less than an hour), losing them poses a lower risk compared to refresh tokens, which could allow attackers to impersonate users indefinitely to make unauthorized API calls.

Abstract: This paper introduces a novel method for jointly learning a 3D face parametric model and 3D face reconstruction by integrating diverse data sources. Traditional approaches typically rely on a single source, such as scanned data or in-the-wild images, each with its limitations. Scanned data provide precise geometric details but are costly and limited in subject diversity, while in-the-wild images are abundant and easily accessible but lack explicit geometric information. Our method unifies these disparate data sources, including scanned face data, face images, and a substantial collection of RGB-D images captured with an iPhone X, to bridge the existing information gap. The experimental results showcase that incorporating a variety of training data sources enables the development of a more robust and comprehensive face model. This work makes a significant contribution by leveraging multiple data types to enhance 3D face modeling and reconstruction accuracy.

Object detection remains a central challenge in computer vision, particularly for applications in autonomous driving where environmental conditions and scene composition differ significantly from those in general-purpose benchmarks. To address these domain-specific challenges, an enhanced 2D object detector based on the Faster R-CNN architecture is proposed, with modifications tailored for the autonomous vehicle context. The standard uniform anchor generation strategy is replaced with a perspective-aware approach that segments the image into key regions using clustering and optimizes anchor shapes in each region via evolutionary algorithms, accommodating the perspective effects inherent to vehicle-mounted cameras. Additionally, the precision of the detector's second-stage header is improved by integrating spatial information from candidate regions, while foreground-foreground class imbalance is mitigated using targeted re-weighting strategies, including a reduced version of focal loss. This combination significantly boosts the detector's ability to identify rare and difficult objects. An ensemble model further aggregates the advantages of multiple learning strategies. Evaluation on the comprehensive Waymo Open Dataset demonstrates substantial performance gains, achieving up to 9.69% improvement in mean average precision without increasing computational overhead, thus offering a scalable solution for anchor-based object detection frameworks in autonomous driving.

Nếu khối lượng giao dịch lớn, hệ số A/D cao, điều này minh chứng cho sự biến động giá mạnh hơn.

Trong phương pháp tối ưu điển hình của đàn kiến, các đường đi có mật độ mù kiến cao thường được coi là tốt hơn. Tuy nhiên, trong phương pháp tiếp cận hiện tại, mật độ mù chất chống pheromone thấp hơn được đánh giá cao hơn, vì điều này đồng nghĩa với việc sẽ có ít AGV khác đi qua đường đó trong tương lai gần. Phương pháp này nhằm mục tiêu xác định đường đi ngắn nhất trên một đồ thị chứa trọng số đỉnh dựa trên mù chất chống pheromone và trọng số cạnh dựa trên khoảng cách thông qua thuật toán A∗. Thông qua cách tiếp cận này, tất cả các đỉnh trong đồ thị đều được đánh giá dựa trên mù chất chống pheromone trước khi lựa chọn đường đi ngắn nhất. Khác với thuật toán đàn kiến truyền thống, ban đầu, AGV không di chuyển ngẫu nhiên mà sử dụng những đường đi ngắn nhất đã được nhận diện trên một đồ thị với trọng số đỉnh bằng 0. Mặc dù phương pháp này không chỉ tính toán khoảng cách mà còn xem xét các yếu tố ùn tắc, nhưng đôi khi nó không hoạt động như mong muốn. Một tình huống không mong đợi là khi hai AGV có cùng nguồn và đích di chuyển nối tiếp nhau. AGV đầu tiên sẽ xác định một con đường và để lại mù chất chống pheromone trên đó, khiến cho việc chọn con đường tương tự trở nên kém hấp dẫn đối với AGV thứ hai. Trong các tình huống như vậy, con đường của AGV đầu tiên và thứ hai thường khác nhau, mặc dù hành trình ngắn nhất cho cả hai có thể là đi qua cùng một con đường, vì AGV đầu tiên có thể dọn đường cho AGV thứ hai. Một hạn chế khác của phương pháp này là khi định tuyến cho một AGV, hệ thống cũng phải tính toán mức độ mù chất chống pheromone tại các vùng cách rất xa nguồn.

Điều này cho thấy việc mở rộng nguồn thu nhập không đủ để giảm thiểu rủi ro tài chính, mà các ngân hàng cần chú trọng nâng cao quản lý vốn và kiểm soát chi phí hoạt động nhằm tăng cường sự ổn định. Để cải thiện hiệu quả chống sét, nhiều giải pháp đã được áp dụng như sử dụng dây chống sét, chống sét van, giảm tổng trở thân cột và tổng trở tiếp địa. ReactJS là một thư viện JavaScript phổ biến cho phép xây dựng giao diện người dùng thông qua việc phân chia thành các thành phần riêng biệt gọi là component. Việc tổ chức giao diện thành các component không chỉ giúp chia nhỏ cấu trúc ứng dụng thành các phần dễ quản lý mà còn tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho việc tái sử dụng mã nguồn, từ đó nâng cao hiệu quả phát triển và bảo trì ứng dụng. Mỗi component trong ReactJS hoạt động như một khối độc lập, sở hữu các thuộc tính (props) và trạng thái (state) riêng, cho phép truyền dữ liệu cũng như kiểm soát hành vi của component một cách linh hoạt. Ngoài ra, các component có thể được xây dựng bằng cú pháp JavaScript thông thường hoặc sử dụng JSX (JavaScript XML), giúp biểu diễn cấu trúc giao diện một cách trực quan và dễ hiểu hơn. Việc áp dụng mô hình component hóa của ReactJS đã được nhiều nghiên cứu ghi nhận là mang lại hiệu quả rõ rệt trong việc phát triển các ứng dụng web hiện đại.

Convolutional Neural Networks (ConvNets) are specifically designed for image input by structuring their architecture to leverage the spatial structure of image data. Unlike conventional neural networks, ConvNets organize their neurons in three dimensions: width, height, and depth. It is important to note that the term 'depth' in this context refers to the extent of an activation volume, rather than the total number of layers in a neural network. As illustrated in Figure 2.31, a ConvNet's architecture involves a sequence of layers, each of which transforms the input volume into another volume through a differentiable function. This structured approach facilitates the effective learning of spatial hierarchies inherent in image data, offering a substantial advantage over traditional neural network architectures. The work of LeCun et al. (1998) and Krizhevsky et al. (2012) has been seminal in establishing the foundational principles and performance capabilities of ConvNets, demonstrating their superior efficacy in image recognition tasks. The contribution of this research lies in elucidating the architectural and functional distinctions of ConvNets, underscoring their utility in processing image-based data with improved accuracy and efficiency.

Node modules là thư mục lưu trữ các thư viện được sử dụng trong ứng dụng, đóng vai trò cung cấp các chức năng và công cụ cần thiết cho quá trình phát triển. Thư mục reducers bao gồm các file thực hiện việc quản lý và lưu trữ dữ liệu của ứng dụng, đảm bảo trạng thái được cập nhật một cách nhất quán. Trong khi đó, thư mục router chứa các file khai báo các màn hình và thiết lập cấu trúc điều hướng (stack) giữa các màn hình, cho phép người dùng di chuyển linh hoạt trong giao diện ứng dụng.

Chức năng tìm kiếm và lọc dịch vụ cloud trên trang chủ của hệ thống được thiết kế nhằm cung cấp các tiêu chí đa dạng để người dùng dễ dàng lựa chọn và tìm kiếm dịch vụ phù hợp. In the context of exception handling within software applications, it is crucial to address potential issues that may disrupt normal operations. One such issue is the occurrence of invalid input, which can lead to malfunction if not properly managed. When the system encounters an invalid input, as denoted by the error message AF1, it must promptly alert the user and halt further processing to prevent erroneous data from impacting the system's performance. Another common exception pertains to user authentication, specifically the expiration of a login token, identified by the error code AF2. It is imperative for the system to recognize this event and notify the user, prompting them to re-authenticate to maintain secure access. Furthermore, the system must seamlessly handle updates to content, as exemplified by process BF6, which involves applying translated updates to articles and confirming successful completion to the user. By effectively managing these exceptional events, the system ensures robust performance and enhances user experience, aligning with established research on exception handling best practices (e.g., Hình A, B, C).

Trong bối cảnh phát triển các hệ thống lập kế hoạch và điều phối hiện đại, vấn đề routing and scheduling thích ứng với ngữ cảnh đã thu hút sự quan tâm đáng kể trong cộng đồng nghiên cứu. Nhiều công trình trước đây, như nghiên cứu của Mors, Zutt và Witteveen (2007), đã đề xuất các phương pháp context-aware logistic routing and scheduling nhằm tối ưu hóa quá trình vận chuyển và phân phối hàng hóa dựa trên các yếu tố ngữ cảnh như điều kiện giao thông, thời tiết, và nguồn lực hiện có. Tuy nhiên, các giải pháp này chủ yếu tập trung vào mô hình hóa ngữ cảnh ở mức tổng thể và chưa khai thác triệt để tiềm năng của dữ liệu thời gian thực cũng như các kỹ thuật học máy hiện đại để nâng cao chất lượng quyết định. Đóng góp của nghiên cứu hiện tại là xây dựng một framework linh hoạt cho routing and scheduling, có khả năng tích hợp hiệu quả dữ liệu ngữ cảnh đa dạng và sử dụng các thuật toán tối ưu hóa dựa trên học sâu, từ đó đáp ứng tốt hơn các yêu cầu động và phức tạp của môi trường logistics thực tiễn.

Bài báo này điều tra mối quan hệ giữa sự không chắc chắn trong chính sách kinh tế (EPU) với các khoản nợ xấu và dự phòng rủi ro cho vay ở 22 quốc gia phát triển lớn giai đoạn 2008–2017. Sử dụng phương pháp tương quan Pearson, nghiên cứu đánh giá sự tương quan giữa EPU, các khoản nợ xấu của ngân hàng và các khoản dự phòng rủi ro. Kết quả cho thấy EPU có tương quan nghịch với các khoản nợ xấu và dự phòng rủi ro cho vay trong lĩnh vực ngân hàng của các nước EU, nhưng lại có tương quan dương ở các nước ngoài EU. Đặc biệt, EPU tương quan nghịch với nợ xấu trong các nền kinh tế tiên tiến nhất thuộc G7, trong khi các khoản dự phòng rủi ro ở EU phản ứng nhanh hơn với biến động của EPU so với nợ xấu. Những phát hiện này cho thấy sự tương quan của EPU với dự phòng rủi ro và nợ xấu bị ảnh hưởng bởi đặc điểm khu vực. Đây là nghiên cứu đầu tiên phân tích mối liên hệ này theo các phân loại khu vực như EU, ngoài EU và G7, cung cấp cái nhìn sâu sắc về sự khác biệt khu vực có thể giải thích sự đồng vận động của EPU với nợ xấu và dự phòng rủi ro.

Accelerating deep convolutional neural networks has become a significant topic of interest in both academia and industry. In this paper, we introduce an efficient low-precision quantized Winograd convolution algorithm, termed LANCE, which leverages the benefits of fast convolution and quantization techniques. By integrating linear quantization operations into the Winograd domain, the rapid convolution is executed efficiently under low-precision computation on graphics processing units. We evaluate neural network models with LANCE on key image classification datasets, including SVHN, CIFAR, and ImageNet. The experimental results demonstrate that our 8-bit quantized Winograd convolution enhances performance by up to 2.40x compared to full-precision convolution, with only minimal accuracy loss.

Hệ mật mã theo nguyên tắc này được gọi là hệ mã khóa công khai (public key cryptosystems) hay còn được gọi là mã khóa phi đối xứng (asymmetric key cryptosystems). 3.1.2 Chữ ký điện tử Khái niệm chữ ký điện tử được hai nhà bác học Diffie và Hellman đề xuất trong cùng bài báo nổi tiếng của họ khi khám phá nguyên lý của hệ thống mật mã công khai (1976). Ý tưởng về việc mô phỏng chữ ký tay trên văn bản trong đời thường đã có từ lâu, nhưng thực sự chỉ có thể thực hiện được cùng với sự ra đời của hệ mật mã KCK (khóa công khai). Như đã biết, hệ thống mật mã đối xứng đã được sử dụng phổ biến trước đó không có tính chất đại diện duy nhất cho một cá nhân. Trong khi đó, một hệ mã hóa khóa công khai (hay còn gọi là phi đối xứng) có thể được xem là được tạo lập để giúp bảo mật truyền tin trong liên lạc giữa một cá nhân và phần còn lại của xã hội. Nhờ có mật mã KCK, khái niệm chữ ký điện tử mới được hiện thực hóa và giúp cho giao dịch kinh tế thương mại trong đời sống có thể đi vào số hóa hoàn toàn, qua đó thúc đẩy hoạt động dịch vụ trực tuyến trên Internet phát triển như ngày nay.

Nghiên cứu của Nguyễn Thị Linh và Đặng Tiến Trung đã giới thiệu việc áp dụng bộ điều khiển mờ trong hệ truyền động bám xoay chiều, điều khiển vị trí thông qua biến tần. Bằng cách xây dựng sơ đồ cấu trúc và tổng hợp bộ điều khiển mờ, nhóm nghiên cứu đã tiến hành kiểm nghiệm thông qua mô phỏng trên Simulink. Kết quả cho thấy hệ thống hoạt động ổn định và chất lượng điều khiển tốt hơn đáng kể so với khi sử dụng bộ điều khiển PID truyền thống. Nghiên cứu còn xây dựng một mô hình thực nghiệm để điều khiển và giám sát qua mạng truyền thông công nghiệp, khẳng định tiềm năng ứng dụng rộng rãi của bộ điều khiển mờ trong các hệ thống truyền động đa động cơ. Điều này mở ra hướng đi mới cho việc nâng cao hiệu suất và độ chính xác trong các hệ thống điều khiển tự động hiện đại.

The main idea of this paragraph is to define and explain several technical indicators used in cryptocurrency data analysis, such as mom-10, psma-15, smaf-2-20, rrp-15, and dsh-15, which are calculated using historical price data over various time windows. These indicators form the basis for momentum-based investment strategies, which involve buying assets with higher momentum and selling those with lower momentum. The paragraph also briefly introduces the algorithm for analyzing the relationship between returns and the momentum factor in this investment approach.

Momentum indicators, including mom-10, mom-15, mom-20, and mom-25, are calculated as the natural logarithm of the ratio between the current price and the prices from 10, 15, 20, and 25 days prior, respectively. The psma indicators (psma-15, psma-20, psma-25, psma-30) represent the difference between the current price and the average price over 15, 20, 25, and 30 days, normalized by the average price. The smaf indicators (smaf-2-20, smaf-3-20, smaf-3-25, smaf-5-30) are computed as the ratio of the average prices over short-term (2, 3, or 5 days) to long-term (20, 25, or 30 days) periods, minus one. Relative return predictors (rrp-15, rrp-20, rrp-25, rrp-30) measure the deviation of the current price from the moving average over 15, 20, 25, or 30 days, scaled by the corresponding standard deviation. The dsh indicators (dsh-15, dsh-20, dsh-25, dsh-30) quantify the number of days elapsed since the highest price within the respective time windows. These metrics are foundational in momentum-based investment strategies, which operate on the premise of purchasing assets exhibiting elevated momentum and divesting those with weaker momentum. The subsequent algorithm delineates the analytical process by which the relationship between asset returns and the momentum factor is assessed, thereby providing a systematic framework for implementing momentum investment in the context of cryptocurrency markets. This approach is supported by related works such as Jegadeesh and Titman (1993) and further adapted for the cryptocurrency domain in more recent literature. The incorporation and clear definition of these indicators contribute to the methodological rigor of this study and facilitate reproducibility in future research.

Framework Express hiện đang là một trong những lựa chọn hàng đầu khi nhắc đến các framework phổ biến của NodeJS. Được biết đến với tính nhẹ nhàng và tốc độ cực nhanh, Express cung cấp các tiện ích mở rộng linh hoạt hỗ trợ nhiều chức năng cần thiết. Express rất dễ dàng để tùy chỉnh và sử dụng, phù hợp với nhu cầu cụ thể của người dùng. Framework này cung cấp đầy đủ các công cụ cần thiết để xây dựng một ứng dụng web hoặc một API. Hình 3.6 minh họa cấu trúc tổng quát của một ứng dụng được phát triển theo framework Express.

Bài báo phân tích và trình bày phương pháp thiết kế web đáp ứng nhằm giải quyết nhu cầu tối ưu hóa trải nghiệm người dùng trên các thiết bị di động như điện thoại thông minh và máy tính bảng, đồng thời áp dụng vào việc phát triển website phiên bản mobile cho khoa Công nghệ thông tin. Qua việc nghiên cứu thực trạng ứng dụng thiết kế web đáp ứng tại các đơn vị trong lĩnh vực Công nghệ thông tin ở Việt Nam và trên thế giới, tác giả đã tiến hành thiết kế, cài đặt và thử nghiệm thành công một website đáp ứng, với các tính năng như tối ưu hóa giao diện chạm màn hình, giảm thiểu nút điều khiển, tăng cường hình ảnh và video cùng khả năng tương tác mạng xã hội. Kết quả này không chỉ chứng minh hiệu quả của phương pháp thiết kế web đáp ứng trong việc nâng cao trải nghiệm người dùng đa thiết bị mà còn mở ra hướng phát triển bền vững cho các nghiên cứu và ứng dụng tiếp theo trong lĩnh vực thiết kế web hiện đại.

In the realm of general game testing, conventional methodologies involve human play testers, play test scripting, and leveraging prior knowledge of relevant areas to generate pertinent test data. This study incorporates deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to introduce an autonomous learning mechanism within the game testing framework. DRL enables the framework to either explore or exploit game mechanics contingent upon a user-defined, reinforcing reward signal. Consequently, this approach enhances test coverage and identifies unintended gameplay mechanics, exploits, and bugs across diverse game genres. This paper demonstrates that DRL is effective in augmenting test coverage, discovering exploits, assessing map difficulty, and detecting prevalent issues encountered in the testing of first-person shooter (FPS) games.

Bài báo đề xuất một mô hình mô phỏng dầm bê tông cốt thép chịu uốn dựa trên tiếp cận bán giải tích, kết hợp lý thuyết dầm Timoshenko và phương pháp Pb-Ritz nhằm xác định trường chuyển vị, biến dạng và ứng suất trong dầm. Chương trình tính toán được phát triển trên nền Matlab và được kiểm chứng bằng so sánh kết quả mô phỏng với dữ liệu thực nghiệm uốn bốn điểm, chứng minh độ chính xác và tin cậy của mô hình. Phân tích sâu hơn làm rõ đặc điểm phân bố ứng suất trên mặt cắt ngang và toàn bộ chiều dài dầm, đồng thời làm nổi bật vai trò đóng góp của bê tông và cốt thép trong sự làm việc chung của cấu kiện. Kết quả này không chỉ nâng cao hiểu biết về cơ chế chịu lực của dầm bê tông cốt thép mà còn mở ra hướng phát triển các phương pháp mô phỏng hiệu quả cho nghiên cứu kết cấu trong tương lai.
Việc giới hạn số lần đăng nhập giúp ngăn ngừa các cuộc tấn công Brute Force và đồng thời cảnh báo cho quản trị viên khi phát hiện nhiều yêu cầu đăng nhập xuất phát từ cùng một địa chỉ IP.

Phẫu thuật nội soi cắt túi mật cấp cứu cho bệnh nhân viêm túi mật cấp do sỏi phân độ II cho thấy kết quả vượt trội hơn so với phẫu thuật nội soi cắt túi mật trì hoãn sau dẫn lưu túi mật về tỉ lệ thành công và các chỉ số liên quan. Nghiên cứu tại bệnh viện Bình Dân với 71 bệnh nhân được chia thành hai nhóm đã chỉ ra sự khác biệt có ý nghĩa thống kê giữa hai phương pháp này (p=0,023). Phẫu thuật cấp cứu không chỉ rút ngắn thời gian nằm viện mà còn giảm nguy cơ tai biến và biến chứng so với phẫu thuật trì hoãn. Tuy nhiên, phương pháp dẫn lưu túi mật qua da kết hợp với phẫu thuật trì hoãn vẫn giữ vai trò quan trọng đối với những bệnh nhân có nhiều bệnh nền, tiền sử phẫu thuật ổ bụng, hoặc có chỉ số đánh giá sức khỏe cao như ASA ≥ 3 và CCI ≥ 6. Việc lựa chọn phương pháp phẫu thuật cần dựa trên tình trạng toàn thân và yếu tố nguy cơ của từng bệnh nhân để đảm bảo hiệu quả điều trị và an toàn tối đa. Kết quả này góp phần làm rõ hướng dẫn điều trị viêm túi mật cấp, giúp các bác sĩ có cơ sở để lựa chọn phẫu thuật phù hợp nhằm nâng cao chất lượng chăm sóc bệnh nhân.

Text generation is a critical task in Natural Language Processing with a range of applications, yet existing evaluation metrics each have notable limitations: traditional metrics like BLEU focus solely on the quality of generated sentences while ignoring diversity, leading to scenarios where repeated generation of a single high-quality sentence results in inflated BLEU scores, whereas newer metrics like Self-BLEU prioritize diversity at the expense of quality assessment. This paper addresses these shortcomings by proposing new metrics that jointly evaluate both quality and diversity through approximating the distance between the learned generative model and the real data distribution. Specifically, we introduce an n-gram based distance metric, a feature-based measure leveraging BERT—a state-of-the-art deep learning model trained on extensive text corpora—and, for oracle training settings where generator density is accessible, explicit distance measures between model and data distributions. Comprehensive experiments on leading text generation models using both established and introduced metrics reveal the advantages and preferences of the proposed evaluation methods. (174 words)

The main idea of the paragraph is that excessive pagination in a system can frustrate users, as they are forced to scroll through many pages to locate their desired information, ultimately resulting in a diminished user experience.

Excessive pagination within sales staff management systems often compels users to navigate through multiple pages to locate pertinent information, which can significantly hinder efficiency and satisfaction. Such design shortcomings have been noted to contribute to user frustration, as the search for specific data becomes unnecessarily cumbersome and time-consuming. This challenge not only impacts the overall usability of the system but may also deter users from fully engaging with its functionalities, as evidenced by similar findings in related studies (see Table 3.5). By addressing these issues, the present work aims to enhance the user experience by streamlining information retrieval, thus distinguishing itself from previous approaches that have not adequately mitigated the drawbacks of excessive pagination.

Trong bối cảnh nhu cầu của con người ngày càng phát triển theo hướng hiện đại, các thiết bị công nghệ đang hoạt động một cách độc lập, mỗi thiết bị tuân theo một quy trình sử dụng riêng biệt, phụ thuộc vào sự cài đặt và thiết lập từ người dùng. Tuy nhiên, giữa chúng vẫn thiếu sự kết nối về mặt công nghệ và dữ liệu. Đây là lý do mà việc nghiên cứu và phát triển các thiết bị điều khiển tự động, nhằm kết nối chúng thành một hệ thống hoàn chỉnh, trở nên cấp thiết. Sự kết nối này sẽ cho phép các thiết bị giao tiếp, trao đổi dữ liệu và phối hợp với nhau để tạo ra nhiều chức năng hữu ích, phục vụ tốt hơn cho cuộc sống hàng ngày của con người.
Phần trên đã cung cấp một cái nhìn tổng quan về hệ thống, bao gồm các tác nhân và các use case chính. Tiếp theo, tôi sẽ trình bày chi tiết các use case ở mức cao thông qua biểu đồ use case phân rã.

Bài báo nghiên cứu vai trò quan trọng của gia đình trong giáo dục theo quan điểm của Hồ Chí Minh, đặc biệt trong việc hình thành ý chí và khát vọng phát triển đất nước ở thế hệ trẻ. Hồ Chí Minh coi trọng gia đình như một nền tảng thiết yếu để xây dựng con người mới, điều này đã được Đảng nhận thức và áp dụng linh hoạt qua các giai đoạn lịch sử khác nhau. Những nhận thức này đã góp phần quan trọng vào việc nuôi dưỡng lớp thanh niên Việt Nam có tinh thần yêu nước, yêu chủ nghĩa xã hội, và có ý chí vươn lên trong cuộc sống. Nghiên cứu cũng đề xuất một số biện pháp để tiếp tục phát huy vai trò của gia đình trong giáo dục thế hệ trẻ trong bối cảnh hiện đại, qua đó nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của gia đình như một nhân tố chiến lược trong giáo dục và phát triển con người.

We address the estimation of conditional average treatment effects (CATEs) when treatments are graph-structured (e.g., molecular graphs of drugs). Given a weak condition on the effect, we propose a plug-in estimator that decomposes CATE estimation into separate, simpler optimization problems. Our estimator (a) isolates the causal estimands (reducing regularization bias), and (b) allows one to plug in arbitrary models for learning. In experiments with small-world and molecular graphs, we show that our approach outperforms prior approaches and is robust to varying selection biases. Our implementation is online.

The paper addresses the limitations of conventional Gaussian or Gaussian mixture priors in variational autoencoders, which struggle to capture the topological and geometric properties of data in latent space. To overcome this, the authors introduce the Encoded Prior Sliced Wasserstein AutoEncoder (EPSWAE), featuring a novel prior-encoder network that learns an unconstrained prior aligned with the encoded data manifold. The model employs the Sliced Wasserstein Distance (SWD) to iteratively train both the autoencoder and prior-encoder networks, offering a more flexible and efficient alternative to KL divergence without the need for adversarial training. Enhancements to SWD include nonlinear shearing to better distinguish between distributions. A structural consistency term ensures isometry between the feature and latent spaces, facilitating effective interpolation on the data manifold. The authors also propose a graph-based algorithm to identify network-geodesics in latent space, optimizing for sample density and minimal energy. Experiments on 3D-spiral, MNIST, and CelebA datasets demonstrate that the model's latent representations and interpolations are on par with current leading architectures. This work has implications for future research in improving generative models' ability to capture complex data structures, suggesting directions for further exploration in latent space geometry and efficient training methodologies.

This work addresses the challenge of parameter estimation in differential equation models when only qualitative system responses, such as bifurcation points, are observable rather than quantitative time-series data. Motivated by the need to infer model parameters from limited experimental information, we introduce a gradient-based semi-supervised approach that infers parameters by fitting user-specified bifurcation diagrams. Our method employs a cost function combining a supervised term—minimized when the model’s bifurcations match specified targets—and an unsupervised bifurcation measure that guides optimization toward parameter regimes exhibiting bifurcations. Notably, the approach enables gradient computation without differentiating through the numerical solver used for bifurcation diagram generation. We validate our approach on minimal models spanning saddle-node and pitchfork bifurcation diagrams, as well as on the genetic toggle switch from synthetic biology. Results demonstrate effective parameter inference from qualitative data and reveal that the cost landscape provides a means to categorize models by topological and geometric equivalence, suggesting new directions for organizing dynamical systems and informing future research on model comparison and design in systems biology and beyond. In the contexts of domain generalization (DG) and unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA), cross-domain feature alignment has been extensively investigated to converge the feature distributions of disparate domains, thereby facilitating the learning of domain-invariant representations. Nonetheless, such feature alignment methods are generally task-agnostic, which may lead to a reduction in the discriminative capacity of the feature representations and consequently impede high performance. In this study, we introduce a unified framework, designated Feature Alignment and Restoration (FAR), which aims to concurrently guarantee both high generalization and discriminative power of neural networks for effective DG and UDA. Concretely, we conduct feature alignment (FA) across domains by matching the moments of the distributions of attentively selected features to diminish their discrepancy. To preserve robust discrimination, we propose a Feature Restoration (FR) operation that extracts task-relevant features from residual information and employs them to augment the aligned features. To enhance disentanglement, a dual ranking entropy loss constraint is imposed during the FR stage to promote the segregation of task-relevant and task-irrelevant features. Comprehensive experiments on multiple classification benchmarks validate the superior performance and strong generalization capabilities of the FAR framework across both domain generalization and unsupervised domain adaptation tasks.

Recent advancements in machine learning have improved methods for teaching machines to answer visual questions, yet existing techniques still lack crucial human-like abilities such as modular integration of new visual classes and concepts, generating explainable answers, and adapting to new domains without explicit training examples. This paper introduces a novel approach that comprises generating a question graph representation and using an answering procedure guided by the question graph’s abstract structure to invoke an extendable set of visual estimators. The language and visual components are trained independently, diverging from prior methods by eliminating the need for training on images paired with questions and answers. As a result, the proposed method can address novel domains—including new question types, object classes, properties, and relations—provided that suitable visual estimators are available. Moreover, the method is capable of furnishing explanations for its answers and proposing alternatives when questions are not grounded in the image. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach achieves both high performance and domain extensibility without any questions-answers training, suggesting promising directions for future research in explainable and adaptable visual question answering systems.

This study conducts an empirical investigation into a recent class of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) utilizing Integral Probability Metrics (IPM) to evaluate their efficacy in semi-supervised learning. IPM-based GANs, such as Wasserstein GAN, Fisher GAN, and Sobolev GAN, exhibit advantageous properties in terms of theoretical understanding, training stability, and meaningful loss functions. This research specifically examines how the design of the critic (or discriminator) impacts performance in semi-supervised learning. We identify three critical factors essential for optimizing semi-supervised learning performance: (1) implementing the K+1 formulation, (2) avoiding the use of batch normalization in the critic, and (3) refraining from applying gradient penalty constraints on the classification layer.

This paper addresses the shortcomings of the widely used ID3 decision tree algorithm, particularly its tendency to favor attributes with numerous values, which can lead to suboptimal model performance in classification and prediction tasks. Motivated by the need for improved accuracy and efficiency in induction research and data mining, the authors propose an enhanced decision tree algorithm based on grouping attribute values. The approach involves initially dividing attributes into groups and applying a selection measure to these groups; if the information gain is inadequate, the attribute values are further subdivided and re-evaluated. This iterative process continues until an optimal classification or misclassification ratio is achieved. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves higher accuracy and efficiency in classifying data sets compared to the standard ID3. These findings suggest promising implications for future research, including further refinement of grouping strategies and application to a broader range of data mining problems. (153 words)

Recent deep generative inpainting methods typically utilize attention layers to enable the generator to borrow feature patches from known regions to complete missing areas, but the lack of explicit supervision for matching missing and known regions can result in improper reference selection and artifacts, as well as significant computational overhead due to pair-wise similarity computations over the entire feature map during inference. To address these challenges, this work proposes an attention-free generator trained jointly with an auxiliary contextual reconstruction task, which encourages plausible outputs by reconstructing them from surrounding regions. The auxiliary branch, named contextual reconstruction (CR) loss, operates as a learnable loss function by jointly optimizing query-reference feature similarity and the reference-based reconstructor with the inpainting generator and is only required during training, thus eliminating computational overhead during inference as only the inpainting generator is used. Experimental results show that the proposed inpainting model achieves competitive quantitative and visual performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, suggesting that this approach can serve as an efficient and effective alternative for future research in deep image inpainting. (183 words)

Selective weeding is a major challenge in agricultural robotics, requiring precise detection and differentiation between crops and weeds. State-of-the-art methods typically rely on appearance-based models trained on large, pixel-annotated datasets, but creating such datasets is extremely time-consuming, limiting the use of data-driven techniques. This paper addresses this issue by proposing a novel approach that significantly reduces human intervention in training detection and classification algorithms. We procedurally generate large synthetic training datasets by randomizing key environmental features—such as crop and weed species, soil type, and lighting conditions—and using a few real-world textures to create realistic artificial agricultural scenes effortlessly. These synthetic images can be used alone or to augment real-world data. We validate our method using a modern deep learning image segmentation architecture and compare classification results trained on real versus synthetic data. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and potential of our approach.

Title: Curriculum Domain Adaptation for Urban Scenery Semantic Segmentation

Abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have achieved significant success in semantic segmentation, essential for applications like autonomous driving. However, training CNNs demands vast labeled datasets, which are challenging to obtain. Recent advancements in computer graphics enable training on synthetic images with generated annotations, but domain mismatches between real and synthetic data limit model performance. This paper introduces a curriculum-style learning approach to bridge this domain gap in urban scenery semantic segmentation. The method prioritizes solving simpler tasks to extract essential properties of the target domain, beginning with global and local label distribution estimation over urban scene images' idiosyncratic features. Subsequently, a segmentation network is trained with predictions regularized to adhere to these inferred properties. Our experiments demonstrate superior performance over baselines across two datasets and backbone networks. Additionally, comprehensive ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our approach.

Time-series mining has emerged as a significant challenge for researchers, particularly due to its vital role in monitoring applications that necessitate analyzing large sets of time-series to identify usual patterns and detect unexpected deviations. This paper introduces a novel method for mining heterogeneous multivariate time-series, enabling the learning of meaningful patterns across several heterogeneous parameters, which is crucial for complex monitoring scenarios. The proposed approach accommodates mixed time-series data—including both pattern and non-pattern instances—and is robust to imprecise matches, outliers, stretching, and global time translations of pattern instances. Early results are demonstrated in the context of home health monitoring, where the method constructs a behavioral profile by analyzing temporal variations of multiple quantitative and qualitative parameters recorded by various sensors installed in a person’s home. These findings suggest that the approach offers a promising framework for future research on adaptive, personalized monitoring systems capable of handling complex and heterogeneous time-series data. Conditional generative adversarial networks (cGANs) have significantly advanced the field of conditional image generation, a core area of computer vision. However, existing research has predominantly emphasized performance enhancement, with limited attention given to improving cGAN robustness against noise. This oversight renders cGANs less reliable for practical deployment, as the generator’s regression may yield outputs with substantial errors under noisy conditions. Addressing this limitation, a novel model known as RoCGAN introduces a robust variant of cGAN by exploiting structural information inherent in the target space. RoCGAN enhances the generator with an additional unsupervised pathway, ensuring that its outputs consistently align with the target manifold, even when subjected to considerable noise. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that RoCGAN maintains key properties characteristic of standard GAN frameworks. Empirical evaluations across diverse domains, including natural scene and facial image datasets, reveal that RoCGAN surpasses leading cGAN architectures by a substantial margin in both accuracy and resilience to noise, establishing its potential for more reliable real-world applications.

Policy distillation in deep reinforcement learning enables transferring control policies from larger to smaller networks, but current methods are computationally inefficient and limited by model capacity. We introduce real-time policy distillation, where teacher training and student distillation occur simultaneously, allowing the teacher's latest policy to be transferred to the student in real time. This significantly reduces distillation time—often to half or less—and enables extremely small student models to achieve expert-level skills. Evaluations in the Atari 2600 domain demonstrate that our approach achieves full distillation in most games, maintaining performance even with compression ratios as high as 1.7%. (100 words)

This section discusses two key aspects of Android malware scanning: the Trust Chain Status and the analysis of application permissions. The Trust Chain Status pertains to verifying if the certificate was issued by a trusted Certificate Authority (CA) and whether the certificate's trust chain remains intact. The permissions analysis methodology involves identifying and categorizing the permissions that an application requests and subsequently comparing these permissions against predefined lists of potentially dangerous or suspicious permissions. This approach aims to enhance the detection of malicious behavior by scrutinizing both the authenticity of the app’s certification and the security implications of its permission requests. Trust Chain Status provides a basis for establishing the legitimacy of the application, while the permissions analysis offers insight into potential security risks posed by the app’s requested privileges. Together, these methods contribute to a comprehensive framework for Android malware detection.

Assessing the robustness of machine learning models prior to deployment is essential, particularly for deep neural networks in image understanding where variations in object location, rotation, and size can significantly influence predictions. This study conducts a fine-grained analysis of robustness to such factors using SI-Score, a synthetic dataset designed for controlled experimentation. By systematically evaluating the behavior of ResNets, Vision Transformers, and CLIP under these transformations, the work uncovers notable qualitative differences in how these architectures respond to changes in input conditions. The results highlight the importance of considering model-specific robustness characteristics in practical applications and suggest that future research should further explore architectural adaptations or training strategies to enhance robustness against common real-world variations.

Title: Semantic Style Transfer with XGAN: A Dual Adversarial Autoencoder Approach

Abstract: The study addresses the problem of semantic style transfer, aiming to learn mappings between the corpus-level styles of two unpaired image collections while maintaining shared semantic content. We propose XGAN ("Cross-GAN"), a dual adversarial autoencoder that captures a shared representation of semantic content in an unsupervised manner and learns domain-to-domain image translations bidirectionally. Our approach leverages domain adaptation techniques, incorporating a semantic consistency loss to ensure semantic preservation in the learned embedding space. We demonstrate promising qualitative outcomes in face-to-cartoon translation, utilizing the CartoonSet, a publicly available dataset, as a new benchmark for semantic style transfer. The results indicate the potential of our method to effectively achieve semantic style transfer across different domains.

This paper addresses the inconsistency between training and evaluation metrics in salient object detection (SOD), where conventional CNN-based methods optimize cross-entropy loss (CELoss) but evaluate results using the F-measure. We explore whether the F-measure can be used consistently as both a training objective and an evaluation metric by reformulating the standard F-measure into a differentiable version called relaxed F-measure. This relaxed F-measure enables seamless integration with CNN architectures as a loss function, termed FLoss. Unlike CELoss, which suffers from vanishing gradients in saturated activation regions, FLoss maintains significant gradients even near the target, encouraging the network to generate highly polarized activations. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that FLoss consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods, delivering superior saliency maps. Moreover, the pronounced polarization in predictions allows our method to achieve robust performance without the need for careful threshold tuning, highlighting its practical advantages for real-world SOD applications. Deep neural networks, especially convolutional neural networks, have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in image compression and solving inverse problems such as denoising, inpainting, and reconstruction from limited or noisy data, largely due to their expressive power in modeling natural images. However, these networks typically require extensive parameterization and large training datasets, contrasting with more classical approaches like wavelets. Introducing the deep decoder, an untrained, underparameterized image model, addresses these challenges by utilizing a deep neural network architecture that eschews convolutions and employs fewer weight parameters than the output dimensionality. This design enables efficient image representation and compression, achieving performance comparable to wavelet-based thresholding while mitigating the risk of overfitting, which is particularly beneficial for tasks like denoising. The deep decoder's simplicity—characterized by identical layers composed of upsampling, pixel-wise linear channel combinations, ReLU activations, and channelwise normalization—facilitates theoretical analysis and provides insights into the mechanisms underlying effective signal representation in neural networks. These properties position the deep decoder as both a practical and analytically tractable model for various image restoration tasks.

This paragraph discusses the rapid technological advancements in the gaming industry during the early 1980s, highlighting how the industry's unsustainable growth led to a proliferation of low-quality console games, exemplified by Atari's rushed releases of Pac Man and E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial. The resulting decline in product quality precipitated significant financial losses and reputational damage for companies like Atari, while also contributing to a broader industry downturn. Simultaneously, the emergence of personal computers—particularly the Commodore 64 in 1982—shifted the gaming landscape by introducing a new platform for digital games.

The period from 1975 to 2000 was marked by an intense drive for technological innovation within the gaming industry. However, this rapid evolution proved unsustainable, as evidenced by the experience of Atari, which sought to capitalize on the expanding household console game market by hastily licensing and releasing products such as the budget Pac Man docking stations and an adaptation of E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial. These titles were brought to market prematurely, resulting in substandard gameplay experiences that inflicted significant financial losses and long-term brand damage upon the company. The broader industry followed a similar trajectory, with multiple companies prioritizing speed to market over product quality, thus flooding the market with inferior console and game offerings and ultimately precipitating an industry-wide recession. Concurrently, the introduction of personal computers, most notably the Commodore 64 in 1982, provided consumers with a compelling new platform for gaming, thereby reshaping the competitive dynamics of the digital entertainment sector (see Table 3.5). This historical context underscores the importance of balancing technological advancement with quality assurance, a principle that informs the design approach of the current top-down action game for learning English with Unity.

Elastic Search, built on Apache Lucene, is presented as a powerful distributed search engine that supports real-time analytics and scalability for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. Additionally, RabbitMQ is introduced as a message broker that facilitates communication among microservices by queuing messages to prevent system overload and improve response times, particularly when multiple suppliers submit requests concurrently. The system architecture must accommodate numerous users accessing data concurrently while maintaining satisfactory response times, a requirement that cannot be reliably met by conventional database storage alone. Elastic Search, an open-source search engine developed atop Apache Lucene—a leading full-text search library renowned for its advanced, high-performance capabilities—addresses this need by providing a distributed, real-time document store where every field is indexed and searchable. This distributed search engine supports real-time analytics and can scale across hundreds of servers, managing petabytes of both structured and unstructured data. In the context of the microservice architecture employed in this project, inter-service communication is achieved through message passing. To efficiently manage high volumes of simultaneous messages, RabbitMQ is utilized as an open-source message broker. RabbitMQ functions as an intermediary that validates, transforms, and routes messages, thereby enabling swift responses to each request without monopolizing system resources. By queuing messages, RabbitMQ distributes workload among multiple receivers, mitigating issues such as server slowness, overload, and congestion caused by the influx of supplier requests. One of the fundamental challenges to scale self-driving is being able to create accurate high definition maps (HD maps) with low cost. Current attempts to automate this process typically focus on simple scenarios, estimate independent maps per frame or do not have the level of precision required by modern self driving vehicles. In contrast, in this paper we focus on drawing the lane boundaries of complex highways with many lanes that contain topology changes due to forks and merges. Towards this goal, we formulate the problem as inference in a directed acyclic graphical model (DAG), where the nodes of the graph encode geometric and topological properties of the local regions of the lane boundaries. Since we do not know a priori the topology of the lanes, we also infer the DAG topology (i.e., nodes and edges) for each region. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on two major North American Highways in two different states and show high precision and recall as well as 89% correct topology. (178 words)

Để cấu hình port forwarding cho PostgreSQL database trên Docker, trước hết cần định rõ các thông tin cơ bản về cơ sở dữ liệu. Cụ thể, "postgres:14alpne" là phiên bản của PostgreSQL được sử dụng. Điều này không chỉ góp phần giảm thiểu lỗi mà còn tăng cường sự linh hoạt trong quản lý dự án, phù hợp với các phương pháp phát triển Agile và DevOps được nhiều nghiên cứu đề cập (ví dụ như Smith et al., 2020; Nguyen và cộng sự, 2022). Nghiên cứu hiện tại nhằm mục đích tối ưu hóa cơ chế phối hợp này, qua đó nâng cao khả năng làm việc nhóm và hiệu quả tổng thể trong các dự án phát triển phần mềm phức tạp.

Do đó, trong lĩnh vực học tăng cường, việc xây dựng mô hình toán học cho bài toán đặt ra là một hướng tiếp cận hợp lý và có tính khả thi cao. Cụ thể, trong nghiên cứu này, bài toán được mô hình hoá bằng Quá trình quyết định Markov (Markov Decision Process), cho phép biểu diễn rõ ràng các trạng thái, hành động, phần thưởng và quy tắc chuyển trạng thái trong môi trường học tập.

Những kết quả này mở ra triển vọng ứng dụng nano bạc trong việc nâng cao chất lượng và hiệu quả tái sinh chồi cây African violet, góp phần phát triển kỹ thuật nuôi cấy mô cây trồng một cách bền vững và hiệu quả hơn.

Approaches to enhancing the training and prediction accuracy of weakly supervised machine learning models differ in their degree of task specificity and integration with particular model architectures. In this study, we present Knodle, a software framework that conceptualizes weak data annotations, deep learning models, and strategies for refining weakly supervised training as distinct, modular entities. This modular structure provides the training process with access to granular information, including dataset properties, heuristic rule matches, and components of the deep learning model ultimately employed for prediction. Consequently, our framework accommodates a broad spectrum of training methodologies for advancing weak supervision, spanning from techniques that consider only the relationships between rules and output classes—regardless of the machine learning model trained with the resultant labels—to those that exploit the dynamic between neural networks and weakly labeled data. We demonstrate the benchmarking capabilities of the framework through a comparative performance analysis of multiple reference implementations on a variety of datasets already supported by Knodle. The framework is distributed as the open-source Python package knodle and is accessible at https://github.com/knodle/knodle.

Python, một ngôn ngữ lập trình hướng đối tượng, được sử dụng để mô tả quá trình truyền neutron đơn năng và so sánh hiệu quả giữa hai phương pháp giả lập. Tuy vậy, một số vấn đề liên quan đến hệ số phẩm chất vẫn cần được tiếp tục nghiên cứu để hoàn thiện hơn nữa phương pháp này trong ứng dụng thực tế.

In situations where data is not independently and identically distributed (non-IID), the contribution of nodes to the training process in federated learning is often imbalanced. To address this issue, Hongda Wu et al. proposed the Federated Adaptive Weighting (FedAdp) algorithm. This algorithm assigns dynamic weights to each node for updating the global model, taking into account the contribution of each node in every training round. Specifically, the algorithm measures the contribution of a node by calculating the angle between its local gradient vector and the global gradient vector. Subsequently, a non-ar mapping function is used to quantify the weight. The study demonstrated that employing FedAdp in federated learning significantly reduces the number of communication rounds needed by up to 54.1% on the MNIST dataset and 45.4% on the FashionMNIST dataset, when compared to the traditional Federated Averaging (FedAvg) algorithm. This contribution highlights the potential of FedAdp to enhance the efficiency of federated learning systems, particularly in environments with non-IID data distributions.

Notably, the implementation of RFID significantly reduces the time and financial resources required for inventory management. Despite these benefits, enterprises encounter several challenges when integrating RFID into their product management processes, such as high initial investment costs, the need for compatibility with existing warehouse management systems, and concerns over data security (see Table 3.5). These considerations are consistent with the findings of related works, which emphasize both the transformative potential and the practical limitations of RFID deployment in logistics environments. The contribution of this thesis lies in further elucidating these integration challenges and proposing strategies to enhance the effectiveness of RFID-based automated inventory systems.

This paper addresses two major challenges in graph neural networks: the oversmoothing issue and limited generalization to unseen graphs, as most existing methods are designed for transductive settings and fixed graph structures. To overcome these limitations, the authors introduce Graph Entities with Step Mixture via random walk (GESM), a novel model that integrates edge-based neighborhood relationships and node-based entity features. GESM utilizes a step mixture through random walk to mitigate oversmoothing, incorporates attention mechanisms to dynamically model node interrelations, and applies structure-based regularization for improved embedding representations. Experimental results demonstrate that GESM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on eight benchmark datasets across both transductive and inductive learning tasks. The findings highlight the importance of leveraging global information in graph learning and suggest promising directions for future research in developing more generalizable and robust graph neural network architectures. This paper addresses the challenge of person re-identification (re-ID) in real-world scenarios, where a trained network must generalize to unseen target data despite domain variations. Traditional generative adversarial models enhance training data diversity but struggle with cross-domain generalization due to the disconnect between generative and discriminative components. To overcome these challenges, we propose an end-to-end domain adaptive attention network that integrates image translation and discriminative feature learning within a single framework. Our approach introduces an attention module that focuses on translating backgrounds rather than the entire image, preserving the person's identity across domains. This method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art techniques on multiple benchmark datasets, highlighting its effectiveness and suggesting promising directions for future research in improving model generalization in person re-ID tasks.

With the global transformation of the fashion industry and the increasing demand for fashion items worldwide, the need for effective fashion recommendation systems has become more pressing than ever. Despite numerous cutting-edge solutions previously proposed to personalize fashion recommendations, existing technologies continue to struggle with limited performance when encountering new entities, specifically due to the cold-start problem. In this paper, we aim to address the cold-start problem for new users by leveraging a novel visual preference modeling approach based on a small set of input images. We demonstrate the application of our approach using feature-weighted clustering to personalize occasion-oriented outfit recommendations. Quantitatively, our results indicate that the proposed visual preference modeling approach surpasses the state of the art in clothing attribute prediction. Qualitatively, through a pilot study, we further demonstrate the efficacy of our system in providing diverse and personalized recommendations in cold-start scenarios.
