Các giải pháp truyền thống như đê, kè, đập hay trạm bơm đã không còn phát huy hiệu quả như mong đợi. Để đối phó với thực trạng này, nhiều đô thị đã chủ động tìm kiếm và áp dụng những giải pháp thoát nước bền vững dựa trên tiếp cận tự nhiên, tiêu biểu như hệ thống thoát nước đô thị bền vững, thích ứng dựa vào hệ sinh thái tự nhiên hay các giải pháp dựa vào thiên nhiên. Những mô hình thí điểm này bước đầu cho thấy hiệu quả tích cực, góp phần giảm thiểu tình trạng ngập úng. Tuy nhiên, quá trình triển khai vẫn còn một số hạn chế như thiếu đồng bộ về quy hoạch, chưa có sự phối hợp chặt chẽ giữa các ngành cũng như nhận thức cộng đồng còn hạn chế. Để phát huy tối đa hiệu quả, cần tiếp tục nghiên cứu, hoàn thiện các giải pháp, tăng cường đầu tư cũng như nâng cao nhận thức và sự tham gia của người dân vào quá trình xây dựng đô thị phát triển bền vững.

This paper addresses the limitation of SSD (Single Shot Multibox Detector) in detecting small objects due to the lack of semantic information in its shallow Conv4_3 feature layer. We propose DDSSD (Dilation and Deconvolution Single Shot Multibox Detector), which introduces a novel feature fusion module combining a dilation convolution module to expand the receptive field of shallow features and a deconvolution module to upsample high-layer feature maps. Experimental results demonstrate that DDSSD achieves 79.7% mAP on PASCAL VOC2007 and 28.3% mmAP on MS COCO test-dev at a speed of 41 FPS with 300x300 input on a single Nvidia 1080 GPU. Notably, for small object detection, DDSSD achieves 10.5% mmAP on MS COCO and 22.8% on the FLIR thermal dataset, surpassing numerous state-of-the-art object detectors in both accuracy and speed. (Word count: 143)

Mực nước dưới đất tại vùng đồng bằng sông Cửu Long đang đối mặt với xu thế suy giảm nghiêm trọng, ảnh hưởng tới nguồn cung cấp nước thiết yếu cho khu vực này. Hiện tại, khai thác nước dưới đất đạt khoảng 2 triệu mét khối mỗi ngày và chiếm 70-80% nhu cầu sử dụng của người dân nông thôn. Từ năm 1990, Chính phủ đã triển khai mạng lưới quan trắc quốc gia với 246 giếng quan trắc trên 8 tầng chứa nước. Dữ liệu từ 2005 đến 2018 cho thấy các tầng chứa nước chính như Pleistocen và Pliocen đều có tốc độ hạ thấp đáng kể, lên tới 1,02 m/năm ở một số tầng. Xu thế này không chỉ đe dọa trữ lượng nước, mà còn có thể làm tăng nguy cơ xâm nhập mặn, ảnh hưởng tiêu cực đến nông nghiệp và sinh hoạt của người dân. Dự báo trong năm năm tới, mực nước dưới đất sẽ tiếp tục suy giảm, đòi hỏi các biện pháp quản lý và bảo vệ tài nguyên nước hiệu quả hơn để đảm bảo an ninh nước cho vùng đồng bằng sông Cửu Long.

Kiến trúc MVC gồm ba thành phần liên kết chặt chẽ nhưng khác biệt nhau: Model chịu trách nhiệm quản lý và xử lý dữ liệu, View đảm nhiệm việc hiển thị giao diện cho người dùng, còn Controller là bộ điều khiển điều phối tương tác giữa Model và View. Khi người dùng gửi request qua route, Controller sẽ xử lý yêu cầu đó, lấy dữ liệu từ database thông qua Model, rồi trả kết quả về View để hiển thị giao diện phù hợp. Laravel được ưa chuộng nhờ cú pháp rõ ràng và dễ hiểu.

This paragraph outlines the use case UC19, which describes the process of a customer making a payment via PayPal on an e-commerce luxury clothes website. It specifies the actors involved, preconditions, the step-by-step scenario of signing in and completing payment through PayPal, the expected outcomes, and exceptions such as cancellation by the user. The use case details the interaction flow, including user actions and system responses, to ensure a successful transaction and navigation back to the product page.

Use Case UC19 details the payment procedure using PayPal for customers purchasing items on the e-commerce luxury clothes website. The primary actor, the customer, initiates the process by selecting the PayPal payment option, provided that an item is already present in the shopping cart. Upon selection, the system prompts the user with a login form for their PayPal account, where the customer submits their credentials and requests authentication. Following successful login, the system presents the detailed order information, allowing the customer to confirm the purchase by selecting "Accept." Subsequently, the system records the payment information, confirms the successful transaction, and redirects the customer to the product page. The use case also accounts for the exception scenario where the customer cancels the payment process, resulting in the system displaying a cancellation message. This comprehensive description of the PayPal payment workflow ensures clarity in the system’s payment integration and user interaction design.

This paper addresses the limitations of deep learning methods for relational data, which, while scalable, can only numerically approximate relational structures and lack flexibility in reasoning compared to traditional first-order logic approaches. We propose a novel framework for relational representation learning that unites the scalability of deep learning with the expressiveness and interpretability of first-order logic. Drawing inspiration from the auto-encoding principle, our approach employs first-order logic as the representation language and utilizes logic programs, rather than neural networks, to map between original and latent representations. Learning in this framework is formulated as a constraint optimization problem solvable with existing solvers. Our method yields exact, flexible, and interpretable representations, overcoming the approximation and rigidity of deep learning models. Experimental results demonstrate that these latent representations enhance performance on relational learning tasks, establishing the proposed framework as a more accurate and adaptable alternative to current deep learning methodologies. (153 words)

Bài báo nghiên cứu luật điều khiển tối ưu thích nghi cho các hệ phi tuyến liên tục chịu ảnh hưởng của nhiễu đầu vào và tham số chưa biết, nhằm phát triển một phương pháp điều khiển hiệu quả và ổn định. Những đóng góp này mở ra hướng nghiên cứu mới trong việc áp dụng quy hoạch động thích nghi trực tuyến cho các hệ điều khiển phức tạp với điều kiện không chắc chắn, đồng thời cung cấp cơ sở cho các nghiên cứu tiếp theo về tối ưu hóa điều khiển thích nghi trong môi trường thực tế.

Bài báo nghiên cứu hiệu quả xử lý chất hữu cơ (COD và NH4+ - N) trong nước thải đô thị bằng công nghệ bùn hạt hiếu khí trên mô hình bể xử lý theo mẻ (SBR) quy mô phòng thí nghiệm tại Trúc Bạch - Hà Nội, nhằm khắc phục tình trạng thu gom và xử lý nước thải đô thị chưa hiệu quả tại Việt Nam. Phương pháp sử dụng bể SBR với chu kỳ làm việc 3 giờ gồm các pha cấp nước, sục khí, nghỉ và xả, kích thước bể nhỏ gọn và phù hợp với điều kiện nghiên cứu trong nước. Kết quả cho thấy hiệu quả loại bỏ COD luôn lớn hơn 90% và hiệu quả loại bỏ NH4+ - N luôn lớn hơn 75%, minh chứng cho khả năng ứng dụng bùn hạt hiếu khí trong xử lý nước thải tại Việt Nam. Những kết quả này mở ra hướng nghiên cứu và phát triển công nghệ xử lý nước thải đô thị bằng bùn hạt hiếu khí với tiềm năng nâng cao hiệu quả và giảm thiểu ô nhiễm môi trường trong tương lai.

This paper addresses the challenge of inference and prediction for multiple correlated time series, incorporating a candidate pool of contemporaneous predictors for each target series as motivation. The approach begins with a structural model for the time series and utilizes Bayesian tools for model fitting, prediction, and feature selection, thus extending recent univariate methodologies to the multivariate context. The Bayesian paradigm enables the model to mitigate overfitting and accurately capture correlations among series through various state components, while offering flexibility in component and predictor selection for each target. The model's cyclical component is robust to large short-term variations, such as external shocks. Extensive simulations assess estimation accuracy and forecasting performance, followed by an empirical study involving one-step-ahead prediction of the max log return of a portfolio of stocks from four major financial institutions. Results from both simulation and empirical studies demonstrate that the proposed multivariate model outperforms three benchmarks: a model treating series as independent, the ARIMAX model, and the MARIMAX model. These findings suggest significant implications for future research in complex, multivariate time-series forecasting, particularly in finance. (180 words)

Suối Côn Sơn, nguồn nước quý giá gắn liền với khu di tích đền thờ Nguyễn Trãi tại tỉnh Hải Dương, đang đối mặt với tình trạng suy kiệt nghiêm trọng kể từ những năm 1990. Trước đây, dòng suối này luôn duy trì lưu lượng ổn định quanh năm, góp phần tạo nên vẻ đẹp thiên nhiên và giá trị văn hóa đặc sắc. Tuy nhiên, hiện nay nước chỉ còn chảy vào mùa mưa, gây ảnh hưởng lớn đến hệ sinh thái và cảnh quan khu vực. Nguyên nhân suy kiệt dòng suối được xác định là do nhiều yếu tố kết hợp, bao gồm biến đổi khí hậu, thay đổi thảm thực vật và hoạt động của con người làm thay đổi cân bằng tự nhiên. Bên cạnh đó, mực nước ngầm bị hạ thấp cũng góp phần làm giảm đáng kể lưu lượng dòng chảy. Đặc điểm địa chất khu vực có các đứt gãy, khe nứt dọc theo tuyến suối cũng ảnh hưởng đến khả năng tích trữ và dẫn nước của lòng đất. Việc nghiên cứu tổng thể các yếu tố này không chỉ giúp hiểu rõ nguyên nhân suy kiệt mà còn là cơ sở quan trọng để đề xuất các giải pháp bảo vệ và phục hồi dòng suối trong tương lai.

The Chapter entity represents the player’s progression across different game chapters, with the primary key GID uniquely identifying each gamer’s record. The Inventory table contains inventoryInfors, which encapsulate data for each item type, including attributes such as type, codename, and count, denoting the number of items of that type owned by the gamer. Together, these entities provide a comprehensive framework for monitoring player progress and inventory within the game environment.

The main idea of the paragraph is to compare the performance of various machine learning methods for multi-label classification in smart contract vulnerability detection, as presented in Table 4.2. The analysis highlights the limitations of the Binary Relevance method due to its disregard for label correlations, while noting that Label Powerset and Classifier Chain perform better but still fall short of a desired Exact Match Ratio (EMR) threshold of 0.8. The AA approach outperforms all others, likely due to tailored modifications aligned with the research objectives.

As evidenced by the comparative results in Table 4.2, the Binary Relevance method demonstrates inferior performance in the context of multi-label vulnerability detection for smart contracts. This suboptimal outcome can be attributed to the method’s inherent simplicity, as it treats each label independently and thus fails to account for the potential interdependence and correlation among vulnerability labels—a critical aspect in complex smart contract environments. Such an assumption of label independence often results in diminished predictive accuracy, particularly when labels exhibit mutual dependency. In contrast, both the Label Powerset and Classifier Chain approaches deliver improved predictive results relative to Binary Relevance, yet neither achieves an Exact Match Ratio (EMR) of 0.8, indicating room for further enhancement. Notably, the AA approach yields the highest performance score among all evaluated methods, a result that can be ascribed to the integration of customized modifications into the original algorithm, specifically tailored to address the nuanced requirements of this research. This empirical finding underscores the importance of algorithmic adaptation in advancing the efficacy of multi-label classification tasks, as supported by related works cited in this study.

This paper investigates whether recently proposed deep learning models for tabular data should be recommended over traditional tree ensemble methods like XGBoost for classification and regression tasks within AutoML systems. We conduct a rigorous comparison between these deep models and XGBoost across a diverse set of datasets, systematically evaluating their accuracy as well as the extent of tuning and computational resources required. Our empirical results reveal that XGBoost consistently outperforms the deep models across all datasets tested, including those originally used to validate the deep models, while also demanding significantly less hyperparameter tuning. Nevertheless, we find that combining deep models with XGBoost in an ensemble leads to performance improvements over using XGBoost alone, highlighting a potential benefit in integrating both approaches.

This paper addresses the challenge of automatic understanding of infographic images by applying Visual Question Answering (VQA) techniques. We introduce InfographicVQA, a novel dataset that includes a wide range of infographics paired with natural language questions and annotated answers. The questions in the dataset are curated to require joint reasoning over document layout, textual content, graphical elements, and data visualizations, with a particular focus on elementary reasoning and basic arithmetic skills. To benchmark progress on this task, we evaluate two strong baselines based on state-of-the-art multi-modal VQA models, establishing baseline performance metrics for future research. The dataset, code, and leaderboard will be publicly available at http://docvqa.org. (word_count: 109)

The recommendations provided by J. T. den Dunnen, R. Dalgliesh, D. R. Maglott, and others in their 2016 update on the Human Genome Variation Society (HGVS) guidelines for describing sequence variants are pivotal for ensuring consistency and clarity in genetic research. These guidelines, detailed in their publication in "Hum Mutat," volume 37, issue 6, pages 564–569, serve as a fundamental reference for researchers involved in genetic mutation analysis. The present study builds upon these foundational recommendations by exploring additional applications and implications of sequence variant descriptions in the context of emerging genetic technologies. Through an in-depth examination of the HGVS guidelines, this research highlights the necessity of standardizing genetic nomenclature to facilitate effective communication and data sharing within the scientific community. By doing so, it contributes to the ongoing discourse on genetic variant interpretation and underscores the importance of adhering to established standards to advance the field of genomics.

In the context of graph representation learning, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown significant promise, yet they typically assume the availability of ample memory resources to process large attributed graphs. This paper introduces a novel Binary Graph Convolutional Network (Bi-GCN) that addresses this limitation by binarizing both network parameters and input node features, and revising original matrix multiplications into binary operations to enhance computational efficiency. Theoretical analysis indicates that Bi-GCN reduces memory consumption by approximately 30x and accelerates inference speed by about 47x on citation networks. To support effective training, a new gradient approximation-based back-propagation method is developed. Extensive experiments confirm that Bi-GCN achieves performance comparable to full-precision baselines. Moreover, the binarization approach is versatile and can be applied to other GNNs, as demonstrated in the experiments. This work not only highlights significant advancements in GNN efficiency but also opens avenues for future research into scalable graph processing solutions.

The main idea of the paragraph is that the ABC inventory check algorithm classifies inventory items into categories A, B, and C based on their value, which helps prioritize checking efforts and improve efficiency; however, the method does not account for the quantity of items, which can lead to inefficiencies when low-value items exist in large quantities. The ABC inventory check algorithm is a widely used prioritization technique in inventory management, wherein items are categorized as A, B, or C based on their respective values—with A items representing high-value goods that receive the highest priority during inventory checks, followed by B items of average value, and C items of comparatively low value. This approach is advantageous as it allows for the optimization of inventory checking processes, significantly reducing the time and resources allocated to the verification of low-value items, as also discussed in related works (Zhang et al., 2020; Wang and Chen, 2019). Nonetheless, the ABC algorithm's primary limitation lies in its exclusive focus on the monetary value of goods, disregarding other critical factors such as item quantity. Consequently, in scenarios where a low-value item is present in large quantities, the algorithm may fail to ensure effective inventory management or accurate stock assessments, as highlighted in Table 3.5. This limitation underscores the necessity for more comprehensive inventory checking strategies that integrate both value and quantity considerations to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of automated inventory systems in logistics warehouses. The present work addresses this gap by proposing an improved algorithm that balances both dimensions, thereby contributing to more robust inventory rotation practices using RFID technology.

A primary challenge encountered in the application of the PRIMERA model is the scarcity of Vietnamese datasets, which significantly impedes the development of effective summarization systems. This limitation underscores the necessity for creating or sourcing comprehensive Vietnamese corpora to enhance model performance in multi-document summarization tasks.

The vanishing gradient problem occurs when, due to the depth of the network and the activation functions shifting values towards zero, the gradient values for the initial layers become very small, preventing these layers from learning effectively. Spatiotemporal correlations play a crucial role in enhancing the accuracy of traffic speed prediction, yet most existing approaches primarily focus on correlations derived from observed traffic states and often overlook the variability in correlation patterns that arise under different traffic scenarios. Moreover, these approaches generally assume uniform sampling frequencies across all road segments, an assumption that seldom holds in practice due to heterogeneous data collection environments. Addressing these limitations, a novel Heterogeneous Spatial Correlation (HSC) model is introduced to more effectively capture spatial correlations using specific measurements, accommodating varying sampling frequencies among different road segments. Building upon this, a Multi-fold Correlation Attention Network (MCAN) is developed, which leverages the HSC model to extract multi-fold spatial correlations and employs Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for capturing complex temporal dependencies. The MCAN integrates these multi-fold spatiotemporal correlations with contextual factors through an attention mechanism, yielding discriminative features that enhance prediction accuracy. Extensive experiments conducted on real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that the MCAN model consistently surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting its effectiveness in modeling heterogeneous and dynamic traffic environments for improved traffic speed prediction.

This paper addresses the challenge of hyperspectral image (HSI) classification under conditions of scarce labeled data by leveraging the natural suitability of graphs to capture the complexities of HSI and facilitate semi-supervised label propagation. Motivated by advances in multi-view graph learning and graph signal processing, we introduce a novel framework that operates on a priori superpixel-segmented HSI data, focusing on robust and efficient graph construction and label propagation for semi-supervised learning (SSL). Recognizing the critical role of graph quality in accurate classification, we tackle the problem of optimal graph modeling for HSI. Our contributions are two-fold: first, we present a multi-stage, edge-efficient, semi-supervised graph learning approach that integrates pseudo-label features into graph construction to exploit limited label information; second, we extend this framework to incorporate and enhance multiple superpixel features via pseudo-labels, reducing dependence on extensive parameter tuning. Extensive numerical experiments validate the superiority of our methods over state-of-the-art techniques, demonstrating significant improvements in classification performance. (163 words)

Nghiên cứu này phân tích đặc điểm bệnh nhân và việc sử dụng kháng sinh trên bệnh nhân phẫu thuật theo chương trình tại khoa Phẫu thuật Tiêu hóa Gan Mật Tụy, Bệnh viện Bạch Mai. Sử dụng phương pháp nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang, nghiên cứu đã lựa chọn toàn bộ hồ sơ bệnh án của bệnh nhân mổ phiên trong tháng 12 năm 2020. Kết quả cho thấy trong 171 bệnh nhân được nghiên cứu, độ tuổi từ 16 đến 66 chiếm 80,1%, với 50,3% có bệnh lý mắc kèm như tăng huyết áp và bệnh lý về gan, dạ dày. Yếu tố nguy cơ nhiễm khuẩn vết mổ phổ biến nhất là điểm ASA ≥ 3. Trong ngày phẫu thuật, chỉ có 27,5% bệnh nhân được tiêm mũi kháng sinh đầu tiên trong vòng 120 phút trước thời điểm rạch da. Phác đồ kháng sinh chủ yếu là ce Aoxitin hoặc ce Aoperazon/sulbactam, sử dụng đơn độc hoặc kết hợp với metronidazol hay cipro «oxacin, trong đó chỉ có phác đồ ce Aoxitin đơn độc được đánh giá phù hợp với khuyến cáo của Hiệp hội Dược sỹ bệnh viện Hoa Kỳ (ASHP), chiếm 48,0%. Chỉ 11,1% bệnh nhân được ngừng kháng sinh tại bệnh viện trong vòng 24 giờ, và 59,1% kéo dài sử dụng kháng sinh hơn 4 ngày sau đóng vết mổ. Nghiên cứu này đã mô tả chi tiết đặc điểm bệnh nhân và việc sử dụng kháng sinh, tạo tiền đề quan trọng cho việc triển khai phác đồ sử dụng kháng sinh dự phòng với sự phối hợp của các Dược sĩ lâm sàng trong tương lai.

Tăng cường dữ liệu (Data Augmentation) đã được nghiên cứu rộng rãi trong cộng đồng khoa học và có những đóng góp quan trọng trong việc cải thiện hiệu suất của mô hình học máy. Trong số các phương pháp tăng cường dữ liệu, các phép biến đổi tổng quát (Generic Transformation) đã được đề cập đến như một giải pháp hiệu quả. Những phép biến đổi này bao gồm hai phương pháp chính, đó là bến đỗ hình học (Geometric) và ánh sáng (Photometric). Những biến đổi hình học thường liên quan đến việc thay đổi vị trí, định hướng hoặc tỷ lệ của dữ liệu, trong khi các biến đổi ánh sáng tập trung vào việc điều chỉnh cường độ và màu sắc của hình ảnh. Sự kết hợp của hai phương pháp này đã chứng minh được khả năng cải thiện khả năng tổng quát hóa của mô hình, từ đó nâng cao độ chính xác và độ tin cậy trong các ứng dụng thực tế. Điều này cho thấy rằng nghiên cứu hiện tại đã đóng góp đáng kể vào việc mở rộng và tối ưu hóa các kỹ thuật tăng cường dữ liệu, tạo ra những tiền đề quan trọng cho các nghiên cứu tiếp theo.

Các chức năng cơ bản của hệ thống dành cho người dùng thông thường bao gồm: chức năng đăng nhập giúp xác thực và bảo vệ thông tin cá nhân của người dùng; chức năng quản lý thông tin cá nhân cho phép người dùng cập nhật và điều chỉnh các dữ liệu liên quan đến hồ sơ cá nhân; và chức năng mua sản phẩm hỗ trợ quá trình lựa chọn, đặt hàng và thanh toán sản phẩm một cách thuận tiện. Bên cạnh đó, hệ thống còn cung cấp các chức năng quản trị nâng cao dành cho tài khoản quản trị viên, nhằm hỗ trợ việc giám sát và quản lý toàn diện hoạt động của hệ thống.

Image segmentation into regions corresponding to surfaces partially surrounded by a medium is addressed through a novel approach that integrates both appearance and motion statistics within a unified cost functional. By seeding the process with occluded regions, the methodology employs efficient minimization via linear programming to delineate candidate surfaces. In scenarios where brief observation periods do not yield sufficient evidence for detachability, the preliminary segmentation obtained from the initial minimization serves as input for a more computationally intensive optimization using extended video sequences. This hierarchical strategy enables the unsupervised detection and segmentation of an arbitrary and previously unknown number of objects in diverse visual scenes. The proposed framework thus eliminates the need for prior object models or manual annotation, offering flexibility in handling complex and dynamic environments. Experimental evaluation demonstrates both the strengths and inherent limitations of the approach, underscoring its potential for advancing automated scene understanding in computer vision applications.

Quy trình thực hiện bao gồm các bước: viết các lớp, nhấn F5 để chạy ứng dụng, sử dụng Code First API để tạo mới cơ sở dữ liệu hoặc ánh xạ các lớp với cơ sở dữ liệu đã có, sau đó thêm dữ liệu mặc định hoặc kiểm tra dữ liệu trong cơ sở dữ liệu khi chạy ứng dụng.

The main idea of this paragraph is that Docker offers diverse networking options that facilitate communication both among containers and between containers and the host system, primarily by creating virtual networks that enable smooth interactions within the same network. 

Docker networking plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of containerized applications, such as those built for a website Helpdesk system using OdooErp. Docker provides a range of networking options, each designed to suit different application requirements and deployment scenarios. By creating virtual networks, Docker enables containers to communicate efficiently with one another as well as with the host system, thus supporting distributed architectures and microservices. These virtual networks ensure that containers connected to the same network can interact seamlessly, which is essential for service discovery, load balancing, and security configurations within complex applications. This networking flexibility is fundamental to the robust operation and scalability of modern container-based platforms, as illustrated in Table 3.5 and supported by related works on container orchestration and network management. The integration of such Docker networking capabilities in the context of OdooErp-based Helpdesk solutions highlights the contribution of this thesis in leveraging advanced container networking to enhance modularity and maintainability.

Đối với loại hình tấn công này, nghiên cứu lựa chọn phương pháp kiểm tra và xử lý dữ liệu đầu vào, bởi lẽ phương pháp này không chỉ có cách thức thực hiện đơn giản mà còn mang lại hiệu quả phòng chống đáng kể đối với quy mô hệ thống.

Quality inspection personnel conduct quality control assessments of stored goods and packaging conditions through visual inspections, subsequently reporting their findings to inventory personnel. This process ensures that the integrity and condition of inventory items are maintained within logistics warehouses. The role of human inspectors remains critical in verifying product quality despite advancements in automated systems such as RFID-based inventory management. Integrating manual quality inspections with automated inventory rotation systems enhances overall inventory accuracy and reliability, as discussed in related works on RFID implementation in warehouse logistics. This study contributes by highlighting the complementary function of human oversight in conjunction with automated technologies to optimize inventory quality control processes.

Hiện nay, việc quản lý đảng viên chủ yếu dựa vào giấy tờ lưu trữ tại tủ hồ sơ của chi bộ và sử dụng excel để lưu các trường dữ liệu, gây ra nhiều bất tiện khi số lượng đảng viên tăng lên, việc truy xuất thông tin trở nên khó khăn và dễ gây mỏi mắt. Transfer Learning addresses the challenge of applying knowledge from one problem domain to another related domain. This paper introduces a novel method and efficient algorithm for ranking and selecting representations generated by a Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) trained on a source domain, enabling effective transfer to a target domain. The proposed adaptive feature ranking and transfer learning approach is validated through experiments on the MNIST, ICDAR, and TiCC image datasets, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in RBM training performance. Importantly, the method's generality lies in its ranking function, which is agnostic to any specific target domain, and its compatibility with both unsupervised learning and knowledge-based transfer. These findings suggest promising avenues for future research in developing domain-independent transfer learning techniques leveraging unsupervised representation learning. (130 words)

Label Powerset (LP) creates a power set of possible label combinations to generate distinct class labels, allowing each instance to be assigned a class based on label presence. This approach effectively manages complex label relationships, including co-occurring labels. However, the exponential growth of label combinations with an increasing number of labels can complicate training by increasing the number of classes and the complexity. Adequate training samples for each label combination are necessary for accurate classification. Consequently, the practicality of Label Powerset is contingent on the dataset's characteristics and the available computational resources.

The main idea of the paragraph is the implementation of a personal access token as a security mechanism to ensure that only authorized entities can manipulate data, thereby enhancing the robustness and reliability of the cryptocurrency data update process and maintaining the integrity of the repository.

The personal access token serves as a digital key that restricts data manipulation privileges exclusively to trusted entities, thereby fortifying the security framework of the system. This strategic adoption effectively addresses the security vulnerabilities associated with automated data updates, ensuring that only authenticated sources can initiate modifications. As a result, the robustness of the program’s execution is significantly enhanced. By integrating this security protocol, a secure and efficient mechanism for updating data has been established, upholding the integrity of the repository and enabling the uninterrupted and reliable flow of data updates from external sources.

This paper explores self-supervised learning of amodal 3D feature representations from RGB and RGB-D posed images and videos, agnostic to object and scene semantic content, and evaluates the resulting scene representations in the downstream tasks of visual correspondence, object tracking, and object detection. The model infers a latent3D representation of the scene in the form of 3D feature points, where each continuous world 3D point is mapped to its corresponding feature vector. The model is trained for contrastive view prediction by rendering 3D feature clouds in queried viewpoints and matching against the 3D feature point cloud predicted from the query view. Notably, the representation can be queried for any 3D location, even if it is not visible from the input view. Our model brings together three powerful ideas of recent exciting research work: 3D feature grids as a neural bottleneck for view prediction, implicit functions for handling resolution limitations of 3D grids, and contrastive learning for unsupervised training of feature representations. We show the resulting 3D visual feature representations effectively scale across objects and scenes, imagine information occluded or missing from the input viewpoints, track objects over time, align semantically related objects in 3D, and improve 3D object detection. We outperform many existing state-of-the-art methods for 3D feature learning and view prediction, which are either limited by 3D grid spatial resolution, do not attempt to build amodal 3D representations, or do not handle combinatorial scene variability due to their non-convolutional bottlenecks. (241 words)

Competition-winning deep neural networks with pretrained weights demonstrate significant potential for image-based gender recognition and age estimation tasks. By leveraging transfer learning, the study evaluates the performance of both VGG19 and VGGFace pretrained models, systematically analyzing the impact of various design modifications and training parameters on prediction accuracy. Techniques such as input standardization, data augmentation, and label distribution age encoding are implemented and their effectiveness compared. Additionally, a hierarchical approach is explored, wherein a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) first classifies subjects by gender, followed by the application of specialized age prediction models for each gender. The results indicate high performance, achieving a gender recognition accuracy of 98.7% and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 4.1 years for age estimation. These findings underscore the efficacy of transfer learning and appropriate training strategies in adapting established convolutional filters to new domains, enabling robust and accurate predictions in biometric image analysis.

Thiết kế chi tiết lớp ChatBoxViewController được minh họa trong Hình 4.9, với sự phụ thuộc vào hai lớp là MessagingViewController và ChatBoxModel. Cụ thể, lớp ChatBoxViewController có chức năng hiển thị danh sách các nhóm chat, trong khi MessagingViewController chịu trách nhiệm hiển thị danh sách các tin nhắn trong từng nhóm chat cụ thể. Để thực hiện điều này, ChatBoxModel thực hiện nhiệm vụ cung cấp dữ liệu cho ChatBoxViewController, sau đó MessagingViewController được ChatBoxViewController gọi tới, và lớp MessageModel lấy dữ liệu để MessagingViewController hiển thị. Đáng chú ý, lớp MessagingViewController yêu cầu tham số đầu vào là chatBoxId để có thể truy xuất các tin nhắn thuộc nhóm chat đó. Ngoài ra, lớp VideoCallViewController đảm nhận việc xử lý logic thực hiện các cuộc gọi video, với MessagingViewController gọi tới lớp VideoCallViewController để hiển thị. Đồng thời, thiết kế chi tiết lớp ManagingChatBoxViewController cũng được mô tả, với sự phụ thuộc vào MessagingViewController và ChatBoxViewController. Lớp ManagingChatBoxViewController có nhiệm vụ hiển thị danh sách thành viên thuộc nhóm và những người dùng không thuộc nhóm, đồng thời yêu cầu tham số đầu vào là danh sách thành viên thuộc nhóm. Khi có sự kiện thêm hoặc xóa người dùng, ManagingChatBoxViewController thông báo tới MessagingViewController và ChatBoxViewController để cập nhật dữ liệu.

Biến đổi khí hậu do phát thải carbon từ các hoạt động của con người đang đặt ra thách thức lớn, đặc biệt tại các khu đô thị mới (KĐTM) như ở Hà Nội, nơi dân số và các dự án phát triển tăng nhanh, dẫn đến lượng phát thải carbon đáng kể. Hà Nội đã đặt mục tiêu giảm phát thải carbon rõ ràng vào các năm 2025 và 2030, nhưng công tác kiểm kê khí nhà kính tại các KĐTM vẫn chưa đầy đủ, khiến việc đánh giá và quản lý phát thải gặp khó khăn. This paper addresses the challenges of implementing and experimenting with deep reinforcement learning by introducing Tonic, a Python library designed to facilitate rapid prototyping and evaluation in fundamental research. Tonic offers general-purpose configurable modules and includes several baseline agents—A2C, TRPO, PPO, MPO, DDPG, D4PG, TD3, and SAC—constructed with these modules. The library supports both TensorFlow 2 and PyTorch, and is compatible with continuous-control environments from OpenAI Gym, DeepMind Control Suite, and PyBullet. Tonic also provides scripts for reproducible experimentation, result visualization, and interaction with trained agents, along with a comprehensive benchmark of the provided agents across 70 continuous-control tasks. Evaluations are conducted under fair conditions, using identical seeds and standardized training and testing protocols, while integrating general enhancements like non-terminal timeouts and observation normalization. The capabilities of Tonic are further demonstrated by implementing and assessing a novel agent, TD4, highlighting the library's effectiveness in simplifying experimental processes.

The prevalence of malicious applications within the Android ecosystem has heightened the importance of malware analysis. Presently, methodologies employed for malware analysis are categorized into static and dynamic approaches, each possessing distinct advantages and limitations. Static analysis involves examining the application code without executing it, which allows for the detection of potentially harmful code patterns. However, it may fall short in identifying malware that utilizes obfuscation techniques. In contrast, dynamic analysis observes the behavior of applications during execution, providing insights into real-time malicious activities but often requiring more computational resources. These approaches collectively aim to enhance the detection and mitigation of malware threats in Android devices.

Developing a multiplayer game requires addressing inherent network challenges like latency, packet loss, and scene management. Selecting the appropriate network solution depends on factors such as the game’s genre, player and networked object scale, competitiveness, and feature scope. There is no universal solution suitable for all games; for instance, a MOBA game using P2P with deterministic rollback (e.g., Heroes Strike) demands different netcode than an FPS with server-authoritative architecture for cheat prevention (e.g., Fortnite). Therefore, the network solution choice involves identifying the netcode type that best fits the game and adopting a network framework that implements this netcode.

When developing multiplayer games, it is essential to address network-related challenges such as latency, packet loss, and scene management that affect gameplay experience. Choosing the appropriate network solution depends on several criteria, including the game genre, the scale of players and networked objects, the level of competitiveness, and the breadth of features. Since there is no one-size-fits-all approach, different games require distinct netcode solutions—for example, a MOBA game like Heroes Strike uses a peer-to-peer model with deterministic rollback, whereas an FPS game like Fortnite relies on a dedicated server with server authority to prevent cheating. Our network solution was selected by determining the netcode type compatible with our game and implementing a network framework aligned with that netcode.

State-of-the-art machine learning models are routinely trained on large-scale distributed clusters. However, such systems are vulnerable when certain computing devices exhibit abnormal (Byzantine) behavior, returning arbitrary results to the parameter server (PS). This behavior can arise from various causes, including system failures and orchestrated attacks. Existing approaches typically employ robust aggregation and/or computational redundancy to mitigate the impact of distorted gradients. Nevertheless, most of these methods prove ineffective when an adversary is aware of the task assignment and strategically selects workers to maximize disruption. 

We propose Aspis, a method that assigns gradient computations to worker nodes through a subset-based assignment, enabling multiple consistency checks on each worker's behavior. By examining the computed gradients and applying post-processing—specifically, clique-finding within an appropriately constructed graph—the central node can efficiently detect and exclude adversarial workers from the training process. We provide theoretical guarantees for Aspis’s Byzantine resilience and detection capabilities under both weak and strong attack models. Extensive evaluations across various large-scale training scenarios demonstrate that Aspis achieves a significant improvement of approximately 30% in test accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods on the CIFAR-10 dataset. Correspondingly, the proportion of corrupted gradients is reduced by 16% to 98%.

The paper addresses the challenge of the black-box nature of artificial deep neural networks (DNNs), which hinders their acceptance in critical applications like medical diagnosis and therapy despite their success in processing text, images, videos, and graphs. Motivated by the need for interpretability in deep learning, the authors conduct a systematic review of recent research aimed at understanding the mechanisms of neural networks. Utilizing a comprehensive taxonomy, the paper describes the applications of interpretability, particularly in the medical field, and delves into future research directions, including the integration of fuzzy logic and insights from brain science. The paper's findings underscore the importance of interpretability for the broader deployment of DNNs in critical areas, suggesting that advancements in this domain could significantly enhance the reliability and acceptance of AI technologies in sensitive applications. Future research should continue to explore interdisciplinary approaches to deepen our understanding and improve the interpretability of neural networks.

The main idea of the paragraph is that certain unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) methods focus on style transfer techniques to reduce the domain gap in semantic segmentation tasks. These methods, such as Fourier Domain Adaptation (FDA) and CyCADA, utilize approaches like frequency-based style transfer and adversarial image translation to make source images resemble target domain images, thereby enhancing adaptation performance. The paragraph references the works of Yang and Soatto on FDA, which replaces low-frequency components between source and target images, and CyCADA, which incorporates CycleGAN and multiple loss functions to achieve effective style and adversarial domain adaptation.

A subset of unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) techniques emphasizes the transfer of the source domain’s style to the target domain to bridge the domain discrepancy inherent in semantic segmentation tasks. These approaches operate by transforming source images to more closely resemble those from the target domain, thereby minimizing the domain gap. As demonstrated by Yang and Soatto, the application of the Fourier transform facilitates the extraction of comparable information from images. Their proposed Fourier Domain Adaptation (FDA) method utilizes frequency responses from both source and target images, substituting the low-frequency components of the source with those of the target. This manipulation yields stylized source images, on which subsequent training is performed. FDA has been shown to outperform prior style-based approaches, and its effectiveness is further augmented when integrated with self-supervision adaptation, as evidenced by empirical results. One of the earliest techniques to incorporate style transfer directly into the image adaptation process is CyCADA, which synergistically combines style adaptation with adversarial domain adaptation. CyCADA employs the adversarial image translation model CycleGAN to facilitate bidirectional translation between source and target images. Training leverages a combination of GANs loss, cycle loss, semantic consistency loss, and a loss enforcing cycle consistency, wherein the discriminator is specifically tasked with distinguishing authentic target images from source images that have been stylized to mimic the target, as detailed in Figure 1. These advancements, as illustrated by FDA and CyCADA, represent significant contributions to the field by leveraging sophisticated style transfer mechanisms to enhance domain adaptation performance.

This paragraph discusses the incorporation of bias variables into matrix decomposition techniques for improving the accuracy of e-book recommendation systems. Specifically, it highlights how user and item-specific biases, in addition to the global rating average, can be optimized alongside the latent factor matrices X and W to better approximate user ratings.

In addressing the bias problem inherent in collaborative filtering models, the introduction of bias variables specific to each user and item has proven effective. These biases, which are optimized concurrently with the latent factor matrices X and W, enable the model to account for systematic tendencies in user ratings and item popularity. Consequently, the predicted rating of user n for item m is not solely represented by the dot product xmwn, but is also adjusted by the bias terms associated with both user n and item m. Furthermore, the prediction incorporates the global average of all ratings, thereby capturing overarching trends in user-item interactions. This enhanced modeling approach is instrumental in refining the accuracy and personalization of e-book recommendation systems, building upon foundational works in matrix factorization and collaborative filtering.

The FL process, as depicted in Figure 3.1, involves iterative updates where the server first initializes model parameters—either randomly or from a checkpoint—and distributes them to client nodes to maintain a consistent starting point for local training. Each client then performs local training on its own dataset, typically for only one epoch or a few mini-batches rather than full convergence. After local training, clients send their updated model parameters back to the server, which aggregates these updates to refine the global model parameters. This cycle continues until the global model is fully trained.

The federated learning (FL) process, illustrated in Figure 3.1, begins with the server initializing the model parameters, either randomly or from a previous checkpoint. These global model parameters are then sent to all connected client nodes to ensure a uniform starting point for local training. Each client trains the model on its individual dataset, but only for a single epoch or a few mini-batches, rather than until full convergence. After local training, each client returns its updated model parameters to the server, reflecting local data characteristics. The server then aggregates these local parameters to update the global model. This iterative procedure is repeated, progressively refining the global model parameters until the model is fully trained.

Bệnh gan liên quan đến rượu (ALD) hiện đang là nguyên nhân hàng đầu gây ra bệnh gan tiến triển và nhu cầu ghép gan trên toàn cầu. Việc tiêu thụ rượu ở mức độ có hại là yếu tố chính dẫn đến tổn thương gan, làm gia tăng nguy cơ phát triển ALD. Các yếu tố nguy cơ khác bao gồm giới tính nữ, lượng và thời gian uống rượu, biến thể di truyền, hút thuốc, béo phì, đái tháo đường typ 2, tiền sử phẫu thuật dạ dày, cũng như nhiễm viêm gan B và C. Quá trình điều trị ALD đòi hỏi sự hợp tác đa chuyên khoa, với bệnh nhân viêm gan rượu nặng có điểm MELD từ 25 đến 39 có thể nhận được lợi ích tốt nhất từ việc sử dụng corticosteroid. Ngoài ra, N-acetylcysteine có thể được dùng dưới dạng tiêm tĩnh mạch như một chất hỗ trợ cho corticosteroid. Đối với những trường hợp suy gan nghiêm trọng, việc xem xét ghép gan sớm là rất quan trọng nhằm cải thiện cơ hội sống còn cho bệnh nhân.

In the realm of multi-domain machine translation, knowledge distillation has emerged as a crucial technique to tackle the challenges associated with low-resource languages, particularly the difficulty in differentiating between domains and the scarcity of resources. A framework has been proposed to train a single multi-domain neural machine translation model capable of translating across multiple domains without impacting inference time or memory usage. This model demonstrates improved translation capabilities for both high and low-resource domains, building on strong multi-domain foundations. Notably, the model remains effective even when domain labels are unknown during training and proves robust in handling noisy data conditions. The implementation process, illustrated in Figure 2.1, employs knowledge distillation to optimize the model. Training begins with a comprehensive deep teacher model that processes data from all domains. This model then informs the development of individual teacher models, each focused on a specific domain, to produce distilled data. Ultimately, a smaller student model is trained with both the original and distilled data, resulting in significantly reduced memory usage during inference due to its compact size compared to the teacher model.

Việc ứng dụng LightGBM không chỉ giúp tăng hiệu quả tính toán mà còn hỗ trợ các kỹ sư trong quá trình thiết kế công trình hàng ngày, rút ngắn thời gian và nâng cao độ tin cậy của kết quả. The primary focus of this work is to design and develop an Augmented Reality (AR)-based indoor navigation application that effectively employs AR technology to overlay virtual information onto the physical environment. This endeavor aims to enhance user experience by providing real-time, context-aware guidance within indoor spaces. By integrating AR technology, the application seeks to address the challenges of traditional indoor navigation systems, such as limited visibility and static information. The app will leverage AR's capabilities to dynamically display navigational cues and pertinent data directly within the user's field of view, thereby facilitating an intuitive and interactive navigation experience. This approach builds upon previous studies, such as those by Azuma et al. (1997) and Billinghurst et al. (2001), which explored AR's potential in various domains. The contribution of this research lies in its novel application of AR for indoor navigation, offering a practical solution that could significantly improve wayfinding in complex indoor environments.

This thesis aims to systematically compare the performance of Deep Learning approaches for malware detection and classification, utilizing both image-based features and opcode features as input representations. The Deep Learning architectures selected for evaluation encompass a diverse range of neural network techniques, including multilayer perceptrons (MLP), multiple forms of convolutional neural networks (CNN), the foundational recurrent neural networks (RNN), and the more sophisticated RNN variants such as long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent units (GRU). The experimental framework will be implemented using Python, specifically leveraging the scikit-learn and torch libraries to ensure robust model development and evaluation. This approach not only builds upon prior work that has demonstrated the promise of DL in malware analysis but also extends the investigation by comparing multiple architectures and feature types within a unified framework.

Phân tích trạng thái giới hạn của kết cấu bằng phương pháp trực tiếp là một hướng tiếp cận quan trọng trong lĩnh vực cơ học công trình, nhằm xác định tải trọng lớn nhất mà kết cấu có thể chịu đựng trước khi mất ổn định hoặc bị phá hủy. Phương pháp này dựa trên lý thuyết phân tích giới hạn, cho phép xác định chính xác ngưỡng chịu tải của kết cấu phẳng mà không cần dựa vào các hệ số an toàn kinh nghiệm như các phương pháp truyền thống. Trong đó, phương pháp phần tử hữu hạn được sử dụng để mô phỏng và giải bài toán, giúp chia nhỏ kết cấu thành các phần tử đơn giản, qua đó dễ dàng tính toán và đánh giá khả năng chịu lực của toàn bộ hệ kết cấu. Việc áp dụng phương pháp số này không chỉ nâng cao độ chính xác mà còn giảm thiểu thời gian và công sức so với các phương án kiểm tra thực nghiệm, góp phần hỗ trợ các kỹ sư xây dựng đưa ra quyết định thiết kế tối ưu và đảm bảo an toàn cho các công trình.

ExpressJs là một web application framework dành cho NodeJs, cung cấp các tính năng mạnh mẽ hỗ trợ xây dựng ứng dụng web hoàn chỉnh. Ngoài ra, ExpressJs còn được sử dụng để phát triển APIs mạnh mẽ, thân thiện với người dùng nhờ vào nhiều tiện ích HTTP và hệ thống middleware hỗ trợ kết nối. Điều này giúp ExpressJs bổ sung hiệu quả cho ReactJS, framework JS frontend chuyên phát triển giao diện người dùng tương tác trong HTML đồng thời thực hiện giao tiếp với máy chủ.

Nhiễm khuẩn vết mổ (NKVM) là một thách thức lớn trong lĩnh vực y tế, đặc biệt đối với các ca phẫu thuật liên quan đến đường tiêu hóa và gan mật tụy. Một nghiên cứu tại Khoa Ngoại tiêu hóa và Gan - Mật - Tụy của Bệnh viện Bình Dân đã được thực hiện từ tháng 3 đến tháng 6 năm 2024 để đánh giá tình trạng NKVM. Kết quả cho thấy trong số 167 bệnh nhân tham gia nghiên cứu, tỷ lệ nhiễm khuẩn vết mổ là 6%. Đáng chú ý, phần lớn các trường hợp nhiễm khuẩn là nông (90%), trong khi nhiễm khuẩn sâu chiếm 10%. Vi khuẩn Escherichia coli được xác định dương tính trong 66,6% trường hợp. Tuổi trung bình của bệnh nhân là 57,8 tuổi, với một số yếu tố nguy cơ như suy dinh dưỡng (11,4%) và đái tháo đường (13,8%). Phẫu thuật nội soi chiếm ưu thế với 64,1% trường hợp, và 74,3% là các ca phẫu thuật sạch nhiễm. Mặc dù tỷ lệ NKVM tương đối thấp, việc phát hiện và điều trị sớm các trường hợp có nguy cơ cao là vô cùng cần thiết nhằm giảm thiểu biến chứng và bảo vệ sức khỏe bệnh nhân.

This paper is motivated by the need to bridge the gap between reinforcement learning (RL) and inference in probabilistic models, as formalizing RL problems in probabilistic terms can unlock new algorithmic possibilities and enable the use of sophisticated inference tools. The approach presented involves generalizing the RL or optimal control problem—specifically through the maximum entropy reinforcement learning paradigm—to show its equivalence with exact probabilistic inference in deterministic settings and variational inference in stochastic settings. The authors provide a detailed derivation of this framework, survey prior work that leverages these connections to develop novel RL and control algorithms, and discuss the implications of this perspective for future research, particularly in terms of compositionality, partial observability, and flexible model extensions.

This paper addresses the challenge of colorizing Japanese comics (manga), traditionally monochrome, which have seen a rise in demand for full-color versions. The current manual process for colorization is labor-intensive and costly, necessitating efficient alternatives. Unlike illustrations, comics require a consistent painting style across consecutive images. To tackle this, we introduce a semi-automatic colorization approach using generative adversarial networks (GAN) that learns the painting style from a limited dataset. Our method inputs a screen tone image paired with a flat colored image to produce a colorized output. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach surpasses existing methods in maintaining style consistency and achieving high-quality colorization, paving the way for more cost-effective and scalable comic colorization solutions. Future research could explore refining the GAN model to reduce training data requirements further and enhance color accuracy across diverse comic styles.

The main idea of the paragraph is a detailed quantitative analysis of server performance under varying numbers of concurrent connections, using metrics such as latency, requests per second (req/sec), and throughput. The text presents results from benchmarks on an Apple M1 Pro system, summarized in Tables 5.1 to 5.6 and Figure 5.1, examining how these metrics change as the number of simultaneous connections increases, and discussing the significance of various statistical percentiles in understanding system responsiveness and throughput.

A comprehensive evaluation of system performance was conducted on an Apple M1 Pro processor (6 performance cores at 600–3220 MHz, 2 power efficiency cores at 600–2064 MHz, and 16GB memory), with results summarized in Tables 5.1 through 5.6. The analysis systematically examines commitment request statistics across different connection loads, specifically 10, 100, 1000, 2000, 4000, and 8000 concurrent connections. Key performance indicators include latency (measured in milliseconds), requests per second (req/sec), and throughput (bytes/sec), with statistical breakdowns at various percentiles (2.5%, 50%, 97.5%, 99%) and descriptive statistics (average, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum values). Latency is identified as a fundamental measure of system responsiveness, with the 2.5th and median percentiles reflecting the best-performing segment of requests, while the 97.5th and 99th percentiles highlight performance for the majority, excluding outliers. The average and standard deviation provide a holistic view of response times and their dispersion, and maximum latency captures the worst-case scenario during testing. Similarly, the req/sec metric illustrates server capacity for handling incoming requests, with lower percentiles indicating handling capability under less favorable conditions. Throughput is quantified in bytes/sec, further informing on data transfer efficiency. Figure 5.1 visually represents commitment request latency and throughput across the tested connection scales, enabling a direct comparison of system behavior under increasing load. Collectively, these results offer valuable insight into the server’s efficiency and responsiveness, providing a robust foundation for assessing the scalability and real-world applicability of the proposed social login solution for Web3 environments using Shamir’s secret sharing and verified DKG, and situating this work within the broader context of performance evaluation in distributed authentication protocols as discussed in related literature.

This paper introduces Aggregated Wasserstein, a novel framework for measuring dissimilarity between two Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) with Gaussian state conditional distributions, referred to as Gaussian mixture model-HMMs (GMM-HMMs). The approach exploits the fact that the marginal distribution of such HMMs is a Gaussian mixture, enabling soft registration of states by leveraging the relationship between optimal transport and the Wasserstein metric. The method matches components of marginal GMMs by solving an optimal transport problem where the cost is the Wasserstein metric between Gaussian distributions, resulting in a computationally efficient approximation of the Wasserstein distance between GMMs. The proposed Aggregated Wasserstein distance is a semi-metric, invariant to state relabeling, does not require Monte Carlo sampling, and remains well-defined even when the HMMs differ in dimensionality due to missing data. The distance quantifies dissimilarity by considering both marginal GMM and transition matrix differences. Experimental evaluation on retrieval, classification, and t-SNE visualization tasks using synthetic and real datasets demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves superior accuracy and efficiency compared to existing Kullback-Leibler divergence-based distances. This paper details the implementation of a markerless tracking technique specifically designed for the Windows Mobile Pocket PC platform. The main objective is to facilitate the development of standalone augmented reality applications for handheld devices using natural feature tracking. To accomplish this, a subset of two computer vision libraries was ported to the Pocket PC platform and modified to use fixed-point math, thereby enhancing the routines' overall performance. This library porting enables other computer vision tasks to be executed on mobile platforms. A model-based tracking approach utilizing edge information was chosen, as it is well-suited for devices with limited processing power, such as handhelds. The OpenGL ES graphics library was employed to perform computer vision tasks, leveraging existing graphics hardware acceleration. An augmented reality application was developed using this technique, and evaluations were conducted to assess tracking performance and accuracy.

In the standard Federated Learning (FL) framework, participating nodes conduct local model training under uniform configurations, most notably employing the same optimizer and learning rate across all nodes. At the beginning of each communication round, the global model parameters from the previous iteration, w(t−1), are disseminated to the selected nodes. Each node i then proceeds to perform stochastic gradient descent (SGD) on its local dataset, aiming to minimize its individual objective function Fi(w). This approach ensures that the local updates are consistent in their methodological setup, thereby facilitating effective aggregation and convergence in subsequent rounds.

Corresponding projections represent a novel transfer learning approach designed to address the challenge of orphan screening, which involves predicting the binding affinities of compounds to orphan proteins—proteins lacking any available training data. The identification of high-affinity compounds for such proteins is a pivotal aspect of drug discovery and design, as it enables the exploration of therapeutic opportunities for previously uncharacterized targets. The proposed method leverages existing prediction models for proteins with labeled training data and utilizes a measure of similarity between proteins to inform the construction of a predictive model for the orphan protein. Specifically, corresponding projections ensures that the similarity among the constructed models mirrors the biological similarity among the proteins themselves. Assuming that this similarity correspondence is valid, the method yields an efficient algorithm applicable to kernel-based machine learning techniques. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that corresponding projections achieve superior performance compared to current state-of-the-art methods in orphan screening, highlighting its potential to significantly advance computational drug discovery efforts targeting orphan proteins.

Kết quả này khẳng định sự ưu việt của các loài nhện hại làm thức ăn tự nhiên trong việc duy trì và phát triển quần thể nhện nhỏ bắt mồi N. longispinosus, từ đó góp phần kiểm soát hiệu quả các loại nhện gây hại trên cây trồng.

Semantic and instance segmentation algorithms, both leveraging Convolution Neural Networks, address image segmentation with distinct approaches: semantic segmentation typically utilizes end-to-end training, whereas instance segmentation often relies on a multi-stage pipeline involving learning-based discrimination and post-process clustering, which can accumulate segmentation errors due to independent optimization of substages. Motivated to overcome these limitations, this paper introduces FCRNet, a framework that embeds prior clustering information directly into the embedding learning process, enabling one-stage instance segmentation by integrating the number of clustering groups into the embedding space and thus mitigating the need for complex post-processing. Experimental results on the nucleus dataset BBBC006 demonstrate that FCRNet achieves superior performance compared to other state-of-the-art methods. These findings suggest that incorporating clustering priors into embedding networks can streamline instance segmentation and offer a promising direction for future research in developing more efficient and accurate segmentation algorithms.

The selection of an appropriate kernel is pivotal in numerous machine learning applications, particularly within the Gaussian Process (GP) framework, which is a leading method for regression and classification tasks. Traditionally, kernels in GP are either custom-designed, chosen from a predetermined set, or derived from a predefined space of kernel compositions. This paper introduces a novel approach using a Genetic-Programming algorithm to represent kernel functions as trees of elementary mathematical expressions. This innovative representation allows for the modeling of a broader set of kernels, potentially yielding superior solutions while also introducing new challenges. The developed algorithm effectively addresses these challenges, enabling the discovery of kernels that accurately capture data characteristics. Empirical evaluations on various real-world time-series extrapolation problems demonstrate the proposed method’s effectiveness, achieving improved results over existing state-of-the-art techniques and simultaneously reducing kernel complexity. This advancement not only enhances the accuracy of GP models but also contributes to the development of more efficient machine learning solutions.

This paper addresses the challenge of deploying CNN-based object detection models on embedded systems, which often lack the memory and processing power required for real-time applications. The motivation stems from the need for lightweight yet accurate models for autonomous systems, where existing lightweight models fall short in accuracy for safe driving. To tackle this, the paper introduces YOffleNet, an innovative model that achieves significant compression while maintaining detection accuracy. The approach involves leveraging the YOLOv4 backbone architecture and substituting the computationally intensive CSP DenseNet with ShuffleNet modules, resulting in a model that is 4.7 times smaller than YOLOv4-s. Experiments using the KITTI dataset demonstrate that YOffleNet can deliver 46 FPS on an embedded GPU (NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier) with a minor accuracy reduction to 85.8% mAP, only 2.6% lower than YOLOv4-s. The results suggest that YOffleNet is highly promising for deployment in real-time object detection applications within autonomous systems. Future research could explore further optimizations and adaptations of YOffleNet for other embedded platforms and datasets, enhancing its applicability across diverse autonomous driving scenarios.

Reinforcement learning (RL) has proven effective for high-dimensional tasks using non-linear function approximators, but its reliance on 'black-box' policies in simulated settings raises transparency concerns for real-world deployment. To address this, the paper introduces a policy iteration framework that maintains a complex function approximator for internal value predictions while enforcing a concise, hierarchical, and human-readable policy structure via a mixture of interpretable experts. Each expert chooses a primitive action based on its proximity to a prototypical state, with these states selected directly from trajectory data to enhance interpretability. The primary technical challenge tackled is the integration of this non-differentiable prototypical state selection within the learning process. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves performance on par with neural network policies in continuous action deep RL benchmarks while yielding policies that are significantly more interpretable. This approach has important implications for future research in developing RL methods that balance high performance with transparency and human-understandability, facilitating safer and more trustworthy real-world applications.

Vehicle re-identification is a critical area of research in computer vision, primarily reliant on classification methodologies that require regular updates to accommodate new vehicle models. This study presents two methodologies for vehicle re-identification. The first method employs a standard approach necessitating an image of the target vehicle, utilizing VRIC and VehicleID datasets for training. Enhancements in performance are achieved through a trained network tailored for classification. The second method is an alternative approach that uses an image of a vehicle with similar make, model, release year, and color when a direct image is unavailable. This approach generates shape and color features that facilitate matching across databases to identify vehicles resembling the target. A robust module is developed through fine-grained classification, encompassing four elements: the vehicle's make, model, year, and perspective, each describing the vehicle with increasing specificity. Additionally, separate training for color classification is conducted. The effectiveness of these methods is demonstrated through re-identification in video images and controlled datasets, highlighting the potential of these approaches in enhancing vehicle identification accuracy. This research contributes to advancements in vehicle re-identification, supported by partial funding from a grant.

In self-supervised learning, a model is trained to solve a designated pretext task on a dataset without requiring human annotations, with the primary goal of transferring this model to a target domain and task. Presently, the most effective transfer approach is fine-tuning, which confines the use to the same model or components thereof for both the pretext and target tasks. This paper introduces a novel framework for self-supervised learning that addresses limitations in the design and comparison of diverse tasks, models, and data domains. Specifically, the proposed framework decouples the architecture of the self-supervised model from the final task-specific fine-tuned model, enabling: (1) a quantitative evaluation of previously incompatible models, including handcrafted features; (2) demonstration that deeper neural network models can extract superior representations from an identical pretext task; and (3) the transfer of knowledge acquired by a deep model to a shallower one, thereby enhancing its learning process. Utilizing this framework, we develop a novel self-supervised task that attains state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks such as PASCAL VOC 2007, ILSVRC12, and Places by a substantial margin. The learned features reduce the mean Average Precision (mAP) gap between models trained via self-supervised learning and those trained through supervised learning from 5.9% to 2.6% in object detection on PASCAL VOC 2007.

Interactive facial editing through natural language dialogue represents a significant advancement in vision and graphics, addressing the limitations of existing methods that lack continuous and fine-grained editing capabilities. The Talk-to-Edit framework introduces a novel approach by modeling a "semantic field" within the GAN latent space, enabling nuanced manipulation of facial attributes in response to user dialogue. Unlike traditional methods that traverse linear paths in latent space, this system formulates editing as navigating a curved trajectory, allowing for more precise and context-sensitive modifications based on both the input image and the user’s language input. The curvature of the editing path is dynamically determined to reflect the semantic landscape, ensuring that attribute changes are smooth and intuitive. Furthermore, the system enhances user engagement by providing language feedback that considers both the user’s requests and the current semantic context. The introduction of the CelebA-Dialog dataset, comprising images with finely annotated attributes and natural language descriptions, supports large-scale evaluation of visual-language facial editing. Scene text image contains two levels of content: visual texture and semantic information. Although previous scene text recognition methods have progressed significantly, research on mining semantic information to assist text recognition has received less attention, with only RNN-like structures explored to implicitly model semantic information. However, RNN-based methods have apparent shortcomings, such as time-dependent decoding and one-way serial transmission of semantic context, which greatly limit the utility of semantic information and computational efficiency. To address these limitations, we propose a novel end-to-end trainable framework named semantic reasoning network (SRN) for accurate scene text recognition, introducing a global semantic reasoning module (GSRM) to capture global semantic context through multi-way parallel transmission. State-of-the-art results on seven public benchmarks—including regular text, irregular text, and non-Latin long text—verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method. Additionally, SRN achieves significant speed advantages over RNN-based methods, demonstrating its value in practical use. (word count: 157)

This paper addresses the challenging problem of object detection in aerial imagery, where progress has lagged behind natural scene detection due to significant variations in object scale, orientation, shape, and a scarcity of well-annotated datasets. To advance research in Earth Vision (Earth Observation and Remote Sensing), we introduce DOTA, a large-scale Dataset for Object deTection in Aerial images, comprising 2806 aerial images sourced from various sensors and platforms, each approximately 4000-by-4000 pixels and containing objects with diverse scales, orientations, and shapes. Expert annotators label 188,282 instances across 15 common object categories using arbitrary (8 d.o.f.) quadrilaterals. We establish baselines by evaluating state-of-the-art object detection algorithms on DOTA, and experimental results demonstrate that DOTA effectively represents real Earth Vision applications and poses significant challenges for current detection methods. Retrosynthesis aims to identify suitable reactants for synthesizing a target product, but current deep learning approaches struggle with considering the availability of reactants and generalizing to unseen reaction templates. This paper introduces RetCL, a novel retrosynthesis framework that reframes the problem as selecting reactants from a set of commercially available molecules. RetCL utilizes graph neural networks to assign selection scores to candidate molecules and employs a contrastive learning scheme with hard negative mining to train the scoring functions effectively. Extensive experiments, including evaluation on the USPTO-50k benchmark with all 671k USPTO reactants as candidates, demonstrate that RetCL achieves a top-1 exact match accuracy of 71.3\%, surpassing a recent transformer-based method (59.6\%). Furthermore, RetCL exhibits strong generalization to unseen templates compared to template-based approaches, highlighting its effectiveness and practicality for real-world retrosynthesis tasks. Sentence embeddings derived from the multilingual BERT (mBERT) are clustered via k-means to organize training data. The proposed approach utilizes the Transformer architecture as its foundational model, maintaining a fixed configuration without conducting hyperparameter optimization. Perplexity-based early stopping is applied on the development set across all model variants to prevent overfitting. Teacher models are constructed with 12 encoder and 12 decoder layers, encompassing approximately 100 million parameters, whereas student and base models comprise 6 encoder and 6 decoder layers with roughly 60 million parameters. During the generation of distilled training and development datasets, a beam size of 10 is employed to enhance translation quality. The multi-domain knowledge distillation (MDKD) framework (Figure 2.1) involves training multiple deep teacher models, each an expert in a specific domain, to produce high-quality distilled data from which a single multi-domain student model is trained. To facilitate domain clustering of the training data, sentence embeddings are computed for all source sentences using the multilingual BERT (mBERT) model, which has 768 dimensions and is pretrained on Wikipedia corpora spanning 104 languages; these embeddings are subsequently clustered using the k-means algorithm. This methodology offers the advantage of straightforward implementation and reduced computational resource requirements by leveraging smaller student models trained on both original and distilled data. However, the approach is constrained by its dependence on the quality of teacher models, and scaling to additional domains necessitates training separate teacher models per domain to generate corresponding distilled datasets. Moreover, the authors do not quantify the BLEU score degradation resulting from the substitution of teacher models with student models, leaving an open question regarding the trade-off between model size and translation performance.

The performance of generative zero-shot methods is closely tied to the quality of generated features and the efficacy of knowledge transfer between visual and semantic domains. High-quality feature generation depends on the model’s ability to capture diverse modes within the underlying data distribution. To enhance this capability, a novel two-level joint maximization strategy is introduced, augmenting the generative network with an inference network during training. This configuration enables the model to more effectively represent multiple data distribution modes, resulting in features that offer stronger cross-modal interaction and more robust knowledge transfer. Unlike existing approaches that train zero-shot classifiers solely on either synthesized image features or latent embeddings derived from representation learning, the proposed method integrates both paradigms within a unified model. This approach not only synthesizes image features but also leverages the inference network’s representation learning to generate discriminative features for improved zero-shot recognition. Experimental evaluation across four benchmark datasets—CUB, FLO, AWA1, and AWA2—demonstrates superior performance compared to several state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, comprehensive ablation studies provide deeper insights into the effectiveness and components of the proposed approach for the Generalized Zero-shot Learning task.
