Trong quá trình phát triển hệ thống, nhóm đã lựa chọn và sử dụng các công cụ, thư viện phù hợp nhằm đáp ứng yêu cầu về hiệu năng và trải nghiệm người dùng. Cụ thể, Visual Studio Code được sử dụng làm môi trường phát triển tích hợp (IDE), ngôn ngữ lập trình chính là JavaScript, và framework ReactJS được lựa chọn để xây dựng giao diện người dùng phía frontend. Ngoài ra, Material UI đóng vai trò là thư viện hỗ trợ phát triển giao diện, giúp tăng tính thẩm mỹ và nhất quán cho website. Ở phía backend, Firebase được sử dụng để quản lý dữ liệu và triển khai các chức năng liên quan đến xác thực, lưu trữ. Kết quả đạt được là hệ thống website đáp ứng tốt nhu cầu của cả khách hàng lẫn nhân viên: khách hàng có thể dễ dàng tương tác, đặt hàng trực tuyến và quản lý giỏ hàng cũng như theo dõi thông tin các món ăn; trong khi đó, nhân viên có thể quản lý hoạt động kinh doanh của cửa hàng một cách hiệu quả, trơn tru. Sự kết hợp giữa các công nghệ hiện đại và thiết kế hướng người dùng đã góp phần nâng cao trải nghiệm sử dụng, đồng thời hỗ trợ tốt cho hoạt động vận hành thực tế của cửa hàng.

The evaluation of machine translation (MT) systems often involves the automatic comparison of n-grams from generated translations with those from gold references. The BLEU metric is a widely used standard for this purpose. Recent developments suggest normalizing MT system hypotheses before BLEU score calculation. BLEU operates at the corpus level, comparing entire sets of hypotheses with reference corpora. The BLEU score is derived as the geometric mean of n-gram precisions (ranging from 1-gram to 4-grams), adjusted by a brevity penalty. This is represented as \( \exp \left( \sum_{i=1}^{4} \log(p_i) \right) \). The formula for n-gram precision, \( p_n \), is given by:

\[ p_n = \frac{\sum_{\text{hyp} \in \text{hyps}} \sum_{\text{n-gram} \in \text{n-grams}} \min(\text{Count}(\text{Ref}, \text{n-gram}), \text{Count}(\text{hyp}, \text{n-gram}))}{\sum_{\text{hyp} \in \text{hyp}} \sum_{\text{n-gram} \in \text{-grams}} \text{Count}(\text{Ref}, \text{n-gram})} \]

where \(\text{Count}(C, g)\) indicates the frequency of n-gram \(g\) in corpus \(C\).

Phần backend được triển khai bằng Apollo Server, đảm nhiệm việc xử lý các yêu cầu (request) từ phía frontend cũng như theo dõi trạng thái của các gói hàng (track package). Về kiến trúc frontend, như mô tả trong Hình 4.2, hệ thống chợ tết sử dụng cơ chế context Provider để cung cấp dữ liệu trực tiếp cho các component con mà không cần thông qua các component trung gian, đồng thời dữ liệu từ server được lấy thông qua Apollo Client. Đối với kiến trúc backend, được trình bày ở Hình 4.3, Prisma được sử dụng để tạo cơ sở dữ liệu cùng các model tương ứng dựa trên file schema định nghĩa. Khi web server nhận được yêu cầu từ client, nó sẽ chuyển tiếp request đó đến Apollo Server. Apollo Server dựa trên file schema của Drupal để xác định cách xử lý yêu cầu, sau đó chuyển tiếp đến các resolver. Các resolver chịu trách nhiệm thực thi các request từ phía client, bao gồm hai loại chính là Query (yêu cầu đọc dữ liệu) và Mutation (yêu cầu ghi dữ liệu). Cuối cùng, thông qua Prisma, các thao tác đọc và ghi dữ liệu được thực hiện tương ứng trên cơ sở dữ liệu. Về thiết kế giao diện người dùng, màn hình dashboard tổng quan (Hình 4.4) hiển thị các thống kê về lượt truy cập và số lượng người dùng; màn hình báo cáo địa lý (Hình 4.5) trình bày dữ liệu địa lý dưới dạng các biểu đồ cột, kèm theo thanh điều hướng và nút tải xuống file CSV; màn hình báo cáo công nghệ (Hình 4.6) cũng tương tự, cung cấp các biểu đồ cột về dữ liệu công nghệ cùng thanh điều hướng hỗ trợ người dùng truy cập các chức năng khác. Nghiên cứu này đã xây dựng một kiến trúc hệ thống toàn diện, kết hợp các công nghệ hiện đại như Apollo Server, Prisma và React Context, nhằm tối ưu hóa việc quản lý dữ liệu và nâng cao trải nghiệm người dùng trong hệ thống chợ tết.
RabbitMQ cung cấp một giao diện quản lý thân thiện, giúp người dùng dễ dàng giám sát và kiểm soát toàn bộ các khía cạnh của hệ thống message broker.

Trong nghiên cứu hiện tại, phương thức show Project được triển khai với kiểu trả về là ViewResult, cho phép hiển thị màn hình Project một cách rõ ràng và nhất quán. Tương tự, phương thức create Project có kiểu trả về RedirectResult, giúp chuyển hướng một cách hiệu quả sau khi hoàn tất việc tạo Project. Đối với phương thức showProduct(project_d), kiểu trả về showSuggestProductScreen được sử dụng, nhấn mạnh tính năng gợi ý sản phẩm trên màn hình. Phương thức message(project_d) cũng có kiểu trả về RedirectResult, đảm bảo việc điều hướng người dùng một cách mượt mà sau khi thông điệp được xử lý. Cuối cùng, phương thức showSaveLog(project_d) với kiểu trả về là show Full Screen, cung cấp khả năng lưu trữ và hiển thị thông tin đầy đủ trên màn hình. Nghiên cứu này không chỉ củng cố những kết quả trước đây mà còn mở rộng hiểu biết về cách quản lý các kiểu trả về, đảm bảo tính nhất quán và hiệu quả trong việc phát triển ứng dụng.

Nghiên cứu này nhằm mô tả đặc điểm lâm sàng, cận lâm sàng và tỷ lệ xuất hiện một số tự kháng thể ở bệnh nhân xơ cứng bì hệ thống (XCBHT) bằng kỹ thuật Immunoblot (ANA 23 Profile) trên 57 bệnh nhân được chẩn đoán xác định XCBHT tại Bệnh viện Da liễu Trung ương, tuân theo tiêu chuẩn ACR/EULAR 2013. Kết quả cho thấy nữ giới chiếm ưu thế với tỷ lệ nữ/nam là 5/1, tuổi khởi phát trung bình 49,3±13,3 tuổi và phần lớn bệnh nhân ở độ tuổi trên 50. Thể lan tỏa là thể lâm sàng phổ biến nhất (70%), triệu chứng Raynaud xuất hiện ở hầu hết các trường hợp (98,2%), tiếp theo là trào ngược dạ dày thực quản (86%) và xơ phổi (70,2%), trong khi tổn thương tim và thận ít gặp hơn. Tỷ lệ dương tính của các tự kháng thể chính gồm Scl-70 (63,2%), Centromerase (17,5%) và ARN Polyme III (12,3%). Đáng chú ý, kháng thể Scl-70 chủ yếu hiện diện ở thể da lan tỏa (91,7%, p<0,05), kháng thể CENP chủ yếu ở thể da khu trú (90%, p<0,05), còn kháng thể RNAP III dù chủ yếu gặp ở thể da lan tỏa (85,7%) nhưng không có ý nghĩa thống kê. Đóng góp của nghiên cứu khẳng định mối liên quan giữa kháng thể Scl-70 với thể da lan tỏa và kháng thể CENP với thể da khu trú, gợi ý giá trị định hướng trong lâm sàng và mở ra hướng nghiên cứu sâu hơn về vai trò tiên lượng cũng như chiến lược cá thể hóa điều trị dựa trên đặc điểm miễn dịch học của bệnh nhân XCBHT trong tương lai.
Sử dụng chuyển khoản Virtual Account là một phương thức thanh toán an toàn không đòi hỏi việc cung cấp thông tin cá nhân.

Viêm tai giữa mạn tính có liên quan mật thiết đến chức năng vòi nhĩ, cấu trúc quan trọng nhưng khó tiếp cận. Nghiên cứu khảo sát độ dài và góc vòi nhĩ trên CT scan ở 192 bệnh nhân từ 16 tuổi trở lên, gồm nhóm bệnh và nhóm chứng, nhằm đánh giá mối liên hệ giữa đặc điểm vòi nhĩ và viêm tai giữa mạn tính. Kết quả cho thấy chiều dài vòi nhĩ không khác biệt đáng kể giữa các nhóm, tuy nhiên góc vòi nhĩ ở nhóm viêm tai xương chũm mạn tính có cholesteatoma nhỏ hơn so với nhóm chứng, biểu hiện vòi nhĩ nằm ngang hơn. Phát hiện này góp phần làm rõ vai trò của cấu trúc vòi nhĩ trong bệnh sinh và tiến triển của viêm tai giữa mạn tính, đặc biệt với dạng có cholesteatoma, mở ra hướng nghiên cứu và quản lý bệnh hiệu quả hơn trong tương lai.
MySQL, được phát triển và hỗ trợ bởi công ty Thụy Điển MySQL AB, là một công cụ phổ biến được sử dụng rộng rãi trong nhiều ngành kinh doanh, từ các doanh nghiệp lớn đến nhỏ.

This section outlines the functionality related to user management within the Android Malware Scanner system, specifically focusing on the administrative capability to create new users, assign appropriate roles, and manage access permissions. Additionally, it introduces the feature for deleting users, indicating the actors involved and the preconditions required for these operations. The purpose of these functionalities is to ensure controlled access and secure management of user privileges within the system. In the Android Malware Scanner, the administrator is empowered to create new users, assigning roles and access permissions as necessary to regulate system usage effectively. Furthermore, the system includes functionality to delete users, with the admin serving as the primary actor responsible for this operation, contingent upon predefined preconditions to maintain system security and integrity.

ReactJS nổi bật nhờ khả năng tập trung vào các component riêng biệt. Điều này giúp developer không cần thao tác trên toàn bộ ứng dụng web mà có thể phân tách giao diện người dùng phức tạp thành những component đơn giản hơn.

Character tokenization involves breaking words into sequences of individual characters, which helps address challenges in multilingual neural machine translation (NMT) by avoiding the need for optimal sub-word segmentation across different languages. This method significantly reduces vocabulary size to a small set of characters but results in longer sequences, thereby increasing computational demands during training and decoding. Initial research on character-based NMT aimed to address out-of-vocabulary issues and the softmax bottleneck in word-level models, with various character-based model variants proposed.

The paragraph describes the process of taking a screenshot and the subsequent log display indicating whether the action was successful. 

In executing the screenshot function, the user initiates the process by selecting the 'Screenshot' button. Upon activation, the system generates a log entry to confirm whether the image capture was successful. This procedural feedback is crucial in determining the success or failure of the screenshot operation, providing real-time confirmation to the user.

Hades (Hình 2.4) là một game roguelike với đồ họa 2.5D, trong đó mỗi màn chơi diễn ra trong các phòng nhỏ được sinh ngẫu nhiên, tương tự như game Tiny Rogues. Trò chơi áp dụng cơ chế hack'n'slash với nhịp độ nhanh, kết hợp các combo kỹ năng, cùng với cốt truyện xoay quanh các vị thần Olympus và đồ họa ấn tượng. Sau mỗi màn, người chơi có thể chọn thẻ bài để nâng cấp sức mạnh hoặc vũ khí, từ đó quyết định hướng phát triển cho nhân vật ở các phòng tiếp theo. Tuy nhiên, số lượng quà (reward) trong Hades không phong phú và đa dạng bằng một số tựa game khác.

Blockchain technology offers significant advantages in terms of trust and transparency. Bitcoin facilitates peer-to-peer transactions that eliminate the need for intermediaries, thereby enhancing trust and reducing costs. Ethereum further advances blockchain by enabling programmable smart contracts, which support a variety of decentralized applications (DApps). In this paper, we introduce the Layer-Peeled Model, a nonconvex yet analytically tractable optimization program, to better understand deep neural networks trained for extended periods. This model is derived by isolating the topmost layer from the remainder of the neural network and imposing specific constraints on both parts separately. The Layer-Peeled Model, despite its simplicity, mirrors many characteristics of well-trained neural networks, offering a robust tool for elucidating and predicting common empirical patterns in deep learning training. Our study demonstrates that when applied to class-balanced datasets, any solution to this model forms a simplex equiangular tight frame, partially explaining the neural collapse phenomenon. More critically, in imbalanced cases, the model uncovers a previously unknown phenomenon termed Minority Collapse, which significantly hampers the performance of deep learning models on minority classes. Using this model, we also explore strategies for mitigating Minority Collapse, a phenomenon predicted by the Layer-Peeled Model and subsequently validated through computational experiments. These findings lay the groundwork for future research to further explore and address the limitations of deep learning models in imbalanced data scenarios.

We propose a novel algorithm to solve the expectation propagation relaxation of Bayesian inference for continuous-variable graphical models. In contrast to most previous algorithms, our method is provably convergent. By marrying convergent EP ideas from (Opper&Winther 05) with covariance decoupling techniques (Wipf&Nagarajan 08, Nickisch&Seeger 09), it runs at least an order of magnitude faster than the most commonly used EP solver. These findings demonstrate the potential for substantial gains in both efficiency and reliability in EP-based inference, suggesting promising avenues for extending this approach to larger, more complex models and for exploring further improvements in scalable Bayesian inference algorithms.

Thí nghiệm sử dụng rong sụn kích thước từ 0,25 đến 2 cm trong môi trường PES, kết hợp Indole-3-acetic acid và N6-benzyladenine. In multimodal tasks, the effectiveness of feature extraction networks is pivotal not only for capturing comprehensive information from each modality but also for ensuring strong mutual understanding between feature embeddings from different modalities. This mutual understanding is particularly crucial during feature fusion, often outweighing the importance of simply maximizing extracted information. The selection of optimal feature extraction network combinations thus emerges as a significant subproblem, yet it is frequently overlooked or addressed with exhaustive search strategies in existing research. Addressing this gap, the optimization of network selection is reframed as a comparative upper bound problem, drawing on mathematical techniques from extreme value theory to enhance computational efficiency. Furthermore, to tackle the prevalent issue of misalignment between feature similarity and semantic similarity in multimodal time-series data, a novel multimodal time-series contrastive loss (MTSC) is introduced, inspired by contrastive learning principles. Experimental results in audio-visual video parsing tasks demonstrate that the proposed methods not only streamline the selection of feature extraction networks but also substantially improve the integration and fusion of heterogeneous modal features, as evidenced by comprehensive analytical evaluations.

Semantic segmentation has been shown to effectively assist medical imaging classification tasks by reducing noise and variance within training datasets through masking and cropping input images. Nonetheless, traditional methods face obstacles: acquiring dense segmentations is costly, and identifying the most relevant input regions for classification is not straightforward. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel joint-training deep reinforcement learning framework for image augmentation. In this framework, a segmentation network—serving as an agent and weakly supervised via policy gradient optimization—produces masks as actions based on samples as states, aiming to maximize the classification network’s reward signals. This approach enables the segmentation network to learn how to mask irrelevant imaging features. Our method, Adversarial Policy Gradient Augmentation (APGA), demonstrates promising results on Stanford's MURA dataset and a hip fracture classification task, achieving up to a 7.33% increase in global accuracy and outperforming baseline methods in 9 out of 10 evaluated tasks. We also highlight the wide applicability of our joint training strategy across diverse medical imaging applications.

FastProNGS là một công cụ xử lý sơ cấp nhanh dành cho dữ liệu đọc từ công nghệ giải trình tự thế hệ mới (next generation sequencing - NGS), được phát triển bởi X. Luz và cộng sự (BMC Unformat cs, 2019). Công cụ này hỗ trợ hiệu quả các bước tiền xử lý dữ liệu như lọc, cắt tỉa và loại bỏ các trình tự adapter, từ đó nâng cao chất lượng dữ liệu đầu vào cho các phân tích downstream. Đặc biệt, FastProNGS nổi bật với tốc độ xử lý vượt trội và khả năng xử lý linh hoạt nhiều định dạng dữ liệu NGS, đáp ứng tốt yêu cầu của các nghiên cứu quy mô lớn. Tuy nhiên, hầu hết các công cụ trước đó, bao gồm FastProNGS, chủ yếu tập trung vào các chức năng tiền xử lý cơ bản mà chưa chú trọng đến khả năng tích hợp phân tích chất lượng nâng cao hoặc hỗ trợ mở rộng cho các loại dữ liệu NGS mới. Nghiên cứu hiện tại nhằm khắc phục những hạn chế này bằng cách phát triển một hệ thống xử lý và phân tích dữ liệu NGS toàn diện, tích hợp cả các mô-đun đánh giá chất lượng nâng cao và tối ưu hóa hiệu suất cho các nền tảng tính toán hiện đại, qua đó góp phần cải thiện hiệu quả và độ tin cậy trong các phân tích dữ liệu sinh học lớn.

The paragraph discusses the data preprocessing steps undertaken to prepare a Solidity source code dataset for training a language model aimed at multi-label vulnerability detection in smart contracts. Specifically, it details the conversion of source code into bytecode using solc-js, a JavaScript-based Solidity compiler, and addresses the challenge posed by multiple Solidity versions present in the dataset by employing a Monorepo architecture alongside TypeScript for compilation. This preprocessing is crucial for ensuring compatibility and consistency in the training data. In this study, the dataset comprised Solidity source code that required transformation into bytecode suitable for input into the language model. To achieve this, solc-js, a Solidity compiler implemented in JavaScript, was utilized. Given the dataset included source code spanning multiple compiler versions (from 0.4.11 to 0.8.7), a Monorepo architecture was adopted in conjunction with TypeScript to systematically compile the diverse versions. This approach facilitated efficient preprocessing and ensured the integrity and uniformity of the data used for training the vulnerability detection model.

Mô hình Client-Server tạo điều kiện cho sự phân chia nhiệm vụ rõ ràng giữa hai thành phần chính: Client và Server. Trong đó, Client chủ yếu chịu trách nhiệm về hiển thị giao diện người dùng và thực hiện các tương tác với người dùng, trong khi Server đảm nhận vai trò xử lý logic nghiệp vụ, quản lý lưu trữ dữ liệu và cung cấp các dịch vụ hỗ trợ. Sự phân tách này không chỉ giúp tối ưu hóa hiệu suất hệ thống mà còn nâng cao tính bảo mật và khả năng mở rộng, điều đã được chứng minh qua các nghiên cứu trước đây về kiến trúc phân tán (Smith et al., 2018; Nguyen, 2020). Nghiên cứu hiện tại tiếp tục phát triển mô hình này bằng cách đề xuất các giải pháp cải tiến trong việc phân phối công việc giữa Client và Server nhằm nâng cao hiệu quả và trải nghiệm người dùng trong các ứng dụng mạng phức tạp.

The main idea of this paragraph is to compare the effects of two different loss functions, LCL+CE and LCE, on model training for the first task of the FewRel and TACRED datasets. The author analyzes the learned representation space using spectral decomposition, referencing Figure 4.1, and observes that LCL+CE leads to smaller eigenvalues compared to LCE. The paragraph argues, based on reasoning in subsection 4.2, that LCE reduces the transferability of learned representations. To support this claim, the author further evaluates the CRL model with LCE on two benchmark datasets and compares its performance to the original version, with results shown in Table 5.1.

To investigate the influence of loss function choice on the learned feature representations, the model was trained on the initial task of both the FewRel and TACRED datasets utilizing two variants: LCL+CE and LCE. Subsequent analysis of the representation space was conducted through spectral decomposition. As illustrated in Figure 4.1, the model trained with LCL+CE exhibited noticeably smaller eigenvalues relative to the one trained with LCE, suggesting, as argued in subsection 4.2, that the inclusion of LCE diminishes the transferability of the resulting representations. Sparse representation is a powerful statistical image modeling technique that has been successfully applied to various image restoration tasks. Its success is largely attributed to advancements in l1-norm optimization techniques and the inherent sparsity of natural images in certain domains. The quality of image restoration relies heavily on the capability of the chosen sparse domain to accurately represent the underlying image. Given the significant variability in content across different images and even within different patches of a single image, we propose a method that learns multiple sets of bases from a pre-collected dataset of example image patches. For each image patch to be processed, an appropriate set of bases is adaptively selected to characterize the local sparse domain. Additionally, we incorporate two adaptive regularization terms into the sparse representation framework. First, a suite of autoregressive (AR) models is developed from the dataset of example patches, and the AR models that best fit a given patch are adaptively chosen to regularize local image structures. Second, the non-local self-similarity of images is introduced as another regularization term. Furthermore, the sparsity regularization parameter is adaptively estimated to enhance image restoration performance. Extensive experiments on image deblurring and super-resolution demonstrate that the proposed method, through adaptive sparse domain selection and adaptive regularization, significantly outperforms many state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of both PSNR and visual perception.

The public accessibility of blockchain transaction graphs, as exemplified by cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, offers unique opportunities for analyzing the relationship between network dynamics and price fluctuations. Traditional approaches that rely on standard graph features, such as degree distribution, often fall short in capturing the intricate mechanisms underlying these networks and their influence on market behavior. Recent research highlights the utility of advanced topological methods, specifically those based on persistent homology, in extracting higher-order structural information from blockchain transaction graphs. These topological features provide a more comprehensive characterization of the network's evolving structure and demonstrate strong predictive power regarding Bitcoin price dynamics. The application of persistent homology enables the identification of subtle patterns and interactions within the data, leading to the development of more accurate and computationally efficient models for price prediction. This approach not only advances graph representation learning in blockchain contexts but also paves the way for broader adoption of topological data analysis in financial network studies.

Probabilistic object detection represents an advancement in computer vision by emphasizing not only the identification of objects within images but also the precise quantification of both spatial and semantic uncertainties associated with these detections. Unlike traditional object detection methods that primarily focus on achieving high accuracy scores, probabilistic object detection necessitates a more nuanced evaluation of detection quality. To address the limitations of existing evaluation metrics, the Probability-based Detection Quality (PDQ) measure has been introduced. PDQ differentiates itself from commonly used average precision (AP)-based metrics by eliminating arbitrary thresholds and providing explicit assessments of spatial accuracy, label correctness, and the ability to distinguish between foreground and background, while directly penalizing false positives and false negatives. Comparative analyses involving state-of-the-art detectors and Bayesian approaches, such as those utilizing Monte Carlo Dropout, reveal that conventional detectors often exhibit spatial overconfidence, resulting in suboptimal performance under probabilistic evaluation. The development and adoption of probabilistic object detection methodologies are crucial for real-world applications, particularly in robotics and embodied artificial intelligence, where robust uncertainty estimation can significantly enhance safety and decision-making capabilities.

Several strategies can be used to address overfitting, including adopting a simpler model, expanding the training dataset, and applying regularization techniques to limit the model from capturing unnecessary details and noise.

This paper addresses the challenge of real-time, safety-critical decision making in air traffic control amidst increasingly complex and dense airspace, including both traditional and emerging aircraft types such as drones and eVTOLs. To enable safe and efficient management of high-density traffic and ensure aircraft separation, we propose a deep multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that identifies and resolves conflicts in stochastic, dynamic en-route sectors featuring multiple intersections and merging points. Our methodology employs an actor-critic model (A2C) enhanced with a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) loss function to stabilize training, and adopts a centralized learning, decentralized execution paradigm where a single neural network is shared among all agents. Extensive simulations conducted in the BlueSky environment demonstrate that our approach is both scalable and efficient, achieving extremely high throughput while maintaining safety guarantees. Key findings show that our framework successfully resolves 99.97% of conflicts at intersections and 100% at merging points in scenarios characterized by extremely high traffic density, highlighting its potential for future autonomous air traffic control systems. Time-lagged autoencoders (TAEs) have been proposed as a deep learning regression-based approach for discovering slow modes in dynamical systems. However, a rigorous analysis of nonlinear TAEs remains absent. In this work, we examine the capabilities and limitations of TAEs through both theoretical and numerical analyses. Theoretically, we derive performance bounds for nonlinear TAEs in slow mode discovery and demonstrate that, in general, TAEs learn a mixture of slow modes and modes of maximum variance. Numerically, we present cases in which TAEs succeed or fail to identify the leading slowest mode in two example systems: a two-dimensional "Washington beltway" potential and the alanine dipeptide molecule in explicit water. We further compare TAE results with those obtained using state-free reversible VAMPnets (SRVs), a variational-based neural network approach for slow mode discovery, and show that SRVs can correctly identify slow modes in scenarios where TAEs are unsuccessful.

This paper addresses the problem of feature learning in challenging domains such as speech, computer vision, and natural language processing by introducing a novel class of matrix and tensor-valued features that can be pre-trained using unlabeled samples. The methodology involves efficient algorithms for extracting discriminative information from these pre-trained features using labeled samples for related tasks. The features are based on higher-order score functions that capture local variations in the probability density function of the input. A theoretical framework is established to characterize the nature of discriminative information extractable from score-function features when combined with labeled samples. Efficient spectral decomposition algorithms on matrices and tensors are employed to extract discriminative components. A key finding is that tensor-valued features enable the extraction of richer discriminative information through overcomplete representations. The primary contribution is the development of a novel framework that utilizes generative models of the input for discriminative learning, enhancing the capacity to discern complex patterns across various domains.

We investigate the relationship between the structure of a discrete graphical model and the support of the inverse of a generalized covariance matrix, demonstrating that for certain graph structures, the support of the inverse covariance matrix of indicator variables on the vertices reflects the conditional independence structure of the graph. Extending results previously established only for multivariate Gaussian graphical models, our work addresses an open question regarding the significance of the inverse covariance matrix for non-Gaussian distributions. The proof leverages concepts from the geometry of exponential families, junction tree theory, and convex analysis. Our population-level results yield several implications for both existing and novel graph selection methods, including a new approach for structure estimation in the presence of missing or corrupted observations. We provide nonasymptotic guarantees for these methods and validate the sharpness of our predictions through simulations. (151 words)

The work of B. M. Todd and C. A. A. Soule, as documented in "Fans and Brands: Debating between Fandoms, Brand Communities, and Brand Publics," provides a comprehensive analysis of the complex interactions between fans and brands. This study, which appears in the 2020 publication "Global Branding: Breakthroughs in Research and Practice" by IGI Global, spans pages 668 to 684. It delves into the nuances of how individuals within fandoms and brand communities engage with brands, highlighting the dynamic nature of these relationships. The research contributes significantly to the understanding of brand publics by exploring the diverse ways in which fans can influence brand perceptions and vice versa. By examining these interactions, Todd and Soule offer valuable insights into the strategic implications for brand management and the cultivation of brand loyalty in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape. This study serves as a pivotal reference point for scholars and practitioners seeking to navigate the intricate web of brand-fan relationships in contemporary marketing.

Các kết cấu thủy lực như đập, đê và hồ chứa nước đóng vai trò thiết yếu trong cung cấp nước, năng lượng và kiểm soát lũ lụt, nhưng đồng thời cũng đối mặt với nguy cơ mất ổn định do hiện tượng xói ngầm. Quá trình xói ngầm gồm bốn loại chính: xói rò rỉ, xói kéo theo, xói tiếp xúc và xói hạt mịn, trong đó xói hạt mịn gây biến đổi đáng kể về đặc trưng thủy lực và cơ học của đất, làm giảm tính ổn định của kết cấu. Việc nghiên cứu tiến trình thấm và xói theo thời gian, đặc biệt trong các mẫu đất nhiều lớp với dòng chảy ngang và dòng chảy đứng, rất cần thiết để đánh giá chính xác tính an toàn của các công trình thủy lực. Mô hình nghiên cứu cần phù hợp với cấu trúc thực tế của đập, đê nhằm kiểm soát và ngăn ngừa các hiện tượng xói ngầm, góp phần nâng cao độ bền và tuổi thọ công trình, đảm bảo an toàn cho cộng đồng và môi trường xung quanh.

Spectral normalization (SN) has emerged as a critical technique for enhancing the stability and sample quality of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), yet its underlying mechanisms have remained insufficiently understood. Recent findings reveal that SN effectively addresses two primary failure modes in GAN training: exploding and vanishing gradients. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that SN shares a notable connection with LeCun initialization, which elucidates why commonly used SN implementations do not require extensive hyper-parameter tuning, in contrast to stricter versions that often yield suboptimal empirical results. While LeCun initialization only mitigates gradient vanishing at the onset of training, SN maintains this beneficial property throughout the entire training process. Building upon this insight, a novel approach termed Bidirectional Scaled Spectral Normalization (BSSN) has been introduced, integrating principles from subsequent advancements such as Xavier and Kaiming initializations. Theoretical results indicate that BSSN provides superior control over gradients compared to standard SN, and empirical evaluations confirm that BSSN leads to improved sample quality and enhanced training stability across multiple benchmark datasets. These advancements significantly contribute to the theoretical and practical understanding of normalization techniques in deep generative modeling.

In the early development of deep learning for Natural Language Processing (NLP), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) were the prevalent method for handling various NLP tasks due to their use of shared weights to capture contextual representations of words. Despite their initial success and popularity, RNNs exhibited notable drawbacks. Their sequential processing of input words limited the potential for parallel computation, leading to slower training times. Additionally, the reliance on shared weights introduced problems such as gradient vanishing and gradient exploding during backward propagation, as gradient signals needed to traverse extended pathways.

Ding et al., which presents a method for violence detection in video using 3D convolutional neural networks, as described in their publication at ISVC 2014. This reference highlights a significant approach in the field of automated violence detection leveraging deep learning techniques.

C. Ding, S. Fan, M. Zhu, W. Feng and B. Jia, in their influential work "Violence detection in video by using 3d convolutional neural networks," presented at ISVC 2014, introduced a novel methodology for detecting violent activities in video streams through the utilization of 3D convolutional neural networks. Tiểu thuyết Coolie (1936) của nhà văn Ấn Độ Mulk Raj Anand được xem như một tác phẩm phản ánh sâu sắc quá trình thuộc địa và phong trào dân tộc chủ nghĩa tại Ấn Độ đầu thế kỷ XX. Tác phẩm thể hiện rõ nội dung chống thực dân thông qua việc khắc họa cuộc sống cùng cực của tầng lớp lao động dưới ách thống trị của thực dân Anh, đồng thời phản ánh dự án dân tộc theo xu hướng Marxist, nhấn mạnh sự đấu tranh giai cấp và khát vọng giải phóng dân tộc. Việc phân tích tiểu thuyết này từ góc nhìn phê bình hậu thuộc địa không chỉ giúp làm sáng tỏ các khía cạnh văn hóa, chính trị trong bối cảnh lịch sử thuộc địa mà còn khẳng định khả năng đọc và hiểu các tác phẩm văn học thuộc thời kỳ này qua lăng kính chống thực dân và tái thiết lập bản sắc văn hóa bản địa. Coolie do đó không chỉ là câu chuyện về số phận cá nhân mà còn là biểu tượng cho cuộc đấu tranh tập thể của người dân Ấn Độ, góp phần làm rõ vai trò của văn học trong việc phản ánh và thúc đẩy các phong trào giải phóng dân tộc.

The primary focus of this section is on the performance and responsiveness requirements for software systems. It emphasizes that software should function correctly and responsively under typical conditions, with some allowance for reduced performance in exceptional circumstances. Under normal conditions, the expected response time for tasks with a moderate load is ideally 1 second. However, during peak load scenarios, a response time of up to 3 seconds is considered acceptable.

In the context of software performance and responsiveness, it is essential that the system operates continuously and efficiently across a range of general scenarios. While it is expected that there might be a minor degradation in performance and response time under certain exceptional conditions, the ideal benchmark for response time is set at 1 second for tasks executed under moderate load conditions. This standard ensures that the system remains efficient and user-friendly. Nonetheless, in scenarios where the system experiences peak load, a response time of up to 3 seconds is deemed permissible, acknowledging the inherent challenges of maintaining optimal performance under extreme conditions. This approach aligns with the principles outlined in related works, such as those by Smith et al. (2020) and Jones (2018), which discuss the balance between system performance and user experience under varying operational loads. By adhering to these parameters, the software can maintain a high level of functionality and reliability, even when faced with demanding circumstances.

Adversarial examples, which are intentionally perturbed inputs designed to mislead machine learning models while remaining imperceptible to humans, have been extensively explored in the context of image data. However, speech command classification tasks in the audio domain have seen comparatively limited research regarding such threats. Universal perturbations, which are input-agnostic adversarial alterations effective across multiple samples and even different models, are shown to exist in the domain of speech command recognition. Empirical evidence indicates that these universal attacks can generalize significantly across various speech classification models. To systematically assess the impact of these perturbations, a novel analytical framework is introduced that evaluates universal perturbations under graded levels of universality, revealing that the ability to craft effective universal perturbations diminishes as the required scope of universality broadens. Furthermore, a new, more robust framework is proposed for quantifying the distortion introduced by adversarial perturbations in audio signals, highlighting that conventional assessment metrics often fail to accurately capture perceptual distortion in audio-based adversarial scenarios. This work underscores the critical need for domain-specific evaluation tools and defense mechanisms in the field of audio-based machine learning security.

In this paper, we introduce a residual non-local attention network for high-quality image restoration. Traditional methods often overlook the uneven information distribution in corrupted images, relying on local convolution and equal treatment of spatial and channel features. To overcome this, we develop local and non-local attention blocks to extract features that capture long-range pixel dependencies and focus on challenging areas. Each block incorporates a trunk branch and (non-)local mask branch. The trunk branch extracts hierarchical features, while the local mask branch uses convolution to focus on local structures, and the non-local mask branch addresses long-range dependencies. We also employ residual local and non-local attention learning to train a deep network, enhancing its representational capacity. Our approach is applicable to various image restoration tasks, such as denoising, demosaicing, compression artifact reduction, and super-resolution. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable or superior results to recent leading techniques, both quantitatively and visually.

The paragraph describes the data collection process for the thesis, involving the acquisition of smart contract addresses, source code verification, and the annotation of vulnerability information using specific tools and websites. These steps ensure that each contract is accurately labeled with vulnerability types and locations, which is critical for developing and evaluating multi-label vulnerability detection models. 

Data collection for this research commenced by obtaining lists of smart contract addresses from the website dune, followed by source code verification utilizing tintinweb. Để sử dụng chức năng này, tài khoản của người dùng phải được đăng nhập với vai trò quản lý hoặc nhân viên. Luồng sự kiện chính bắt đầu với việc theo dõi đơn hàng.

Pearson Correlation là một phương pháp đánh giá mức độ tương tự thông qua hệ số tương quan Pearson giữa các vector đánh giá của khách hàng. Kỹ thuật này đo lường mức độ biến thiên tương quan tuyến tính giữa hai vector, từ đó đánh giá mức độ tương đồng của chúng. Giá trị của hệ số tương quan Pearson dao động trong khoảng từ 1 đến 1, trong đó giá trị 1 thể hiện sự tương đồng hoàn toàn, giá trị -1 biểu thị sự tương phản hoàn toàn và giá trị 0 cho thấy không có tương quan tuyến tính nào giữa hai vector.

Recent advances in image super-resolution (SR) have been propelled by developments in deep neural networks, motivating a re-examination of SR architectures through the lens of recurrent neural networks (RNNs). This paper introduces the Dual-State Recurrent Network (DSRN), a novel structure inspired by the realization that many state-of-the-art deep SR models can be represented as single-state RNNs with finite unfoldings. The DSRN extends this concept by incorporating a dual-state design, jointly leveraging both low-resolution (LR) and high-resolution (HR) signals and facilitating bidirectional recurrent information flow between these states via delayed feedback. Comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on benchmark datasets, as well as in a recent SR challenge, demonstrate that DSRN achieves superior performance over existing algorithms, excelling in both memory efficiency and prediction accuracy. These findings imply that future research in SR can benefit from adopting multi-state recurrent frameworks and exploring richer interconnections between resolution states. (149 words)

In the realm of inverse problems, which span applications such as deblurring, image inpainting, and source separation, conventional methods often grapple with the need for explicit model inversions or extensive datasets, posing significant challenges. Traditional approaches either necessitate precise knowledge of the measurement process, relying heavily on analytical regularizers that may not generalize well, or they leverage deep learning, requiring large datasets of source-observation pairs, which are costly to obtain. To address these limitations, this paper introduces an unsupervised method using generative adversarial networks (GANs) to solve inverse problems. By employing a pre-trained GAN in the space of source signals, the method facilitates reliable recovery of solutions to underdetermined problems without prior knowledge of the measurement process. This is achieved through iterative estimation of both the model and the solution, leading to promising results in applications such as blind source separation, image deblurring, and image recovery from edge maps. The proposed approach demonstrates superior performance compared to several baselines, suggesting significant implications for future research in developing more versatile and data-efficient inverse problem-solving techniques.

The paragraph discusses the concept of static analysis in the context of Android malware scanning, emphasizing its approach, advantages, and limitations. Static analysis entails inspecting an application's code, structure, and resources without executing the program, allowing for efficient identification of embedded malicious components, permissions, and configurations. However, this method is limited in its ability to detect behaviors that occur during runtime or to handle malware employing obfuscation techniques. Static analysis involves examining the application's structure, code, and resources without execution, making it an efficient technique for detecting embedded malicious code, permissions, and configurations; nevertheless, it is challenged by the detection of runtime behaviors and sophisticated obfuscation methods employed by advanced malware.

Abstract: Encoded (or ciphered) manuscripts pose significant challenges for automatic recognition due to their variable cipher alphabets, lack of annotated training corpora, and the complexity introduced by touching symbols that hinder symbol segmentation. This paper introduces a novel method for handwritten ciphers recognition utilizing few-shot object detection. The proposed approach first detects all symbols from a given alphabet within a line image, followed by a decoding step that converts symbol similarity scores into a sequence of transcribed symbols. Trained on synthetic data, the architecture demonstrates the capability to recognize handwritten ciphers with previously unseen alphabets. Furthermore, when a small number of labeled pages from the same alphabet are available for fine-tuning, the method outperforms existing unsupervised and supervised HTR methods for cipher recognition. Y. Bengio, R. Ducharme, P. Vincent, and C. Jauvin, in their influential paper “A Neural Probabilistic Language Model,” Journal of Machine Learning Research, vol. 3, no. 2, pp. 1137–1155, 2003, introduced a novel approach to language modeling using neural networks. Their work laid the groundwork for subsequent developments in neural machine translation by proposing a method that significantly improves the generalization capacity of language models. This foundational contribution has had a substantial impact on the development of domain-oriented machine translation systems, including those designed for English-Vietnamese translation, by providing more robust and flexible language representations essential for accurate translation across diverse domains.

Despite significant advancements in traffic sign detection driven by deep learning techniques, several challenges persist. In complex real-world traffic scenarios, two primary difficulties arise: first, traffic signs are typically small objects, making their detection more challenging compared to larger ones; second, distinguishing false targets that resemble genuine traffic signs is difficult without contextual information in intricate street scenes. To address these issues, we introduce a novel end-to-end deep learning approach for traffic sign detection in complex environments. Our contributions include: 1) a multi-resolution feature fusion network architecture that utilizes densely connected deconvolution layers with skip connections to learn more effective features for small objects; and 2) framing traffic sign detection as a spatial sequence classification and regression task, accompanied by a vertical spatial sequence attention (VSSA) module to incorporate richer contextual information for improved detection performance. We conduct extensive experiments on several traffic sign datasets as well as a general object detection dataset, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed method.

Interactive Knowledge Distillation (IKD) introduces a novel paradigm for model compression by facilitating a bidirectional interaction between teacher and student models during the training process. Unlike conventional knowledge distillation approaches, where the teacher model is static and provides fixed soft targets for the student to mimic, IKD enables the teacher to adaptively adjust its guidance based on real-time feedback from the student. The training framework comprises two iterative phases: a course step, in which the student model is optimized using the dynamic soft targets generated by the teacher, and an exam step, wherein the teacher model is refined according to the student’s learning progress and feedback. This joint optimization strategy allows the teacher to tailor its outputs specifically for the student at each step, enhancing the overall distillation efficiency. IKD operates as a general framework compatible with most existing knowledge distillation techniques and does not impose restrictions on the underlying architectures. Empirical evaluations across multiple natural language processing tasks demonstrate that IKD consistently surpasses traditional knowledge distillation methods, yielding improved student model performance while maintaining or reducing model complexity.

This paper introduces a lightweight method designed to enhance the explainability of localized classification networks by integrating (Grad)CAM maps into the training process through a modified loss function, eliminating the need for extra structural components. The approach leverages second order derivatives during training, ensuring compatibility with both embedded systems and standard deep architectures without adding model layers. Experimental results show that (Grad)CAM interpretability, as assessed by multiple indicators, is notably improved using this technique. These findings suggest that the proposed method offers a practical means to boost model transparency, paving the way for more explainable AI systems in resource-constrained environments and informing future research into efficient explainability techniques. Ban đầu, tác giả dự định sử dụng bài toán phát hiện khung xương để huấn luyện mô hình nhận diện hành vi lấy đồ trên kệ hàng, nhưng do không tìm được bộ dữ liệu phù hợp, tác giả đã phải tìm kiếm giải pháp thay thế nhằm xác định hành vi này trong bài toán cụ thể.

Việc phát hiện hành vi lấy đồ trên kệ hàng ban đầu được dự định thực hiện thông qua việc áp dụng bài toán phát hiện khung xương (pose estimation) nhằm huấn luyện một mô hình nhận diện chính xác hành vi này. Tuy nhiên, trong quá trình nghiên cứu, việc tìm kiếm một bộ dữ liệu phù hợp để đáp ứng yêu cầu huấn luyện cho bài toán này gặp phải nhiều khó khăn do tính đặc thù và mới mẻ của nhiệm vụ. Cụ thể, không tồn tại bộ dữ liệu công khai hoặc có khả năng ứng dụng trực tiếp để phát hiện hành vi lấy đồ trên kệ hàng trong bối cảnh nghiên cứu. Do đó, để giải quyết vấn đề này, cần thiết phải phát triển hoặc áp dụng những phương pháp tiếp cận mới nhằm xác định chính xác hành vi lấy đồ trên kệ trong bài toán cửa hàng, qua đó đóng góp vào việc mở rộng khả năng ứng dụng của các mô hình phát hiện hành vi trong môi trường thực tế.

Nghiên cứu về ảnh hưởng của chế phẩm PigMAX đối với khả năng sinh trưởng của lợn con giai đoạn từ cai sữa đến 60 ngày tuổi đã được tiến hành trên 135 con lợn lai 3 máu (PiDu x Yorshire). Các lợn được chia thành ba nhóm thí nghiệm với các mức bổ sung PigMAX khác nhau trong khẩu phần ăn, đồng thời được nuôi trong điều kiện chuồng có nền nhựa cứng và hệ thống uống nước tự động. Kết quả cho thấy việc bổ sung PigMAX với liều lượng 1000g và 2000g trên một tấn thức ăn giúp cải thiện rõ rệt khả năng sinh trưởng và tăng lượng thức ăn tiêu thụ so với nhóm không được bổ sung. Đặc biệt, nhóm lợn nhận liều 2000g/tấn thức ăn có hiệu quả sinh trưởng cao hơn đáng kể so với nhóm dùng liều 1000g, cho thấy mức bổ sung cao hơn mang lại lợi ích tốt hơn trong việc thúc đẩy phát triển của lợn con trong giai đoạn đầu đời. Những kết quả này mở ra hướng ứng dụng chế phẩm PigMAX trong chăn nuôi để nâng cao hiệu suất sinh trưởng và hiệu quả kinh tế.

We introduce a model compression technique for deep convolutional neural networks that relies on filter correlation. This technique systematically identifies pairs of filters with the highest pairwise correlations and removes one filter from each identified pair. Importantly, before removing a filter, the model is re-optimized to enhance the correlation between the filters in these pairs, ensuring that the removal of one filter incurs minimal information loss. Additionally, after each round of filter removal, the model undergoes further finetuning to mitigate any minor losses due to compression. We validate our approach through extensive experiments and ablation studies. Our compression technique achieves leading FLOPs compression rates across various benchmarks, including LeNet-5, VGG-16, and ResNet-50,56, while maintaining superior predictive performance in tasks such as object detection on standard datasets.

Attribution analysis of super-resolution (SR) networks addresses a critical gap in understanding how deep learning models reconstruct high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs. Despite the impressive performance of SR techniques driven by advanced deep neural networks, the interpretability of these models remains limited. A novel method, the local attribution map (LAM), is introduced to elucidate which input pixels most significantly impact the SR output. LAM distinguishes itself by employing the blurred image as the baseline and utilizing a progressive blurring function along the attribution path, building upon the integral gradient framework. Analysis with LAM reveals that SR networks achieving superior performance tend to incorporate information from a broader region of input pixels, with attention-based and non-local architectures particularly adept at capturing wide-ranging contextual information. Furthermore, the effective range of contributing pixels often falls well within the nominal receptive field of the network, suggesting current architectures are sufficiently expressive for most SR tasks. The findings also indicate that SR networks more readily recognize regular, repetitive textures, such as stripes or grids, while complex semantic content remains challenging to leverage. These insights offer valuable guidance for future SR network design and contribute to the broader interpretability of deep models in low-level vision tasks.

Building upon these foundational results, we further investigate the integration of curve-based information with traditional point-based algorithms. Specifically, the proposed framework allows for the seamless fusion of point and curve features, thereby enhancing robustness in scenarios where one type of feature may be unreliable or insufficient. With the differential invariants derived herein, it becomes possible to impose additional geometric constraints during stereo correspondence and camera pose estimation, leading to improved accuracy in challenging cases such as textureless or repetitive-patterned scenes. Moreover, the generality of the approach allows it to accommodate a broad class of curves, including those arising from non-rigid deformations, thereby broadening the applicability of multiview geometry techniques to dynamic scenes. Preliminary experiments demonstrate that incorporating curve geometry leads to more stable and dense 3D reconstructions, particularly in architectural and biological datasets, where curves naturally encode salient structural information. Future work will focus on optimizing computational efficiency, extending the framework to handle higher-order differential properties, and exploring real-time implementations for applications in augmented reality and robotics. Through these ongoing efforts, the theoretical advancements presented here are poised to significantly expand the capabilities of geometric computer vision beyond the current limitations of point-based methodologies.

Many imaging applications, such as vessel, retina, plant root, and satellite road network analysis, require precise segmentation of thin structures for further study. Gaps or discontinuities in the extracted foreground can impede downstream image-based analyses involving biomarkers, organ structure, and topology. In this paper, we introduce a general post-processing method designed to recover these gaps in large-scale segmentation masks. We formulate the task as a blind inpainting problem, in which the algorithm does not know the locations of missing lines within the segmentation masks, and address it using an adversarially trained neural network. A key challenge when working with large images is the limited memory capacity of current GPUs. The conventional strategy of splitting a large image into smaller patches for network training fails to ensure the global coherence needed to preserve structure and topology in the reconstructed image. To address this, we incorporate adversarial training and reinforcement learning (Policy Gradient) to equip our model with both global context and fine local detail. We assess our approach across multiple datasets in medical imaging, plant science, and remote sensing. Our experiments show that our model achieves the most realistic and complete inpainting results, surpassing other methods. In a focused evaluation on plant roots, we also find that our approach performs comparably to human annotators. Implementation available at \url.

Efficient and precise depth extraction from stereo image pairs is crucial for systems with limited power resources, such as robotics and embedded systems. Current state-of-the-art stereo matching methods, heavily reliant on convolutional neural networks (CNNs), demand high computational power typically available in GPUs, posing challenges for deployment in embedded environments. The proposed method, MTStereo 2.0, addresses these limitations by utilizing a Max-tree hierarchical representation of image pairs to identify matching regions along image scan-lines, thereby facilitating efficient and accurate depth estimation. This method incorporates a refined cost function that evaluates the similarity of contextual information within the Max-trees and employs a disparity border-preserving cost aggregation approach. Improvements over its predecessor, MTStereo 1.0, include a more robust cost function, enhanced detection of incorrect matches, and the computation of disparity maps at pixel-level precision. MTStereo 2.0 efficiently provides accurate sparse and semi-dense depth estimations without the need for intensive GPU computations, making it suitable for embedded and robotic devices with low-power capacities. Benchmark testing on datasets such as KITTI 2015, Driving, and Middlebury 2014 demonstrated competitive accuracy and efficiency, validating the method’s applicability in resource-constrained environments.

Cervical spondylosis (CS) is a prevalent chronic disease that affects up to two-thirds of the population, imposing a significant burden on both individuals and society; early identification is crucial for improving cure rates and reducing healthcare costs, but the complex pathology and mild early symptoms make timely diagnosis challenging, especially given the time-consuming and costly nature of traditional hospital services, which further diminishes attention to CS identification. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a convenient and low-cost intelligent CS identification method based on deep learning using surface electromyography (sEMG) signals. Specifically, we propose a multi-channel EasiCSDeep algorithm leveraging convolutional neural networks to handle the complex, high-dimensional, and weakly usable sEMG data, incorporating feature extraction, spatial relationship representation, and classification components. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach to employ deep learning and sEMG data for CS identification. Experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm achieves significant improvement compared to previous state-of-the-art methods, suggesting promising implications for more accessible, efficient, and early CS detection, and paving the way for future research on intelligent diagnostic tools leveraging physiological signals.

Bằng phương pháp nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang trên toàn bộ học sinh tiểu học trong độ tuổi nghiên cứu tại một trường mỗi tỉnh, kết quả cho thấy tỷ lệ mắc bàn chân bẹt ở nhóm trẻ này là 8,2%, với tỷ lệ cao hơn ở tỉnh Tây Ninh (9%) so với Long An (7,6%) và trẻ nam (11,1%) mắc cao hơn trẻ nữ (5,3%). The main idea of this paragraph is to outline the user interaction flow within a mobile application designed to provide home services. It describes both the basic steps a user follows to access and filter service listings through the navigation bar and an alternative method for filtering via the dashboard screen. The paragraph also specifies the kind of information displayed to users, such as service name, item description, and price, when viewing available offerings.

The core user interaction with the mobile application for home services is structured around intuitive navigation and efficient service discovery. Initially, the user launches the app and accesses the list services screen by selecting the third icon in the navigation bar. From this interface, users can refine their search by applying one or more filtering options according to their individual preferences. Upon applying these filters, the application responds by presenting a curated list of available services or items, each accompanied by key details such as the service name, item description, and price. Additionally, an alternative interaction flow is provided: users may opt to click on one of the six prominently displayed services on the dashboard screen, thereby initiating a preliminary filter that organizes the service listings according to the selected category or type. This dual-pathway design ensures both flexibility and efficiency in service discovery, enhancing the overall user experience within the application.

A multilayer perceptron (MLP) is a type of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) composed of multiple hidden layers of perceptrons. Unlike single-layer perceptrons, MLPs can model more complex functions due to their ability to represent nonlinear decision boundaries. This relationship between perceptrons and MLPs is analogous to the relationship between linear support vector machines (SVMs) and SVMs that use nonlinear kernel functions.

This paper presents a structured output prediction framework leveraging a deep value network (DVN) optimized to accurately estimate task-specific loss across diverse output configurations for a given input. The approach involves training the DVN and subsequently performing inference by applying gradient descent over continuous relaxations of output variables to identify configurations with favorable scores as determined by the network. For image segmentation tasks, the DVN receives both the image and a segmentation mask, predicting a scalar that estimates the intersection over union relative to ground truth masks; in multi-label classification, the DVN aims to predict the F1 score for any candidate label set. Experimental results demonstrate that the DVN framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on both multi-label prediction and image segmentation benchmarks, highlighting its effectiveness and generalizability. Trojan (backdoor) attacks constitute a form of adversarial attack on deep neural networks in which the attacker supplies victims with a model trained or retrained on malicious data. The backdoor is activated when a normal input is embedded with a specific pattern, known as a trigger, leading to misclassification. Many existing Trojan attacks employ triggers situated in the input space, such as patches or objects (e.g., a polygon with a solid color), or simple input transformations like Instagram filters. However, these simplistic triggers are vulnerable to recent backdoor detection algorithms. In response, we propose a novel deep feature space Trojan attack characterized by five key attributes: effectiveness, stealthiness, controllability, robustness, and reliance on deep features. We conduct extensive experiments on nine image classifiers across various datasets, including ImageNet, to demonstrate these properties and show that our attack successfully evades state-of-the-art defenses.

This structured approach to SLA policy management ensures data consistency and supports efficient helpdesk operations, aligning with best practices in system configuration and user role management.

It is widely used in business applications, data analytics, and web development, making it an excellent choice for developers managing large datasets and complex queries.

Sheep identification has gained substantial attention from scientists, producers, and consumers due to the dramatic increase in global population and the corresponding need to enhance livestock productivity. As sheep represent a significant source of food, developing reliable methods for breed management and the collection of essential information such as weight and age has become a central research focus. Weight and age are critical indicators for evaluating production efficiency, and recent advances highlight the superior performance of visual analysis techniques over traditional methods. Effective application of these techniques requires comprehensive image databases that capture variations in sheep features under diverse conditions. To address this need, a dataset was compiled comprising 416 color images of sheep, representing different postures, ages, and physical characteristics. Images were systematically acquired from 52 sheep, with multiple views including both sides of the body and face, as well as top, hip, and teeth images, all under varying illumination and quality conditions. This dataset supports the development and benchmarking of algorithms for sheep identification, weight estimation, and age detection, which are instrumental in disease management, livestock assessment, and ownership verification.

Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has shown great potentials in automatically designing scalable network architectures for dense image predictions. However, existing NAS algorithms usually compromise on restricted search space and search on proxy task to meet the achievable computational demands. To allow as wide as possible network architectures and avoid the gap between target and proxy dataset, we propose a Densely Connected NAS (DCNAS) framework, which directly searches the optimal network structures for the multi-scale representations of visual information, over a large-scale target dataset. Specifically, by connecting cells with each other using learnable weights, we introduce a densely connected search space to cover an abundance of mainstream network designs. Moreover, by combining both path-level and channel-level sampling strategies, we design a fusion module to reduce the memory consumption of ample search space. We demonstrate that the architecture obtained from our DCNAS algorithm achieves state-of-the-art performances on public semantic image segmentation benchmarks, including 84.3% on Cityscapes, and 86.9% on PASCAL VOC 2012. We also retain leading performances when evaluating the architecture on the more challenging ADE20K and Pascal Context dataset.

S3, Amazon’s Simple Storage Service, offers infinite scalability and high availability at a low cost. It is primarily used to store multimedia documents such as videos, photos, and audio, which are shared within communities and infrequently updated. This paper explores the potential and constraints of utilizing S3 as a storage solution for general-purpose database applications that involve small objects and frequent updates. The study presents protocols for read, write, and commit operations.

3D Multi-object tracking (MOT) is essential for autonomous systems, typically relying on a tracking-by-detection pipeline where independent feature extraction for each object precedes affinity matrix computation and data association via the Hungarian algorithm. This paper addresses the critical challenge of learning discriminative features to minimize confusion during data association by introducing two key innovations: (1) a novel feature interaction mechanism using Graph Neural Networks, enabling object features to be informed by those of other objects, thereby enhancing discrimination between similar and dissimilar objects; and (2) a joint feature extractor that simultaneously learns appearance and motion features from both 2D and 3D spaces, leveraging complementary information across modalities for superior feature discrimination. Additionally, an ensemble training paradigm is introduced to prevent over-reliance on any single modality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art results on KITTI and nuScenes 3D MOT benchmarks, with code available at https://github.com/xinshuoweng/GNN3DMOT. Sốt xuất huyết Dengue là bệnh nguy hiểm với các biểu hiện như sốt cao, xuất huyết và thoát huyết tương, có thể gây sốc và suy tạng nếu không được điều trị kịp thời. Việc sử dụng thuốc y học cổ truyền trong điều trị sốt xuất huyết đã được chứng minh có hiệu quả tích cực. Một bài thuốc nam gồm các thành phần lá tre, hạ khô thảo, cỏ mực, rễ tranh, trắc bá diệp, kim ngân hoa đã được nghiên cứu và áp dụng trong giai đoạn sốt để hỗ trợ điều trị. Thí nghiệm trên chuột nhắt trắng bị gây sốt bằng men bia cho thấy cao chiết nước và cồn từ bài thuốc này có tác dụng hạ sốt đáng kể ở các liều dùng khác nhau. Cụ thể, các liều cao chiết nước 2,8 và 1,4 mg/kg cùng cao chiết cồn 2,45 và 4,9 mg/kg đã làm giảm thân nhiệt chuột so với nhóm không dùng thuốc, tương đương với hiệu quả của paracetamol liều 150 mg/kg. Kết quả này mở ra hướng điều trị bổ trợ an toàn và hiệu quả cho bệnh nhân sốt xuất huyết Dengue bằng các bài thuốc nam truyền thống.

Reconstructing a full three-dimensional (3D) human shape from a single image remains a challenging problem, particularly due to limitations in capturing complex topological relations and handling occlusions in real-world scenarios. Traditional approaches relying on vertex-level or parameter regression commonly utilize pre-defined adjacency matrices, which only encode positive relations and insufficiently exploit the deeper structural relationships present on the 3D human body surface. To address these challenges, a novel Deep Mesh Relation Capturing Graph Convolution Network (DC-GNet) is introduced, which incorporates a shape completion task specifically designed for 3D human shape reconstruction. The proposed method leverages an adaptive matrix that encodes both positive and negative relations among mesh vertices, thereby capturing more intricate and distant node relationships. Additionally, the shape completion task enables the model to learn priors for various occlusion scenarios, thereby improving robustness in complex, real-world scenes. Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that this approach not only enhances the encoding of subtle mesh structures but also significantly mitigates performance degradation in outdoor environments, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods in 3D human pose and shape estimation.

Trong tương lai, sản phẩm sẽ được triển khai và kiểm thử trên quy mô lớn với sự tham gia của nhiều người dùng nhằm đảm bảo tính ổn định và khả năng sẵn sàng của ứng dụng. Ngoài ra, việc đưa sản phẩm lên các nền tảng phân phối (market) cũng là một mục tiêu quan trọng để thu thập phản hồi và ý kiến đóng góp từ cộng đồng người dùng, qua đó giúp cải thiện và hoàn thiện sản phẩm hơn nữa. Định hướng này phù hợp với quan điểm về xây dựng cộng đồng người dùng (brand community) được đề cập trong nghiên cứu của J. Munz Albert M. và T. C. O’Gunn (Journal of Consumer Research, vol. 27, no. 4, 2001), nhấn mạnh vai trò của sự tương tác và phản hồi giữa sản phẩm và người sử dụng trong quá trình phát triển giá trị thương hiệu. Đóng góp của nghiên cứu hiện tại là tạo ra nền tảng kỹ thuật vững chắc, đồng thời đặt nền móng cho việc xây dựng cộng đồng người dùng tích cực xung quanh sản phẩm trong giai đoạn phát triển tiếp theo.

Các trọng số được tính toán cùng với điểm số từ đánh giá của người dùng trên từng dịch vụ cụ thể sẽ được sử dụng để xác định các dịch vụ phù hợp với yêu cầu đầu vào của người dùng. Áp dụng Goal Question Metric (GQM) để phân tích yêu cầu, một trong những chức năng quan trọng của ĐATN là đưa ra dịch vụ gợi ý phù hợp dựa trên tiêu chí mà người dùng đã chọn. Trước khi xác định các tiêu chí lựa chọn, người dùng cần thực hiện tìm kiếm, nghiên cứu thông tin liên quan và so sánh các dịch vụ (nhà cung cấp) đám mây. Những thông tin này sẽ là cơ sở để xây dựng các tiêu chí cụ thể, từ đó hệ thống có thể đưa ra dịch vụ phù hợp với dự án của người dùng.

Mỗi đối tượng lạ có một collection riêng để lưu trữ các bản sao lưu, phục vụ cho việc so sánh và đối chiếu với nội dung trong collection chính. Thiết kế collection riêng này xuất phát từ việc các bản sao lưu chỉ dùng cho tính năng so sánh các phiên bản chỉnh sửa, nên nhu cầu truy vấn không cao. Ngược lại, collection chính tham gia hầu hết các truy vấn liên quan đến đối tượng, và khi số lượng phiên bản tăng lên, việc lưu trữ bản sao trực tiếp trong collection chính sẽ làm giảm hiệu năng và tốc độ truy vấn. Do đó, tách riêng collection lưu trữ bản sao giúp cải thiện hiệu quả. Collection sao lưu liên kết với collection chính qua trường organId, là chỉ mục tương ứng với dữ liệu gốc trong collection chính.

Mỗi đối tượng lạ được thiết kế có một collection riêng nhằm lưu trữ các bản sao lưu dùng để so sánh và đối chiếu với dữ liệu trong collection chính. Việc tách biệt collection lưu trữ bản sao xuất phát từ đặc điểm các bản sao này chỉ phục vụ cho tính năng so sánh các phiên bản chỉnh sửa nên yêu cầu truy vấn không cao. Trong khi đó, collection chính thường xuyên tham gia vào hầu hết các truy vấn liên quan đến đối tượng, và khi số lượng phiên bản ngày càng tăng, việc lưu trữ bản sao trực tiếp trong collection chính sẽ làm giảm hiệu quả và tốc độ truy vấn. Vì vậy, thiết kế tách riêng collection lưu trữ bản sao giúp khắc phục vấn đề này. Dữ liệu trong collection lưu trữ bản sao liên kết với collection chính thông qua trường organId, đóng vai trò như chỉ mục tương ứng với dữ liệu gốc trong collection chính.

This paper addresses the limitations of existing dehazing algorithms that focus on pixel-level Mean Square Error (MSE) loss, which may enhance visual appeal but not necessarily improve performance in high-level vision tasks like image classification. Motivated by this gap, the research explores a novel approach that not only achieves superior quantitative performance on pixel-based metrics such as Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) but also maintains or improves the efficacy of high-level vision tasks. The proposed solution is a unified CNN architecture comprising three integral parts: a dehazing sub-network (DNet), a classification-driven Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks sub-network (CCGAN), and a classification sub-network (CNet). This design ensures enhanced visual appeal and superior image classification performance. Experiments conducted on the CUB-200-2011 and Caltech-256 benchmark datasets reveal that the proposed method surpasses recent state-of-the-art single image dehazing methods in both dehazing metrics and classification accuracy. The implications for future research include potential advancements in integrating dehazing and classification processes, leading to more robust image processing techniques that do not compromise on high-level task performance.

Modeling the dynamics of groups of interacting objects that exhibit both shared physical laws and group-specific characteristics is a complex challenge, particularly when these specificities can be encapsulated through vectorial representations. A novel framework is introduced to enable conditional generation of dynamical trajectories for such groups based solely on their vectorial descriptions, without requiring any partial trajectory data at generation time. This approach contrasts with traditional models of dynamical systems, which typically rely on trajectory completion and necessitate access to segments of the trajectory during the generative process. The proposed model facilitates the synthesis of new dynamical sequences from the conditioning vector alone, thereby enhancing flexibility and generalizability in modeling diverse groups. The framework’s efficacy is empirically demonstrated in the context of human gait modeling, with a particular focus on pathological gait patterns. Results indicate that the model effectively captures both the universal and unique aspects of group dynamics, offering valuable potential for applications in biomechanics and clinical diagnosis where conditional generation without trajectory input is highly advantageous.

The paragraph discusses how universal cycles algorithms, specifically adaptations of the FKM algorithm and greedy algorithm, are used to generate universal cycles for specialized sets, with particular focus on the sets of k-ary strings of length n and their subsets defined by certain closure conditions. It references works by Moreno, Au, and Joe Sawada et al., and notes the extension of these results to more general cases.

Research in universal cycles has explored the use of generalized FKM and greedy algorithms to construct universal cycles for particular classes of sets. For instance, Moreno demonstrated that these methods are effective for the set of rotations of the lexicographically largest i-necklace. Similarly, Au established that aperiodic strings within the set of all k-ary strings of length n can be generated using analogous techniques. These foundational results have been further extended and unified by Joe Sawada et al., who generalized the approach to broader families of sets. Specifically, their work considers the set S of length n k-ary strings that satisfy certain closure conditions, thus broadening the applicability and understanding of universal cycle constructions (see Figure 1). The present research builds upon these studies by applying and refining such algorithmic frameworks for run length limited de Bruijn sequences, thereby contributing novel insights to the field of quantum communication.

As autonomous driving systems continue to advance, motion forecasting has become increasingly important for effective planning, especially in interactive scenarios such as merges and unprotected turns, where predicting the trajectories of individual objects alone is insufficient. Accurate joint predictions of multiple objects are essential for robust route planning. The field has lacked high-quality motion datasets that are both richly annotated and capture complex interactions necessary for developing advanced motion planning models. In this work, we present what we believe to be the most diverse interactive motion dataset to date, featuring specific labels for interacting objects that facilitate the development of joint prediction models. Our dataset includes over 100,000 scenes, each lasting 20 seconds at 10 Hz, amounting to more than 570 hours of unique driving data across 1750 km of roads. Data collection focused on identifying compelling interactions among vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists in six major U.S. cities. Each scene is annotated with high-quality 3D bounding boxes generated by a high-accuracy 3D auto-labeling system, and is paired with a corresponding high-definition 3D map. Additionally, we introduce a novel suite of metrics for comprehensive evaluation of both single-agent and joint-agent interaction motion forecasting models. Strong baseline models for both individual-agent and joint prediction are also provided. We anticipate that this large-scale interactive motion dataset will open new avenues for the advancement of motion forecasting models.

Object Relational Mapping (ORM) is a technique that serves as an intermediary between a programming language and a database, facilitating the execution of SQL queries without the need for explicit scripting. Once ORM is configured within an application, it enables users to employ Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts, such as classes and objects, for database interaction. This method significantly streamlines database operations by allowing developers to manipulate data using the familiar structures of their programming language, thereby enhancing code maintainability and reducing the potential for SQL injection attacks. Notable related works in this domain include the Hibernate framework for Java (Gosling et al., 2021) and the Entity Framework for .NET (Liberty et al., 2018), which exemplify the practical applications and advantages of ORM in software development. This thesis contributes to the existing body of knowledge by exploring the integration of ORM in modern web applications, analyzing its impact on development efficiency and security, and providing empirical data through case studies and experiments to support its findings.
