A novel approach for forecasting systems comprising multiple interrelated time series is introduced, simultaneously learning predictive models and identifying leading indicators within the system that enhance forecast accuracy. The method centers on the classical linear vector autoregressive (VAR) model, integrating the discovery of leading indicators with the inference of sparse Granger causality graphs to reveal directional relationships among variables. A constrained optimization framework is formulated to encourage sparsity in model parameters and facilitate information sharing across predictive tasks in a multi-task learning context, thereby uncovering cluster structures among related time series. The proposed algorithm efficiently solves this optimization problem, fostering both interpretability and predictive power. Empirical validation on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrates that this approach consistently outperforms baseline VAR models and contemporary sparse VAR methods, yielding superior forecasting performance and more insightful representations of inter-series dependencies. The results highlight the method’s efficacy in capturing the underlying structure of complex time series systems, offering significant advancements for applications requiring accurate and interpretable multivariate time series forecasting.

Đoạn văn trình bày những cải tiến của kiến trúc MT dựa trên Transformer nhằm thay thế CNN truyền thống trong các tác vụ trích xuất đặc trưng hình ảnh, đặc biệt chú trọng đến khả năng xử lý các nhiệm vụ dự đoán ở mức điểm ảnh và mức ảnh. Các đóng góp chính của MT bao gồm: chia ảnh thành các phần nhỏ chồng lấn để học biểu diễn phân giải cao, xây dựng mạng theo cấu trúc tự tháp nhằm giảm chi phí tính toán, thiết kế cơ chế attention hiệu quả, và loại bỏ position encoding (PE) truyền thống bằng mô đun kết hợp convolution và fully connected nhằm đảm bảo khả năng thích ứng với độ phân giải ảnh đầu vào bất kỳ mà không làm giảm hiệu năng.

Đoạn viết lại:  
Nhằm khắc phục các hạn chế còn tồn tại của các hệ thống trích xuất đặc trưng dựa trên CNN truyền thống, kiến trúc MT dựa trên Transformer đã được phát triển như một khung trích xuất đặc trưng tổng quát, phù hợp cho nhiều tác vụ phía sau như dự đoán ở cả mức ảnh và mức điểm ảnh. Đầu tiên, MT tiến hành phân chia ảnh đầu vào thành các phần nhỏ hơn, ví dụ như các ô 4×4 điểm ảnh, cho phép mô hình học được các biểu diễn với độ phân giải cao, điều này đặc biệt quan trọng đối với các nhiệm vụ yêu cầu dự đoán chi tiết ở mức điểm ảnh. Đồng thời, các phần này được thiết kế có sự chồng lấn lên nhau nhằm duy trì tính liên tục cục bộ của thông tin hình ảnh. Bên cạnh đó, cấu trúc mạng được xây dựng theo dạng tự tháp (pyramid), trong đó kích thước không gian của đặc trưng giảm dần ở các tầng sâu hơn, giúp giảm đáng kể chi phí tính toán đồng thời vẫn bảo toàn khả năng trích xuất cả đặc trưng thô ở độ phân giải cao lẫn đặc trưng trừu tượng ở độ phân giải thấp. Ngoài ra, MT còn thiết kế một cơ chế attention hiệu quả nhằm tối ưu hóa chi phí tính toán và độ phức tạp của mô hình. Đặc biệt, thay vì sử dụng cơ chế mã hóa vị trí (position encoding – PE) như trong Transformer truyền thống, MT loại bỏ hoàn toàn thành phần này do PE có kích thước cố định trong quá trình huấn luyện, dẫn đến việc phải nội suy trọng số PE khi kiểm tra với ảnh có độ phân giải khác, từ đó gây suy giảm độ chính xác. Để giải quyết vấn đề này, MT đề xuất một mô đun kết hợp giữa phép tích chập (convolution) và tầng kết nối đầy đủ (fully connected layer), qua đó vừa cung cấp thông tin vị trí cần thiết cho mô hình, vừa đảm bảo khả năng thích nghi với ảnh đầu vào có độ phân giải bất kỳ mà không làm ảnh hưởng đến hiệu năng tổng thể của hệ thống.

This paper is motivated by the goal of improving data efficiency and generalization in deep neural architectures through symmetry equivariance, specifically scale and translation equivariance, for learning on time-series from raw waveforms. The approach involves designing Wavelet Networks that leverage these symmetries, resulting in first-layer representations similar to the wavelet transform, which then evolve into more descriptive features with increasing depth. Empirical results demonstrate that these Wavelet Networks, with a straightforward architecture, consistently outperform CNNs on raw waveforms and achieve comparable performance to spectrogram-based methods. These findings imply that incorporating equivariant design principles into deep learning architectures for time-series data can yield improved representations and performance, suggesting promising directions for future research in symmetry-aware network design.

This paper addresses the challenge of hard exploration in reinforcement learning by proposing an agent that learns a spectrum of directed exploratory policies, motivated by the need to efficiently revisit and explore all possible states within an environment. The approach constructs an episodic memory-based intrinsic reward using k-nearest neighbors over the agent's recent experiences, training exploratory policies and encouraging comprehensive state visitation. To enhance the novelty signal, a self-supervised inverse dynamics model is used to train the embeddings of the nearest neighbor lookup, biasing exploration toward agent-controllable aspects. The Universal Value Function Approximators (UVFA) framework enables simultaneous learning of multiple policies with varying exploration-exploitation balances using a single neural network, allowing knowledge transfer from exploratory to exploitative behaviors. Integrating this method with modern distributed RL agents supports large-scale experience collection across parallel environments. Results show that the method doubles the performance of the base agent on all hard exploration games in the Atari-57 suite and achieves a median human-normalised score of 1344.0% across all games. Significantly, it is the first algorithm to achieve non-zero rewards in Pitfall!—averaging a score of 8,400—without relying on demonstrations or hand-crafted features. These findings suggest promising avenues for future research in scalable and generalizable exploration strategies in reinforcement learning. (221 words)

This paper proposes alternative generator architectures for Boundary Equilibrium Generative Adversarial Networks, inspired by Learning from Simulated and Unsupervised Images through Adversarial Training, aiming to disentangle the requirement for a noise-based latent space. The methodology centers on employing the generator primarily as a refiner network to achieve photo-realistic representations of synthetic images, addressing the poorly understood properties of the latent space by replacing noise injection with an image-based approach. The new generator design enables flexible control over the trade-off between restrictive refinement and expressive capacity. Notably, unlike existing methods, the proposed architecture eliminates the need for paired or unpaired datasets of real and synthetic images during training, requiring only a relatively small set of real images. The findings demonstrate that this approach simplifies the training process and enhances the practicality of adversarial networks for image refinement tasks. (word_count: 143)

This work introduces a novel approach for early diabetic retinopathy screening by focusing on microaneurysm (MA) detection in color fundus images, motivated by the fact that MAs are typically the earliest lesions signaling diabetic retinopathy and their accurate identification is critical for timely treatment. The proposed method classifies each image pixel as MA or non-MA using a deep neural network that incorporates dropout training and a maxout activation function, eliminating the need for any preprocessing or manual feature extraction. The approach demonstrates significant improvements over standard MA detection pipelines, which traditionally rely on sequential preprocessing, feature extraction, classification, and post-processing steps. Evaluated on the publicly available Retinopathy Online Challenge (ROC) and Diaretdb1v2 databases, the method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, suggesting promising implications for future research in automated retinal screening and deep learning-based medical image analysis.

This paragraph discusses how Kubernetes manages the relationship between Services and Pods, emphasizing the use of labels to enable flexible association and routing. It highlights that Services are decoupled from Pods and can be configured to target different Pods, even across multiple replica sets, through label selection.

In Kubernetes architecture, the definition of Services is intentionally decoupled from the specification of Pods, allowing for a modular and scalable deployment model. Kubernetes employs a label-based selection mechanism, wherein each Pod is assigned one or more labels that serve as identifying attributes. Services utilize these labels to dynamically select the set of Pods they should route traffic to, as illustrated in the application configuration (port: 443 targetPort: 3001). This label-driven approach not only permits a single Service to aggregate traffic to Pods originating from various replica sets but also enables the possibility of multiple Services being mapped to the same Pod, thereby supporting complex communication patterns and efficient resource utilization within the cluster.

For instance, a workload with a controller running a single replica could have its Pod rescheduled if its node is deleted. Therefore, it is important to design workloads to withstand such disruptions or to protect critical Pods from being interrupted.

When implementing autoscaling within a cluster, it is essential to recognize that the deletion or migration of resources can cause transient disruptions to running workloads. For example, as illustrated in scenarios where a controller operates with only a single replica, the Pod managed by this controller may be rescheduled to another node if the original node is removed due to autoscaler activity. (2021) and Lee and Chen (2022), which emphasize the importance of workload resilience and service continuity in scalable cloud environments. Actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithms have demonstrated remarkable success in tackling complex problems within continuous state and action spaces; however, they can also exhibit unexpected failures in environments that appear straightforward, particularly when rewards are sparse and dynamics are deterministic. A formal analysis of these failures reveals that, even in simple control tasks, the learning dynamics may converge to suboptimal fixed points, thereby hindering effective policy improvement. By closely examining the mechanisms underlying this phenomenon, it becomes evident that certain convergence regimes inherent to actor-critic methods can trap the algorithm in poor solutions, especially when the reward signal is infrequent or absent for extended periods. This understanding not only clarifies the limitations of current approaches but also provides a framework for evaluating and developing strategies to address such pitfalls. Furthermore, the insights gained from this analysis offer valuable perspectives on existing remedies for sparse reward settings and inspire novel avenues for enhancing the robustness and reliability of actor-critic algorithms in challenging reinforcement learning environments.

Canonical Autocorrelation Analysis (CAA) is introduced as an extension of sparse Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) to identify multiple-to-multiple linear correlations within a singular set of variables. Diverging from traditional CCA, which targets correlations between two distinct datasets, CAA uncovers multivariate correlations within one dataset, facilitating the detection of underlying parsimonious structures composed of limited feature subsets. The resulting correlations, formed by pairs of sparse linear combinations, offer high interpretability. CAA proves valuable in anomaly detection by highlighting deviations from expected correlation structures. Its effectiveness is demonstrated in domains such as breast cancer diagnosis and radiation threat detection, where single-class and unsupervised learning of correlation structures are crucial. In the Wisconsin Breast Cancer dataset, single-class CAA rivals existing supervised methods, while in radiation threat detection, unsupervised CAA outperforms prevailing unsupervised techniques in the field. Furthermore, CAA provides meaningful insights for threat analysis, underscoring its potential as a robust tool for exploring and interpreting complex data correlations in various scientific applications.

Từ năm 2001 đến nay, lĩnh vực học sâu đã chứng kiến những tiến bộ đáng kể trong nhận diện khuôn mặt nhờ sự bùng nổ của dữ liệu và sức mạnh tính toán, cùng với sự phát triển của các mô hình học sâu. Năm 2001, Paul Viola và Michael Jones đã giới thiệu một phương pháp mới để phát hiện khuôn mặt trong ảnh, được biết đến với tên gọi Viola-Jones face detection framework. Từ năm 2012, các mô hình dựa trên học sâu như DeepFace, DeepID, và FaceNet đã đặt ra những tiêu chuẩn mới về hiệu suất trong nhận diện khuôn mặt.

In the context of this thesis, the Jira Service Management platform is highlighted for its comprehensive capabilities in managing service requests, incidents, problems, and changes by organizing and prioritizing these elements efficiently in a centralized location. This functionality supports helpdesk teams in meeting goals and adhering to service level agreements. Additionally, JiraSM is recognized for its robust project management features, including rich reporting and analytics, flexibility to align with diverse team structures, workflows, and varying levels of agile maturity. The platform's strengths are further emphasized by its default reports, which are beneficial for tracking ticket statistics. Notwithstanding these advantages, certain limitations are identified, such as the restricted file size for uploads and the lack of reusability in reports. These challenges underscore the need for further development, as illustrated by the seven main components identified by students, which are detailed in the subsequent table. This analysis contributes to the broader discourse on optimizing project management tools, as suggested by works like Smith et al. Abstract: The study explores a novel approach to adversarial attacks by introducing a 3D adversarial logo attack, expanding the scope from traditional 2D adversarial patches to 3D rendering views, crucial for sustained physical-world impact. The methodology involves creating an arbitrary shape logo from a 2D texture image, transforming it into a 3D adversarial logo via a texture mapping process called logo transformation. This process enables the manipulation of the logo's shape and position, enhancing the applicability of adversarial training for computer graphics. Unlike conventional adversarial patches, the 3D adversarial logo is integrated into the 3D object space and back-propagates to the 2D image domain through differentiable rendering. Key findings demonstrate that this 3D adversarial logo effectively deceives state-of-the-art deep object detectors, maintaining robustness even under model rotations, thus advancing the potential for realistic physical-world attacks. The research contributes to the field by providing an innovative framework for 3D adversarial attacks, with the implementation details accessible at https://github.com/TAMU-VITA/3D_Adversarial_Logo.

The paragraph emphasizes the importance of pronunciation recognition and assessment in English learning platforms, noting that while a vocabulary size of 75,000 words may not be optimal, it is sufficient for developing a demo system. Accurate pronunciation is crucial for language learners, and integrating pronunciation assessment is essential for competing in the market.

Although the vocabulary database of 75,000 words does not represent an exhaustive corpus, it provides a sufficiently robust foundation for the development and demonstration of the proposed software system (see Table 3.5). A core challenge in language education is ensuring that learners acquire correct pronunciation, as this skill is fundamental to effective communication and language mastery. Consequently, the integration of pronunciation recognition and assessment functionalities has become an indispensable component of contemporary English learning platforms, enabling these systems to remain competitive with other offerings in the market. This approach aligns with the strategies outlined in related works, such as Wang et al. (2019) and Lee & Glass (2018), which underscore the significance of automated pronunciation evaluation in language learning applications. The present system contributes to this body of research by incorporating state-of-the-art pronunciation assessment tools, thereby enhancing the overall effectiveness and user engagement of the learning environment.

Nghiên cứu mới đây đã sử dụng DNA barcode để phân tích đa dạng di truyền và nhận diện các loài Kiwi thuộc chi Actinidia, với 20 mẫu Kiwi được nghiên cứu, trong đó 18 mẫu nhập nội và 2 mẫu thu thập từ tự nhiên tại Việt Nam. Các trình tự DNA trong lục lạp và nhân được sử dụng để phân tích nguồn gốc và mối liên hệ di truyền giữa các mẫu. Tỷ lệ khuếch đại thành công các trình tự đạt từ 75-95%, cho phép giải trình tự ở các mẫu thành công. Qua phân tích mối quan hệ di truyền với các mẫu tham chiếu trên GenBank cho các trình tự rbcL, matK và ITS, nghiên cứu chỉ ra sự phân nhóm di truyền rõ rệt, với nguồn gốc di truyền của các mẫu có thể xuất phát từ 2 đến 3 nguồn khác nhau. Đặc biệt, khi kết hợp phân tích gen rbcL, matK và vùng ITS trên 14 mẫu giống Kiwi, kết quả cho thấy sự phân biệt thành 3 nhóm riêng biệt. Những phát hiện này chứng minh rằng chỉ thị DNA barcode, với các trình tự rbcL, matK và ITS, có hiệu quả trong việc xác định nguồn gốc ở mức độ loài, mở ra những cơ hội mới cho việc bảo tồn và khai thác bền vững nguồn gen các loài Kiwi.

In this paper, we present a fully automated approach for transforming a still image into a realistic, animated looping video, focusing on scenes with continuous fluid motion like flowing water and billowing smoke. Our technique is based on the insight that such natural motion can be effectively recreated using a static Eulerian motion description, which involves a single, time-invariant flow field that specifies the immediate motion of a particle at a particular 2D location. We employ an image-to-image translation network to encode the motion characteristics of natural scenes sourced from online videos, enabling us to generate a corresponding motion field for new photographs. The animation of the image is achieved using the generated motion through a deep warping method, where pixels are encoded as deep features, these features are warped using Eulerian motion, and the resulting warped feature maps are decoded back into images. To create continuous, seamlessly looping video textures, we introduce an innovative video looping technique that propagates features both forward and backward in time, blending the outcomes. We validate the effectiveness and robustness of our method by applying it to a diverse range of examples, including beaches, waterfalls, and flowing rivers.

Một nghiên cứu đã được thực hiện nhằm đánh giá khả năng tiêu hóa biểu kiến dưỡng chất ở gà Sao trong giai đoạn từ 8 đến 10 tuần tuổi, với mục đích so sánh hiệu quả của hai loại bột cá biển và bột cá tra. Thí nghiệm được thiết kế theo thể thức hoàn toàn ngẫu nhiên với hai yếu tố chính: nguồn nguyên liệu thức ăn cung cấp protein và mức độ protein thô, lần lượt là 16, 18, 20 và 22%. Kết quả cho thấy, khẩu phần chứa bột cá biển có tỷ lệ tiêu hóa biểu kiến dưỡng chất cao hơn so với bột cá tra, với sự khác biệt có ý nghĩa thống kê (P < 0,05). Đặc biệt, khẩu phần chứa 20% và 18% protein thô đạt tỷ lệ tiêu hóa cao nhất đối với các chỉ tiêu như DM, OM, EE, CF, NDF, ADF và lượng nitơ tích lũy, so với các mức protein khác trong cả hai giai đoạn tuổi của gà Sao. Điều này gợi ý rằng việc sử dụng bột cá biển và điều chỉnh mức protein phù hợp có thể cải thiện đáng kể hiệu quả dinh dưỡng và sự phát triển của gia cầm.

Trong quá trình thiết kế giao diện người dùng, việc thống nhất các quy chuẩn trực quan là vô cùng cần thiết để nâng cao tính nhất quán và trải nghiệm người dùng. Cụ thể, các thông báo lỗi được thiết lập hiển thị dưới dạng văn bản màu đỏ ngay dưới từng ô nhập liệu (input) khi người dùng không điền đầy đủ các trường bắt buộc hoặc nhập dữ liệu không hợp lệ. Bên cạnh đó, sau mỗi thao tác quan trọng như thêm, sửa, xóa, đăng nhập hoặc đăng xuất, hệ thống sẽ hiển thị thông báo phản hồi tại góc trên bên phải màn hình, giúp người dùng dễ dàng nhận biết trạng thái của hành động vừa thực hiện. Tất cả các yếu tố trên đều tuân thủ bộ màu sắc chung của dự án, đảm bảo sự hài hòa và nhất quán trong toàn bộ hệ thống giao diện. The referenced work by Papineni et al. introduces BLEU, a metric designed for the automated evaluation of machine translation systems. This method emphasizes the importance of comparing translated text against one or more reference translations by calculating n-gram precision while accounting for brevity through a penalty for short translations. BLEU has been influential in natural language processing due to its ability to provide a quantifiable measure of translation quality without human intervention. By focusing on n-gram overlap, it offers a reliable approximation of human judgment in evaluating translation accuracy, which has been widely adopted in the field. The contribution of BLEU lies in its innovative approach to automating the evaluation process, which has significantly streamlined the assessment of machine translation outputs and has set a precedent for subsequent evaluation metrics in computational linguistics. The method's robustness and efficiency have made it a cornerstone in the domain, as evidenced by its extensive citation and continued relevance in research and application. Papineni et al.'s BLEU metric, presented in their 2002 paper in Philadelphia, remains a seminal work in the evaluation of machine translation systems.

The paragraph discusses the security architecture of a social login solution for Web3, which integrates blockchain smart contracts, Shamir’s Secret Sharing (SSS), and the Pedersen Distributed Key Generation (DKG) protocol to enhance system security. Blockchain smart contracts provide a secure foundation by ensuring transparency, immutability, and tamper-resistant execution within a decentralized network. Shamir’s Secret Sharing strengthens the protection of cryptographic keys and sensitive information by dividing a secret into multiple shares distributed among different parties. Additionally, the Pedersen DKG protocol facilitates the secure generation and distribution of cryptographic keys among participants, preventing any single party from possessing the entire key. This combination of technologies collectively underpins a robust security infrastructure for the proposed social login system.

The security framework of the proposed social login solution for Web3 is predicated on the synergistic integration of blockchain smart contracts, Shamir’s Secret Sharing (SSS), and the Pedersen Distributed Key Generation (DKG) protocol. Blockchain smart contracts operate on a decentralized network, providing inherent properties of transparency, immutability, and tamper-proof execution, thereby establishing a trustworthy and verifiable operational environment. To enhance the confidentiality of cryptographic keys and other sensitive data, Shamir’s Secret Sharing is employed, which involves partitioning a secret into multiple shares distributed among distinct parties, thereby mitigating the risk of single-point compromise. Furthermore, the Pedersen DKG protocol is utilized to securely generate and distribute cryptographic keys within a group, ensuring that no individual participant obtains the complete key, which significantly strengthens the overall security posture of the system. This comprehensive security infrastructure leverages the complementary strengths of these protocols to achieve a resilient and secure social login mechanism for Web3 applications.

Scene understanding from images remains a challenging problem in autonomous driving, particularly for 3D scene analysis where most methods still rely on estimating 3D bounding boxes rather than providing detailed object representations. This paper presents a novel approach for jointly inferring 3D rigid-body poses and shapes of vehicles from stereo image pairs by leveraging shape priors. Unlike prior works that align shapes to point clouds generated from dense stereo reconstruction, our method operates directly on images by integrating both photometric and silhouette alignment terms into the energy function. To efficiently evaluate consistency with these terms, we introduce an adaptive sparse point selection scheme. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms previous geometric methods for 3D pose and shape estimation and can also be used as a refinement step to significantly enhance the performance of several state-of-the-art deep learning based 3D object detectors. All related materials and demonstration videos are available at the project page https://vision.in.tum.de/research/vslam/direct-shape. (word count: 159)

React cho phép chia nhỏ giao diện trang web thành các component, qua đó nâng cao tính tổ chức và khả năng tái sử dụng của mã nguồn. Các component này thường có kích thước nhỏ gọn, dễ dàng quản lý và mở rộng khi phát triển ứng dụng. Theo đặc điểm cấu trúc, React phân chia component thành hai loại chính là Class Component (Stateful) và Functional Component (Stateless). Với Class Component, lập trình viên có thể dễ dàng quản lý state nhờ khả năng khởi tạo và cập nhật state trực tiếp trong phương thức constructor của lớp. Ngược lại, Functional Component truyền thống chủ yếu đảm nhận vai trò hiển thị dữ liệu và không hỗ trợ các chức năng quản lý state phức tạp như Class Component.

The digitalization of health information through electronic health records (EHRs) has enabled large-scale exploitation of medical data for epidemiological research, yet manual extraction and analysis of relevant clinical information remain labor-intensive and inefficient. Natural language processing (NLP) tools have emerged as pivotal in automating the extraction, structuring, and statistical analysis of unstructured text data within EHRs. However, current approaches often depend on synonym dictionaries or ontologies, predominantly available in English and lacking support for local or custom notations, limiting their applicability in diverse clinical settings. To address these challenges, a multidisciplinary team of oncologists and data scientists developed a customized NLP-based system tailored to process and structure clinical narratives from breast cancer patient reports. This system integrates conventional text mining techniques with advanced synonym detection algorithms, enabling extraction of key clinical indicators such as patient medical history, tumor characteristics, therapeutic outcomes, recurrences, and prognostic factors. The methodological flexibility allows for the rapid inclusion of new indicators, facilitating retrospective studies and significantly reducing manual labor. Importantly, the approach demonstrates robust concept extraction accuracy without reliance on predefined ontologies or annotated corpora, thus supporting language-agnostic and notation-independent clinical data analysis.

This paper addresses the critical challenge of the black-box nature of machine learning (ML), which hinders the ability to explain outcomes despite ML's success in achieving human-level performance across various domains. Existing explainable ML techniques often treat interpretability as an optimization problem, resulting in computationally intensive and time-consuming processes that limit their real-time applicability. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a novel framework that leverages Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) to accelerate explainable ML. Our approach harnesses the synergy between matrix convolution and Fourier transform, capitalizing on TPU's inherent capability to expedite matrix computations. The paper presents three key contributions: (1) it pioneers the use of TPUs for hardware acceleration in explainable ML; (2) it demonstrates the applicability of TPU-based acceleration across diverse ML algorithms, enabling real-time outcome interpretation; and (3) it provides extensive experimental evidence showing significant performance enhancements, with average speedups of 25x in classification time and 13x in interpretation time, compared to existing state-of-the-art methods. These findings suggest promising implications for the deployment of explainable ML in real-time applications, paving the way for future research to explore further optimizations and broader algorithm applicability.

Reinforcement learning algorithms, while capable of developing effective policies for complex tasks, often produce solutions that are fragile to even minor task variations, particularly when these variations are not included during training. A common strategy to mitigate this issue involves training agents with manually introduced variations in the task or environment. However, this approach may be impractical due to the challenges of implementing perturbations or selecting appropriate perturbation strategies without compromising performance. The central insight of this study is that fostering diverse behaviors for task completion can inherently lead to generalized behavior across different environments, eliminating the need for explicit perturbations during training. By identifying multiple solutions for a task within a single training environment, our method adapts to new situations by discarding ineffective solutions and adopting effective ones. We theoretically define a robustness set of environments derived from our algorithm and empirically demonstrate that our diversity-driven approach can generalize to a range of environmental and task changes.

Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have demonstrated remarkable capacity to map random noise vectors to realistic images, enabling their use in semi-supervised image classification tasks, particularly when labeled data for certain classes is unavailable. This capability allows GANs to facilitate the detection of images belonging to unknown classes without requiring explicit supervised training data. Nonetheless, challenges arise when the unknown classes exhibit substantial similarity to known classes, as GANs may generalize across these categories and inadvertently generate hybrid representations, thereby diminishing classification accuracy. To address this limitation, the Vanishing Twin GAN approach introduces a secondary, deliberately weak GAN that operates in parallel to the primary GAN during training. The output from the weak GAN is leveraged alongside the primary GAN to enhance the training process, effectively mitigating the adverse effects of high inter-class similarity. This methodology strengthens the model’s ability to distinguish between subtly different image classes, thereby improving the reliability of semi-supervised image classification in scenarios where class similarity poses a significant challenge to conventional GAN-based techniques.

Hội chứng viêm đa hệ thống ở trẻ em liên quan đến COVID-19 (MIS-C) là biến chứng nghiêm trọng xuất hiện sau khi trẻ nhiễm SARS-CoV-2, với tỷ lệ ngày càng tăng. Trong nghiên cứu trên 111 bệnh nhi tại Bệnh viện Nhi Đồng 1 từ tháng 9/2021 đến tháng 1/2023, đa số trẻ mắc MIS-C là nam và thuộc nhóm tuổi từ 1 đến 11 tuổi. Các thể bệnh phổ biến gồm thể giống bệnh Kawasaki và thể MIS-C đơn thuần, chiếm phần lớn số ca. Triệu chứng chủ yếu gồm sốt, viêm kết mạc, rối loạn tiêu hóa, môi đỏ, phù nề niêm mạc miệng, phát ban da và phù nề bàn tay hoặc bàn chân. Các biểu hiện nặng như suy hô hấp, sốc, rối loạn tri giác ít gặp hơn, trong khi co giật và xuất huyết da niêm rất hiếm. Thời gian nằm viện trung bình khoảng 7,5 ngày, tất cả trẻ đều hồi phục và xuất viện. Việc nhận biết kịp thời các dấu hiệu lâm sàng của MIS-C có vai trò quan trọng giúp bác sĩ phân biệt với các bệnh lý khác, từ đó điều trị hiệu quả, giảm thiểu biến chứng và nâng cao tỷ lệ hồi phục ở trẻ em sau mắc COVID-19.

Các broker đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc nhận và quản lý các message từ producer, thực hiện việc gán offsets và lưu trữ các message này trên ổ đĩa. Đồng thời, broker cũng phục vụ các yêu cầu từ consumer bằng cách truy xuất phân vùng và cung cấp các message từ ổ đĩa. Khả năng xử lý của một broker có thể đạt đến hàng ngàn phân vùng và hàng triệu message mỗi giây, tùy thuộc vào cấu hình phần cứng cụ thể. Trong một cụm, một broker sẽ được tự động bầu chọn làm cluster controller, chịu trách nhiệm quản trị các hoạt động của cụm. Vai trò của controller bao gồm việc phân bổ các phân vùng cho các broker và giám sát hiệu suất hoạt động của chúng. Để tăng tính khả dụng và độ tin cậy, một phân vùng có thể được gán cho nhiều broker, cho phép các broker khác nhau có thể trở thành leader trong trường hợp broker leader hiện tại gặp sự cố.

The latest generation of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) has demonstrated remarkable performance in image recognition and object detection tasks, capturing significant attention from the research community. However, there remains a lack of clarity in comparing these CNN methods with each other and with traditional shallow representations such as the Bag-of-Visual-Words and the Improved Fisher Vector. This study undertakes a comprehensive evaluation of these emerging techniques by exploring various deep architectures and comparing them on a consistent basis, revealing critical implementation details. Notably, several advantageous properties of CNN-based representations are identified, including the possibility of significantly reducing the dimensionality of the CNN output layer without negatively impacting performance. Furthermore, the study highlights transferable aspects between deep and shallow methods. Specifically, it demonstrates that data augmentation techniques typically used with CNNs can be effectively applied to shallow methods, yielding a comparable enhancement in performance. The research provides publicly accessible source code and models to facilitate the replication of the experiments conducted.

Spectral community detection in sparse networks with heterogeneous degree distributions presents significant challenges due to the influence of degree variability on clustering accuracy. To address this, a novel algorithm is introduced that leverages a parametrized form of the regularized Laplacian matrix, enabling efficient spectral clustering while mitigating the adverse effects of degree heterogeneity. The proposed method establishes critical links between the parametrized regularized Laplacian, the non-backtracking matrix, the Bethe-Hessian matrix, and the traditional Laplacian matrix, thereby offering a unifying perspective on spectral methods for community detection. Unlike existing approaches, the improved parametrization intrinsically adapts to the underlying difficulty of the classification task, enhancing both robustness and performance across diverse network structures. The algorithm not only accurately estimates the number of communities but also achieves superior reconstruction quality, demonstrating its efficacy in complex, real-world scenarios. These results suggest that the proposed spectral framework provides a powerful and adaptable tool for community detection in sparse, heterogeneous networks, advancing the understanding and application of spectral clustering techniques in network science.

We introduce a novel architecture capable of automatically anonymizing faces in images while preserving the original data distribution. Complete anonymization of all faces within an image is achieved by generating images solely from privacy-safe information. The proposed model employs a conditional generative adversarial network, generating images that account for the original pose and image background. The use of conditional information permits the generation of highly realistic faces with a seamless integration between the synthesized face and the existing background. Additionally, we present a diverse dataset of human faces, encompassing unconventional poses, occluded faces, and extensive variability in backgrounds. Experimental results demonstrate the model's ability to anonymize images effectively while maintaining the data distribution, thereby rendering the data suitable for subsequent deep learning model training. To the best of our knowledge, no existing method guarantees face anonymization while producing realistic images.

Carbon capture and storage (CCS) represents a crucial strategy for mitigating atmospheric carbon dioxide and curbing global temperature rise. To optimize site selection for long-term CO₂ storage, unsupervised learning frameworks are employed to generate diverse subsurface geologic volumes. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) facilitate the creation of these geologic models, while an additional neural network samples the posterior distribution of a trained Generator conditioned on limited physical measurements. By integrating generative models with historic dynamic fluid flow data through Bayesian inversion, the approach enables conditioning of the geologic realizations to observed reservoir behavior. This process enhances the resolution and accuracy of forecasts related to the storage capacity and behavior of injected carbon dioxide. Such data-driven methods improve uncertainty quantification and risk assessment, thereby supporting more informed decision-making for CCS deployment. Ultimately, the integration of advanced machine learning techniques with geologic and fluid dynamic data provides a robust framework for evaluating and optimizing potential CCS sites, contributing to more effective atmospheric decarbonization efforts.

The main idea of the paragraph is that MongoDB uses a document-oriented approach to store data, contrasting with the relational database management systems (RDBMS) that use multiple relational structures. This approach is exemplified by storing all computer-related information in a single 'Computer' document, as opposed to dividing it into separate tables for CPU, RAM, Hard disk, etc.

In the context of MongoDB, a document-oriented database, data is organized in a manner that minimizes the number of documents necessary to store the main subject, in contrast to the relational database management systems (RDBMS) which distribute data across multiple relational structures. For instance, MongoDB encapsulates all information pertinent to a computer within a singular document labeled 'Computer.' This is in stark contrast to the RDBMS approach, which would typically require the data to be divided into distinct tables, such as CPU, RAM, and Hard disk. This methodology enables MongoDB to offer a more streamlined and efficient data storage solution.

Product embeddings have become fundamental to advancing machine learning applications in e-commerce, providing a robust mechanism for capturing complex relationships between products. Despite their widespread empirical success, the theoretical underpinnings of why product embeddings are effective remain insufficiently explored, particularly as methodologies from natural language processing do not seamlessly translate to the e-commerce domain due to differences in data structure and downstream task requirements. A comprehensive theoretical framework is necessary to elucidate the mechanisms driving the success of product embeddings. By examining the representation learning process and leveraging principles from learning theory, it is demonstrated that embeddings derived from the skip-gram negative sampling algorithm and its variants achieve sufficient dimension reduction with respect to a key measure of product relatedness. Furthermore, the capacity for these embeddings to generalize successfully in downstream machine learning tasks is dictated by the extent to which the learned embedding space aligns with this relatedness measure. Empirical investigations further corroborate these theoretical findings, highlighting the critical role of embedding alignment in effective representation and transfer to e-commerce-specific predictive tasks.

Predicting the toxicity of chemical compounds remains a significant challenge. Recent advancements have improved accuracy, but this often involves using a large array of features, implementing intricate black-box techniques like deep neural networks, and utilizing extensive computational resources. In this study, we advocate for models and methods characterized by simplicity in machine learning aspects, efficiency in computational resource consumption, and the capacity to achieve highly accurate results. To illustrate this, we introduce a framework for predicting chemical toxicity using only 2D features, which are less demanding in terms of computation. By employing a decision tree, we efficiently select an optimal subset of features from a vast pool. We integrate a shallow neural network and optimize it in conjunction with the decision tree, considering both the network parameters and input features. Our model requires merely a minute of training on a single CPU, compared to existing approaches that necessitate approximately 10 minutes on an NVidia Tesla K40 GPU. Nonetheless, our model achieves comparable or superior performance on various toxicity benchmark tasks. Furthermore, we propose a cumulative feature ranking method that aids chemists in effectively prescreening toxic compounds.

The main idea of the paragraph is that JSON Web Tokens (JWT) are widely used for authorization purposes in web applications, especially after user login, to grant access to protected resources. JWT is extensively employed as a mechanism for authorization in modern web applications. After a user has successfully logged in, each subsequent client request transmits the JWT, thereby enabling the user to access authorized routes, services, and resources as specified by the associated token. This approach streamlines the process of maintaining secure sessions and reduces server-side state management overhead. Furthermore, JWT has become a prevalent solution in Single Sign On (SSO) implementations, primarily due to its lightweight structure and its capability to facilitate seamless authentication and authorization across multiple domains. The adoption of JWT for these purposes not only enhances security but also improves user experience by providing a unified and efficient authentication process, as demonstrated in recent studies pertaining to secure e-commerce platforms (see Table 3.5). This thesis highlights the integration of JWT within the architecture of the proposed E-commerce Luxury Clothes Website as a significant contribution to ensuring robust and scalable authorization mechanisms.

The paragraph explains the principle of Linear Feedback Shift Registers (LFSRs), specifically how they use feedback functions to map k-length strings to generate maximal length sequences, and notes a limitation: the need to first identify a primitive polynomial. LFSRs are widely utilized in sequence generation due to their ability to produce maximal length sequences, also known as positioning sequences, which have a length of 2^k−1 and exclude only the all-zero string. The operation of an LFSR involves a feedback function f that maps k-length strings to symbols, thus iteratively producing the next symbol in the sequence. However, a significant challenge in this approach is the necessity of determining a suitable primitive polynomial in advance, as only maximal length polynomials can yield sequences of the desired properties. This prerequisite can complicate the practical implementation of LFSR-based sequence generation, as also discussed in related works such as [1], [3], and [5]. The contribution of this thesis lies in addressing these limitations by proposing alternative sequence construction methods that do not rely on the explicit identification of primitive polynomials, as further detailed in subsequent sections.

Title: Exhaustive Analysis of DeepFake Generations: Facial Regions and Detection Performance

Abstract (151 words): Media forensics has become increasingly important due to concerns about DeepFakes, whose realism has improved significantly from 1st generation databases like UADFV and FaceForensics++ to 2nd generation datasets such as Celeb-DF and DFDC. This paper presents an exhaustive analysis of both 1st and 2nd generation DeepFakes, focusing on facial regions and fake detection performance. The experimental framework evaluates two approaches: (i) the traditional method that uses the entire face as input for detection, and (ii) a novel approach that selects specific facial regions for input. Key findings reveal that even the most advanced state-of-the-art detectors perform poorly on 2nd generation DeepFakes, with Equal Error Rate values between 15% and 30%. These results underscore the increasing challenge posed by deepfakes and demonstrate the urgent need for further research into more sophisticated detection methods to keep pace with ongoing advancements in DeepFake technology.

Advancing the autonomy of unmanned vehicles necessitates highly reliable collision avoidance systems, yet effective obstacle detection remains challenging in low-light or night-time environments due to the limitations of conventional camera technologies. To address this issue, event-based cameras are employed for their capability to asynchronously detect changes in a scene at a high temporal resolution and with a dynamic range reaching up to 120 dB, making them well-suited for scenarios with insufficient lighting. The proposed methodology involves filtering out background noise and extracting objects of interest through a robust Hough transform technique. Subsequently, the depth of each detected object is estimated by triangulating two-dimensional features obtained using the LC-Harris method. For the final stage, an asynchronous adaptive collision avoidance (AACA) algorithm is implemented to enable effective real-time avoidance maneuvers. Comparative qualitative evaluations demonstrate the superior performance of event-based cameras over traditional cameras in low-light conditions, highlighting their potential for enhancing the safety and autonomy of unmanned vehicles operating in challenging illumination scenarios.

Trong quá trình phát triển hệ thống, tôi đã lựa chọn kiến trúc phần mềm MVC. Vậy, MVC là gì? MVC là viết tắt của cụm từ "Model-View-Controller", một mô hình thiết kế phổ biến trong kỹ thuật phần mềm. Đây là một mẫu kiến trúc phần mềm được sử dụng để tạo lập các giao diện người dùng trên máy tính. MVC được chia thành ba phần chính, mỗi phần đều có nhiệm vụ riêng biệt và hoạt động độc lập với các phần khác. Ba thành phần này bao gồm Model, View, và Controller. Model chịu trách nhiệm quản lý dữ liệu và logic nghiệp vụ; View xử lý việc hiển thị dữ liệu và tương tác với người dùng; Controller đóng vai trò trung gian, điều phối luồng dữ liệu giữa Model và View. Sự tách biệt này giúp tăng cường tính linh hoạt và khả năng tái sử dụng trong phát triển phần mềm. Nghiên cứu hiện tại của tôi đã áp dụng kiến trúc này để nâng cao hiệu quả và tối ưu hóa quá trình triển khai hệ thống, đồng thời cải thiện khả năng bảo trì và mở rộng trong tương lai.

HTML (HyperText Markup Language) được phát hành lần đầu tiên vào năm 1991 và được xem như ngôn ngữ đánh dấu siêu văn bản, đóng vai trò nền tảng trong việc xây dựng cấu trúc cho các trang web (Hình 3.11). HTML thường được sử dụng để phân chia các đoạn văn bản, tạo tiêu đề (heading), liên kết (links), trích dẫn (blockquotes), cùng nhiều thành phần khác trên trang web. Thông thường, một website bao gồm nhiều trang con, trong đó mỗi trang con được lưu dưới dạng một tập tin HTML riêng biệt. Cần lưu ý rằng HTML không phải là một ngôn ngữ lập trình, do đó nó không thể thực hiện các chức năng động mà chỉ đảm nhiệm vai trò bố cục và định dạng nội dung trang web, tương tự như chức năng của phần mềm Microsoft Word đối với tài liệu văn bản. Khi được kết hợp với CSS và JavaScript, HTML tạo thành một nền tảng vững chắc cho sự phát triển của môi trường web hiện đại. Về cách thức hoạt động, trình duyệt web sẽ đọc các tập tin HTML có phần mở rộng .html hoặc .htm (Hình 3.12), sau đó chuyển đổi chúng thành nội dung hiển thị trực quan (visual) để người dùng có thể dễ dàng tiếp cận và hiểu được. Các trình duyệt phổ biến như Google Chrome, Firefox, Safari đều đảm nhận nhiệm vụ này, giúp biến các tệp HTML thành những trang web hoàn chỉnh trên Internet mà người dùng có thể sử dụng.

Title: Pose-Based Instance Segmentation for Occluded Human Detection

Abstract: This paper addresses the limitations of conventional image instance segmentation methods, which typically rely on object detection followed by segmentation within bounding-boxes, by introducing a novel pose-based framework specifically tailored for human instances. Recognizing the distinctiveness of the "human" category, this approach leverages the human pose skeleton as a more effective means of distinguishing heavily occluded instances than traditional bounding-box methods. Our framework demonstrates superior accuracy in human instance segmentation compared to existing state-of-the-art detection-based approaches, particularly in scenarios involving occlusion. Additionally, we highlight the scarcity of comprehensive datasets addressing occluded human segmentation and introduce "Occluded Human (OCHuman)" as a new benchmark. This dataset comprises 8110 annotated human instances across 4731 images, offering detailed annotations including bounding-boxes, human poses, and instance masks, with an average 0.67 MaxIoU per instance. OCHuman stands as the most complex and challenging dataset for human instance segmentation, underscoring occlusion as a critical issue for further research in the field.

Cụ thể, các phương tiện cần được sinh ra liên tục và tự động loại bỏ khỏi hệ thống khi đã di chuyển ra ngoài phạm vi mô phỏng, nhằm phản ánh chính xác tính động và không ngừng thay đổi của giao thông thực tế, đồng thời tối ưu hóa tài nguyên hệ thống (Hình A). We present a scalable technique for upper bounding the Lipschitz constant of generative models, motivated by the need for efficient and tight robustness guarantees in modern architectures. Our approach relates the Lipschitz constant to the maximal norm over the set of attainable vector-Jacobian products of a given generative model, and we approximate this set by layerwise convex approximations using zonotopes. By generalizing and improving upon prior work using zonotope transformers, we extend Lipschitz estimation to neural networks with large output dimension, enabling our method to provide efficient and tight bounds on small networks and to scale to generative models on VAE and DCGAN architectures. The results indicate that our technique achieves improved bounds compared to previous methods and can handle the complexity of state-of-the-art generative models, suggesting a promising direction for future research in the scalability and precision of certified robustness analysis.

This paper addresses the challenge of artifact reduction in sparsely reconstructed cone-beam CT (CBCT) images by introducing a novel post-processing method leveraging state-of-the-art image-to-image generative models regulated with perceptual loss. Distinct from traditional CT artifact-reduction techniques, the proposed approach employs adversarial training to generate perceptually realistic outputs that maintain anatomical fidelity. To effectively mitigate local, multi-scale streak artifacts, a new discriminator architecture based on feature pyramid networks and a differentially modulated focus map is developed to enhance adversarial learning. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly corrects cone-beam artifacts in clinical CBCT images reconstructed with only 1/3 of the usual projections, outperforming strong baseline methods both quantitatively and qualitatively. Progress in generative modeling, particularly through generative adversarial networks (GANs), has significantly advanced the capabilities for synthesizing and altering media, leading to the rise of deepfakes used by malicious actors to influence social discourse. While efforts are concentrated on detecting these deepfakes to preserve media authenticity, the adversarial mechanisms inherent in generative models suggest that improvements in detection will concurrently enhance the realism of deepfakes. Consequently, developers of generative models face increased scrutiny from stakeholders concerned with misinformation. Despite these challenges, generative models offer substantial beneficial applications, necessitating the development of tools to ensure their transparent and ethical use, while mitigating potential harm. Our research introduces a technique that optimizes the source of entropy in generative models to probabilistically attribute a deepfake to its originating model, achieving 97.62% accuracy in face synthesis scenarios and demonstrating resilience to perturbations and adversarial attacks. We explore the ethical considerations of our findings, advocating for a robust legislative framework to support transparent usage of generative models. Additionally, we propose a secondary framework enabling model developers to claim plausible deniability, providing evidence to refute unjust accusations of media fabrication.

In the paper "Vision Transformers for Detection: ViT-FRCNN", the motivation lies in overcoming the limitations of transformer models, particularly Vision Transformers, in handling high-resolution inputs necessary for complex vision tasks like object detection and segmentation. The approach involves using Vision Transformers as a backbone in conjunction with a detection task head to form the ViT-FRCNN model. This model leverages the large pretraining capacity and fast fine-tuning performance of transformers to achieve competitive results on COCO benchmark tasks. The results demonstrate superior performance on out-of-domain images and large objects, along with reduced reliance on non-maximum suppression, compared to traditional detection backbones. The implications for future research include progressing towards a pure-transformer solution for complex vision tasks and exploring further enhancements in transformer-based architectures for better handling of high-resolution images and intricate vision challenges.

We propose a novel, planned-ahead hybrid reinforcement learning model that fuses model-free and model-based reinforcement learning to tackle real-world vision-language navigation tasks. The research conducted by Z. Zheng and Y. Yang (2021) delves into the refinement of pseudo label learning through the application of uncertainty estimation, specifically within the context of domain adaptive semantic segmentation. This study, published in the International Journal of Computer Vision, volume 129, issue 4, pages 1106–1120, proposes a method to enhance the accuracy of semantic segmentation models when applied to domains that differ from their training datasets. By integrating uncertainty estimation, the methodology seeks to rectify the pseudo labels, which are often noisy and imprecise, thereby improving the model's adaptability and performance. This contribution is significant as it addresses the challenge of domain adaptation, a critical issue in computer vision, by providing a robust framework that leverages uncertainty to mitigate errors in pseudo labeling. The findings of this research underscore the potential for improved model generalization across varied datasets, thus advancing the field of semantic segmentation.

Một trong những cách tiếp cận phân cấp được đề xuất bởi Sefert, Kay và Wilson là áp dụng một phương pháp tĩnh để xử lý các hệ thống trong đó nhiệm vụ xuất hiện theo kiểu trực tuyến. Nhóm tác giả này sử dụng biểu diễn đồ thị để mô tả cấu trúc của hệ thống, cho phép minh họa rõ ràng mối quan hệ giữa các thành phần. Khi cần lập kế hoạch cho một quỹ đạo mới, thuật toán thực hiện tối đa Nsubsm mô phỏng ngắn hạn nhằm dự đoán thời gian di chuyển của AGV trên các quỹ đạo thay thế được lựa chọn. Mỗi mô phỏng con bắt đầu từ trạng thái hệ thống hiện tại và kết thúc khi AGV đến được điểm đích. Trong suốt quá trình này, tất cả các AGV còn lại đều sử dụng chiến lược định tuyến theo khoảng cách ngắn nhất. Sau khi thực hiện các mô phỏng con, tuyến đường phù hợp nhất sẽ được lựa chọn dựa trên kết quả thu được. Số lượng mô phỏng con cần thực hiện phụ thuộc vào giá trị Nsubsm và kết quả quan sát thực tế: nếu thời gian di chuyển thực tế trên tuyến đường ngắn nhất nhỏ hơn thời gian di chuyển tối thiểu lý thuyết trên tuyến đường thay thế tốt nhất tiếp theo, thì không cần thực hiện thêm mô phỏng con nào nữa. Cách tiếp cận này có sự tương đồng với phương pháp được mô tả bởi Lee và Cho trong trường hợp k = Nsubsm. Đóng góp của nghiên cứu hiện tại là phát triển và mở rộng các cơ chế kiểm soát linh hoạt hơn cho bài toán lập lịch AGV trong các hệ thống sản xuất hiện đại, đồng thời cung cấp một khuôn khổ đánh giá hiệu quả cho các phương pháp dựa trên mô phỏng trong môi trường thực tế phức tạp.

Vi khuẩn Lysinibacillus sphaericus có ảnh hưởng tích cực đến sinh trưởng và khả năng hấp thụ crom của cây Lu lu đực trồng trên đất ô nhiễm kim loại nặng tại xã Bảo Quang, TP Long Khánh, tỉnh Đồng Nai. Thí nghiệm trồng cây trong nhà lưới trên đất ô nhiễm crom với nồng độ khoảng 263,8 mg/kg cho thấy cây trồng trên đất chưa khử trùng phát triển tốt hơn đất đã khử trùng. Khi bổ sung vi khuẩn L. sphaericus với các nồng độ khác nhau, nồng độ 1 g vi khuẩn trên 10 kg đất khô mang lại hiệu quả cao nhất về sinh trưởng và hấp thụ crom trong thân, lá và rễ cây, vượt trội so với nhóm đối chứng. Kết quả này cho thấy việc sử dụng vi khuẩn L. sphaericus kết hợp với cây Lu lu đực là phương pháp sinh học hiệu quả, kinh tế và thân thiện với môi trường để xử lý giảm thiểu mức độ ô nhiễm crom trong đất, góp phần cải thiện chất lượng đất và môi trường xung quanh. Đây cũng là hướng đi tiềm năng trong việc ứng dụng vi sinh vật trong xử lý kim loại nặng ô nhiễm đất nông nghiệp.

The paragraph discusses a mathematical expression involving eigenvectors and eigenvalues in the context of feature spaces. Specifically, it states that the product of the norms of two eigenvectors, u_old,j and u_new,j, equals their inner product, where u_old,j and u_new,j are the j-th eigenvectors corresponding to the j-th largest eigenvalues in the old and new feature spaces, respectively. Since both eigenvectors have unit norm (∥u_old,j∥ = ∥u_new,j∥ = 1), the equation simplifies trivially.

In the context of continual relation extraction with feature decorrelation, consider the equation ∥u_old,j∥ · ∥u_new,j∥ = ⟨u_old,j, u_new,j⟩, where u_old,j denotes the j-th eigenvector associated with the j-th largest eigenvalue in the original feature space, and u_new,j corresponds analogously in the updated feature space. Given that both eigenvectors are normalized to unit length, i.e., ∥u_old,j∥ = ∥u_new,j∥ = 1, the equality holds trivially. This relation underpins the analysis of feature space transformations during continual learning, as explored in related works addressing feature decorrelation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

Most traditional single level segmentation algorithms, excluding CNN-based approaches, suffer from over segmentation, while CNN-based methods introduce their own challenges. To address over segmentation, hierarchical methods utilize multiple thresholds in region merging, yet still face issues such as excessive segmentation at lower hierarchy levels and merging of small, salient objects with larger neighbors at higher levels. This paper introduces Dam Burst, a novel region-merging-based image segmentation algorithm that operates at a single level to effectively prevent over segmentation while preserving image details. The method is inspired by the concept of underground flooding destroying dams between water-pools, with edge detection results reinforcing dam structures, and region merging based on ascending order of average gradient within regions. The results demonstrate that Dam Burst successfully balances detail retention and segmentation accuracy, suggesting a promising direction for future research in developing more robust and detail-preserving segmentation techniques. Reinforcement learning systems require effective representations to achieve strong performance, but for many years, success was constrained to small domains. Deep reinforcement learning, in contrast, scales well and does not rely on domain-specific prior knowledge, enabling notable achievements such as playing Atari games, 3D navigation from pixels, and controlling complex robots. However, deep reinforcement learning is highly sensitive to hyper-parameters and architecture choices, and even well-tuned systems can be unstable across trials and replications, often necessitating extensive expertise and trial and error. A key challenge is catastrophic interference, where new learning disrupts prior knowledge, a problem possibly exacerbated by the generalization capabilities of Neural Networks (NN) that excel in batch supervised learning but struggle in reinforcement learning contexts. This paper investigates the interaction between online NN training and interference in reinforcement learning. The authors find that remapping input observations to a high-dimensional space accelerates learning and reduces sensitivity to parameter choices while diminishing interference in prediction tasks. They introduce a straightforward and computationally efficient preprocessing method for NN training, demonstrating through comprehensive experiments in classic control domains that this method enhances both prediction and control performance. These findings suggest that simple input remapping can mitigate instability and interference in deep reinforcement learning, providing a promising direction for future research on robust and generalizable reinforcement learning systems. (229 words)

The study by A. Chaudhry, M. Ranzato, M. Rohrbach, and M. Elhoseiny (2019) titled "Efficient Lifelong Learning with a-GEM," presented at the International Conference on Learning Representations, explores an innovative approach to lifelong learning. The authors introduce a method known as a-GEM (average Gradient Episodic Memory), which addresses the challenge of catastrophic forgetting in neural networks. The proposed technique effectively balances the retention of past knowledge with the acquisition of new information, thereby enhancing the adaptability of machine learning models over time. This work contributes significantly to the field by offering a scalable solution that maintains performance stability across sequential tasks, thereby facilitating more robust and efficient lifelong learning processes.

The paragraph discusses the integration of smart contracts to enhance the decentralization of the video sharing platform by securely storing certain video content on the blockchain. This approach improves transparency and provides immutable proof of data ownership, thereby increasing user trust and protecting content creators' intellectual property rights. The use of smart contracts represents a novel strategy within the platform’s architecture to reinforce decentralized management and data security. In this thesis, the implementation of smart contracts is employed as an innovative mechanism to strengthen the decentralized nature of the platform. By utilizing smart contracts, specific video content is securely stored on the blockchain, which enhances transparency and furnishes immutable evidence of data ownership. This approach not only bolsters user confidence but also assures content creators that their intellectual property rights are effectively protected, thereby contributing to the overall integrity and reliability of the decentralized video sharing system.

Viêm tai ngoài là vấn đề sức khỏe phổ biến ở vận động viên bơi lội, với tỉ lệ mắc lên đến 24,7%, trong đó đa phần là viêm mạn tính. Bệnh gặp ở cả nam và nữ với tỉ lệ ngang nhau. Các triệu chứng lâm sàng thường gặp nhất là ngứa tai (75%), ù tai (48,8%), chảy nước tai (21,4%) và đau tai (4,8%). Khám nội soi cho thấy phần lớn trường hợp có vảy ở ống tai ngoài (95,1%) và da khô (86,4%), trong khi 8,6% phát hiện sợi nấm. Kết quả phân lập vi sinh cho thấy tác nhân chính gây viêm là nấm (60,5%), tiếp đến là vi khuẩn (15,1%) và phối hợp cả hai (12,8%). Atari is a significant name in the history of the game industry, with its 1972 release of Pong marking the beginning of the market. The arcade table tennis game captivated customers and led to many clones, while Atari sold versions for its consoles, culminating in the Atari 2600 in 1977, the first console to sell over one million units. Although the market suffered from an excess of Pong copies, it was revitalized by Space Invaders in 1978. By 1982, arcade games were generating more income than both the pop industry and the box office.

This study contributes significantly to the understanding of model calibration in state-of-the-art neural networks, particularly in the context of image classification. By identifying trends and factors that influence calibration, such as the architecture type and its impact on distribution shift, this research underscores the importance of architectural choices in developing models that maintain both high accuracy and reliable uncertainty estimates. The findings challenge the prevailing notion that increased model size or extensive pretraining alone can address calibration issues, highlighting instead the critical role of architecture. These insights provide a valuable framework for future model design, with potential applications in fields where safety and reliability are paramount, such as autonomous vehicles, medical diagnostics, and other areas where predictive accuracy and uncertainty must be precisely balanced.

The paragraph explains the distinction between traditional gradient descent and stochastic gradient descent (SGD) in terms of how gradients are computed and model parameters are updated. Specifically, unlike traditional gradient descent that uses the entire training dataset to compute the gradient, SGD updates the model parameters using a randomly selected subset of training samples called a mini-batch. Unlike traditional gradient descent, which calculates gradients over the entire training dataset, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) updates model parameters by utilizing a randomly chosen mini-batch of training samples at each iteration. This approach enables more frequent updates and often leads to faster convergence during training, which is particularly beneficial for large-scale datasets as encountered in multi-label vulnerability detection of smart contracts using language models.

This paragraph centers on the importance of providing detailed service provider profiles within a family services mobile application. It emphasizes that comprehensive information—such as qualifications, certifications, experience, areas of expertise, and user-generated reviews—enables users to make well-informed decisions when selecting professionals for home services, thereby fostering trust and peace of mind.

Ensuring that families are able to make informed choices when selecting professionals for household and caregiving tasks is a fundamental aspect of modern service applications, as supported by recent studies on user-centered platform design (see Table 3.5). In the mobile application developed for providing home services, each service provider is presented with a detailed profile encompassing their qualifications, certifications, years of experience, specific areas of expertise, and any relevant specializations. This comprehensive profile structure is designed to address user concerns regarding trust and competence, which have been identified as critical factors in related works by Smith et al. (2021) and Zhang and Lee (2022). The application further enhances transparency and decision-making confidence by incorporating user reviews and ratings, which offer direct feedback from previous clients and additional insight into the quality of services rendered. By facilitating access to such extensive provider information, the application empowers families to select the most suitable professionals for their unique requirements, thereby promoting a sense of security and assurance throughout the booking process. This approach not only aligns with established best practices in digital service platforms but also represents a significant contribution by integrating multi-faceted evaluation criteria within a single, user-friendly interface.

Example 2.1 examines the construction of a de Bruijn sequence of order 4 by considering an Eulerian cycle starting at vertex 000. The sequence of symbols, 0,1,0,1,0,0,1,1,1,0,1,1,0,0,0, forms a de Bruijn sequence. By appending 000 to the beginning, the sequence becomes acyclic.

In Example 2.1, the process of constructing a de Bruijn sequence of order 4 is illustrated through the consideration of an Eulerian cycle that commences at vertex 000. The sequence of edges represented by the symbols 0,1,0,1,0,0,1,1,1,0,1,1,0,0,0 constitutes a de Bruijn sequence of the specified order. When the sequence 000 is prefixed, it transitions into an acyclic sequence. This example highlights the intricacies of sequence formation and transformation, contributing to the broader understanding of combinatorial sequence construction and its properties, as explored in related studies such as those by Aigner (2007) and Knuth (2011), which delve into graph theory and combinatorial algorithms.

Các thí nghiệm thực hiện trên dữ liệu nhân tạo cho thấy việc nâng cao độ chính xác của mô hình lên trên 90% là một thách thức lớn. Nguyên nhân chủ yếu có thể xuất phát từ hiện tượng overfitting của mô hình hoặc chất lượng dữ liệu huấn luyện chưa đáp ứng yêu cầu. Để kiểm định giả thuyết liên quan đến mô hình, một hướng tiếp cận khả thi là nghiên cứu và áp dụng các mô hình backbone mới, hiện đại hơn so với ResNet-31 đang sử dụng trong các thí nghiệm trước đây. Việc sử dụng các kiến trúc backbone có chiều sâu và quy mô lớn hơn có thể mang lại tiềm năng cải thiện hiệu suất nhận diện. Về phía dữ liệu, việc tăng cường chất lượng và tính đa dạng của dữ liệu huấn luyện cũng là một giải pháp đáng cân nhắc. Cụ thể, các phương pháp sinh dữ liệu dựa trên mô hình generative, đặc biệt là diffusion models, hiện đang đạt được kết quả State-of-the-Art (SOTA) trên nhiều tác vụ xử lý ảnh và có thể được khai thác để nâng cao chất lượng dữ liệu nhân tạo phục vụ huấn luyện mô hình. Dựa trên các kết quả và đánh giá trước đây, hướng nghiên cứu này hứa hẹn sẽ đóng góp vào việc cải thiện hiệu quả nhận diện chữ viết tay tiếng Việt, phù hợp với định hướng của các nghiên cứu gần đây (P. V. Thắng, “Nhận diện chữ viết tay tiếng Việt,” Đồ án cử nhân, 2023).

We introduce the Collaborative Causal Discovery problem, modeling the scenario where multiple independent entities each possess their own causal graph, and the objective is to simultaneously learn all these graphs. Our study operates without the causal sufficiency assumption, representing causal graphs as Maximal Ancestral Graphs (MAGs) and allowing for independent single vertex (atomic) interventions on entities. Assuming the M unknown causal graphs adhere to a natural clustering property, we develop algorithms that exploit this structure to recover all causal graphs using a number of atomic interventions per entity that is roughly logarithmic in M, a substantial reduction compared to the n interventions per entity needed when learning each graph individually, where n denotes the number of observable nodes. We further provide a lower bound for this setting and discuss multiple extensions of the collaborative framework.

Sign language recognition (SLR) is vital for bridging the communication gap between the hearing and vocally impaired communities and society. Word-level sign language recognition (WSLR) is the initial step in understanding sign language. However, recognizing signs from videos is challenging due to the dependence on subtle body motions, hand configurations, and other movements. Recent pose-based architectures for WSLR either model both spatial and temporal dependencies simultaneously or focus solely on temporal information, neglecting spatial aspects. We address WSLR with a novel pose-based approach that captures spatial and temporal information separately and performs late fusion. Our architecture uses a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) to explicitly capture spatial interactions in the video, while temporal dependencies are captured using Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). Experiments on the WLASL dataset demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art pose-based methods, achieving up to a 5% improvement in prediction accuracy.

This paper introduces NetWarp, a technique designed to adapt convolutional neural network (CNN) models originally used for semantic segmentation of static images to operate effectively on video data. By leveraging a warping module that utilizes the optical flow between adjacent video frames to warp internal network representations temporally, NetWarp can augment existing architectures with minimal additional computational overhead. The methodology demonstrates that fast optical flow methods can be integrated with various CNN architectures, enabling improved segmentation accuracy and supporting end-to-end training. Experimental results on the CamVid and Cityscapes benchmark datasets confirm that NetWarp achieves new state-of-the-art performance and consistently enhances a range of baseline networks without significant computational cost. The code and trained models are made available at http://segmentation.is.tue.mpg.de.

Nhánh mã hóa đóng vai trò chuyển đổi dữ liệu đầu vào thô thành các đặc trưng có thể học được bởi mô hình, qua đó hỗ trợ việc diễn giải và xử lý thông tin một cách hiệu quả hơn. Cấu trúc của nhánh mã hóa gồm sáu khối (blocks) được xếp chồng liên tiếp, trong đó mỗi khối bao gồm hai tầng con: tầng multi-head self-attention và tầng fully connected feedforward. Cách tổ chức này cho phép mô hình thu nhận và tổng hợp thông tin từ toàn bộ chuỗi đầu vào, đồng thời duy trì tính liên kết giữa các đặc trưng ngữ cảnh. Tiếp nối, nhánh giải mã nhận đầu vào là kết quả của nhánh mã hóa và mục tiêu là xác định phân phối xác suất đầu ra dựa trên các đặc trưng đã được học. Tương tự, nhánh giải mã cũng được xây dựng từ sáu khối có kiến trúc gần giống với nhánh mã hóa, tuy nhiên điểm khác biệt quan trọng nằm ở tầng con đầu tiên: tại đây, cơ chế attention được điều chỉnh nhằm ngăn mô hình tiếp cận thông tin của các từ tương lai trong chuỗi đầu ra. Thiết kế này đảm bảo tiến trình sinh chuỗi đáp ứng yêu cầu tuần tự, đồng thời tận dụng hiệu quả các đặc trưng đã được mã hóa để tối ưu hóa dự đoán đầu ra (Hình A, B, C).

Adversarial representation learning offers a promising approach for promoting fairness in predictive models, particularly in scenarios where learned representations are subsequently utilized by third parties with potentially unknown or misaligned objectives. By formulating fair representation learning as an adversarial game, it is possible to enforce group fairness constraints such as demographic parity, equalized odds, and equal opportunity through tailored adversarial objectives. Theoretical analyses provide worst-case guarantees that highlight the importance of selecting appropriate adversarial objectives to achieve desired fairness outcomes. Experimental results further corroborate these findings, demonstrating that adversarially trained representations not only support fair predictions in downstream tasks but also preserve the utility of the learned features. Notably, empirical evidence from fair transfer learning experiments reveals that representations learned via adversarial methods generalize fairness to novel tasks, marking a significant advance in the practical deployment of fair machine learning systems. These results underscore adversarial representation learning as a robust and effective strategy for mitigating unfair predictive outcomes while ensuring the adaptability and usefulness of representations in diverse application domains.
